19018._kDes:
1. Refinement applies to equipment slots only. Changing equipment does not affect refinement bonuses.
2. Slots can still be refined when no equipment is worn, but refinement bonuses only take effect when equipment is equipped.
3. The maximum Refine Level is equal to the character's Current Level.
4. Refining all equipment slots to the specified level activates Resonance stats. The corresponding bonuses only take effect when equipment is equipped.

19019._kDes:
1.Each Refine Level in Equipment Refining has a fixed success rate.
2.Refining may fail. If it does, the Refine Level may decrease by 1.
3.Failed refining attempts or level decreases grant Luck. Consecutive level decreases grant more bonus Luck.
4.At a safe Refine Level, failed refining attempts will neither decrease the Refine Level nor grant Luck. Safe Refine Levels: 4/7/10/13/16/19/22/25.
5.When using Blessed Ore, failed refining attempts will not decrease the Refine Level. Legend Ore increases the refining success rate and prevents the Refine Level from decreasing upon failure.

1. Enhance applies only to equipment slots. Changing equipment does not affect its bonuses.
2. You can still Enhance a slot when no equipment is equipped, but the bonuses only take effect once equipment is equipped in that slot.
3. The maximum Reinforcement level is your character's Current Level.
4. When you Enhance all equipment slots to the specified level, Resonance stats will be activated. You must have equipment equipped in those slots to receive the corresponding bonuses.

25436._kDes:
Cargo Loading
1. After 5:00 AM each day, the Guild Caravan will give each Adventurer an order for the day's required cargo. The cargo can be crafted or purchased through the Trade Exchange or a Stall.
2. After loading the cargo, the Adventurer will receive Personal Rewards based on its value.
3. After loading 5 pieces of cargo in a day, the Adventurer can select Depart and receive generous rewards.
4. Select Depart after loading 6\7\8 pieces of cargo to receive more Additional rewards.

Cargo Help
1. Players can use Get Help to request cargo from guildmates.
2. When a guildmate uses Help Load, both the helper and the requester receive rewards. Help your friends whenever you can!
3. The number of times you can Get Help and Help Load each day is limited, so plan wisely!

26045._kDes:
Basic Rules:
1. MVPs share HP across multiple channels. When an MVP appears, it can be found and fought on every channel, and all battle contributions count toward the rankings.
Reward Rules:
1. MVP rewards are divided into four types: Team Rewards, Participation Rewards, First Strike Rewards, and Final Blow Rewards. Each type has an independent Reward Count and does not affect the others. Click the Reward Count for details.
2. Participation Rewards and Team Rewards have a Chance to contain Rare rewards such as cards. The higher the team's ranking, the greater the Chance of receiving them.
Ranking Rules:
1. After an MVP is defeated, scores are calculated for all participating teams based on damage dealt, damage taken, Healing Volume, and death count. Deaths deduct a small number of points. All participating teams are then ranked by score.
2. If a team has a Member who has reached the Team Reward limit, its total score will be reduced by a certain percentage. The more Members who have reached the limit, the greater the reduction.

40123._kDes:
Pet Basics
1. Unlock pets through Pet Search or by collecting enough shards.
2. Use EXP Books to Level-up pets. Respawn refunds all EXP Books used for Level-up and resets the pet to Lv. 1.
3. A pet's base stats are determined by its level and growth rate.

Pet Skills
1. Combat Skill: An active Pet Skill that can be used after the pet enters battle in modes such as Pet Tower.
2. Passive Skill: A Pet Skill that takes effect when the pet is assigned to a Utility slot.
3. Main Skill: A Pet Skill that the Adventurer can manually use in battle while the pet is assigned to the main slot.
4. Stat Activation Skill: A Pet Skill that grants the Adventurer permanent stat bonuses once the pet is unlocked, even when the pet is not deployed.

Pet Rank and Star Level
1. Every 3 pet Rank Ups increases its star level by 1.
2. Ranking up a pet increases its growth rate.
3. Increasing a pet's star level raises the star level of its Main, Passive, and Stat Activation Skills. Higher-star skills provide stronger effects.

40124._kDes:
Pet Deployment and Assist
1. The Adventurer can deploy 4 pets and assign 5 pets to Assist at the same time: 1 Main slot, 3 Utility slots, and 5 Assist slots. These slots are gradually unlocked with each Adventurer Level Increased milestone.
2. Deploying 3 pets from the same Faction activates that Faction's effect. Each Faction has a different effect.
3. Deployed pets grant the Adventurer a percentage of their base stats. The percentage differs between deployed and Assist pets.
4. A pet in the Main slot grants the Adventurer its Main Skill, while a pet in a Utility slot grants the Adventurer its Passive Skill.
5. Some pets in Utility slots provide a Core Passive with enhanced skill effects. If multiple pets with Core Passives are assigned to Utility slots, only the Core Passive in the lowest-numbered Utility slot takes effect.

44001._kDes: ●Many ferocious monsters have appeared on Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, intent on breaking the dragon's seal. Before challenging the dragon, you must first stop the endless onslaught. Monsters will continuously pour from the purple portals. Only by deploying Adventurers wisely can you repel their assault.

44002._kDes: ●The dragon is sealed at the center of Dragon Sarcophagus Isle. Monsters will continuously surge toward the center in an attempt to break the seal. Any monster that reaches the seal will damage it, so be sure to defeat them before they get close.

44010._kDes:
In the waters surrounding the continent of Midgard lies a little-known island. It appears on no sea chart, and only ships that have lost their way occasionally stumble upon it. Yet no crew dares linger there, for terrifying, thunderous roars have echoed from the island's depths for as long as anyone can remember.
 
Legend holds that the dragon Fafnir is sealed deep within the island. Once a descendant of the giants, he was slain by a descendant of Odin for his insatiable greed for treasure. After Ragnarök, he returned from the underworld to Midgard, transformed into a decaying dragon driven by nothing but greed. To stop Fafnir's plunder and slaughter, people built fortresses, Turrets, and magic formations across the nameless island. Using gold as bait, they ultimately sealed him away through tremendous Devotion. Thus, the island came to be known as Dragon Sarcophagus Isle.

Centuries have since passed, and the seal's power has begun to wane. The roars from the island grow more deafening by the day, while monsters drawn by the dragon's call gather nearby and relentlessly attack the seal.

Fafnir, the dragon once thought safely sealed away, has lost none of his greed. His power stirs deep within Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, threatening the Peace of the continent.

Faced with this threat, the Guild has issued a call to arms. To protect the continent of Midgard and prevent Fafnir from unleashing another catastrophe, brave Adventurers must be assembled. These heroes will form a dragon-slaying force, travel to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle, and challenge Fafnir once more for the sake of the continent's future.
To restore the seal, keep the greedy dragon contained, and protect the Peace of the continent of Midgard, the Guild must gather the bravest Adventurers into a dragon-slaying force and send them to Dragon Sarcophagus Isle to challenge the dragon once more.

53001._kDes:
1. This is a role-playing game suitable for users age 12 and older. Minors are advised to play under parental supervision.
	2. This game features a cartoon art style with detailed visuals, vibrant colors, and lighthearted, lively music. Set against a fictional story and fantasy world, players take on the role of an adventurer embarking on a journey to protect this beautiful world. The game includes competitive gameplay and story-related conflict, but these confrontations are depicted in a cartoon style and cannot be confused with real life. The game includes a text- and voice-based Connect System for interacting with strangers. The Connect System is managed in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
	3. The game includes a real-name user verification System. Users verified as minors are subject to the following restrictions:
	Some gameplay features and items require payment. Users under age 8 may not make payments. Users age 8 or older but under age 16 may spend no more than 50 RMB per transaction and no more than 200 RMB per month. Users age 16 or older who are minors may spend no more than 100 RMB per transaction and no more than 400 RMB per month.
	Accounts without real-name verification cannot log in to play. Verified minors may play for 1 hour each day from 20:00 to 21:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and statutory holidays, and may not play at any other time.
	4. The game includes a party mode, large-scale team missions, and competitions that require players to work together. These activities help Train players' communication and teamwork skills while fostering a sense of group belonging.

69042._kDes: Deep in the forest lived a girl named Ella, who wove winter nests for small animals from fallen leaves each day. One snowy night, she rescued a frozen bluebird. When the bird awoke, it repaid her by spitting out a glowing seed. Ella buried the seed in the moss, and by the next day, it had grown into a Crystal tree. Silver fruit hung among its branches like dewdrops, each reflecting what people desired most in their hearts.

69043._kDes: When the greedy lord heard about it, he stormed into the forest with an axe. But as he struck the trunk, all the fruit suddenly shattered at once, reflecting thousands of disappointed eyes—the eyes of every impoverished person in his domain. The Crystal tree dissolved into mist, leaving only the plainest fruit to roll into Ella's hand. Within it was a vision of the entire forest flourishing.

69044._kDes: Ella finally understood. She gently buried the fruit beside the stream. In the morning light, glowing flowers bloomed all along the bank. They bore no fruit, but allowed everyone who passed to see their heart's true desire. From then on, no one in the forest fought over treasure, because everyone Discovered that the most precious magic had already quietly taken root within their hearts.

10060200000._kDes: Excels at healing allies and specializes in defensive and buff magic.

10060200001._kDes: High Priests are blessed by the gods. They repeatedly work miracles through sacred power and excel at purifying Undead Monsters. With a wide variety of Support and Healing Magic, they are among the most reliable members of any party.

10060200002._kDes: Unlike priests who devote themselves to the gods and focus on the training of the power of mind and magic, they hone their physical body to its peak, focusing on the combat techniques instead. Through achieving the balance of their chi within and utilizing it, they are capable of dealing massive damage.

10060200003._kDes: A powerful presence that saves allies from danger. Reduces the damage allies take while providing powerful Healing.

10060200004._kDes: As the Archbishop closest to the angels, a potent embodiment of sanctity, he offers the finest aid to his allies. At the same time, he wields holy magic to deliver devastating blows to his enemies.

10060200005._kDes: Abacus in hand, cart at the ready. A natural gift for business never stops this merchant from turning a pushcart into the perfect battlefield weapon.

10060200006._kDes: Flame and hammer define a Blacksmith's life—the power of tempering not only forges keen blades, but also empowers the party to Sweep Attack through enemy lines.

10060200007._kDes: Skill elevated to an art, craftsmanship without limit. A Blacksmith at the pinnacle of the craft wields peerless hands to push forging power to its utmost.

10060200008._kDes: Piloting the Madogear Pilot, they Launch long-range cannon fire to demolish enemy lines, or charge in with a kinetic battle axe to control the field and unleash explosive strikes, leaving opponents no time to breathe.

10060200009._kDes: Warriors who walk the path of holy war, wielding faith and Spear as their sharpest weapons. After Job Advance from Swordsman, Crusaders Keep their formidable melee capabilities while further specializing in Spear weapons. They develop two distinct combat styles: an Attack-type Spear build that trades blood for damage, and a defensive shield build that protects allies in peril.

10060200010._kDes: Tempered by even greater holy trials, Paladins Enhance the core mechanics of each Crusader path, further defining the class traits of the "Attacker" and "Protector."

10060200011._kDes: The ultimate evolution of the Crusader path. Royal Guards are not only the kingdom's mightiest warriors, but also engines of Destroy that can shatter enemy Formations on the battlefield. They can both withstand and deal heavy damage, charging through enemy ranks to break their Formation or serving as the core of their own Formation.

10060200012._kDes: Uses a bow to excel at ranged attacks and can knock enemies back at critical moments.

10060200013._kDes: Long-range combat specialist, master of archery, and a mastermind who utilizes traps to lure the enemy into the palm of their hand. They can train a Falcon to support them, and the upper limit to their attack damage is very high.

10060200014._kDes: You can use the instrument to play a variety of songs with powerful support abilities. The notes may sound delightful but they are actually deadly.

10060200015._kDes: They are shooters with perfect aim. Under the attack of arrows and their falcons, no enemy can withstand long, not to mention to fight back.

10060200016._kDes: A solitary Ranger who keeps only a Demonic Wolf for company and has mastered the art of marksmanship. The Ranger can unleash rapid shots at distant targets with the speed of a gale or ride a Demonic Wolf for highly mobile hunts.

10060200018._kDes: Excels at close-range combat, wielding a sword with a balance of offense and defense.

10060200019._kDes: A loyal knight of the kingdom. Skilled with swords and spears, knights can ride Peco Pecos into battle, wield formidable offensive power, and rapidly charge toward enemies.

10060200020._kDes: Their stopping power is enough to crush frontline enemies in the blink of an eye, and they are the most powerful force of The Knights. Not only do they excel in both offensive and defensive positions, once they are in rampage, they're able to massively increase their physique within a short amount of time.

10060200021._kDes: The kingdom's mightiest knight, having mastered the power of runes and tamed a demonic dragon. With complete mastery of swords and spears, Rune Knights ride demonic dragons into the fray, unleash elemental breath attacks, and Sweep Attack entire armies.

10060200022._kDes: Thief is the most agile of all Adventurer classes. Rather than relying on heavy armor to survive, Thieves use their extraordinary reflexes to evade attacks.

10060200023._kDes: Agile, swift, and deadly, Assassins learn the ways of the Dual Blade Technique. Their unrivaled burst damage makes them rulers of one-on-one combat. They can equip the Katar, a weapon with a high critical rate.

10060200024._kDes: Rogues have diverse skills that allow them to use the speed advantage for guerrilla warfare, and the unfortunate enemy that falling into their hands is like a mouse being caught by a cat. There is no way to escape.

10060200025._kDes: An assassin who always has another trick under their sleeve, and none of their targets ever live to see another day. They're good at using poison and assassin techniques to sabotage the enemy's formation and achieve effective results.

10060200026._kDes: When an Assassin Cross achieves a Breakthrough beyond their limits, they become the dreaded Guillotine Cross. Each ring of violet-black afterimages is a waltz that reaps Life—a devastating display of Ultra speed.

10060200027._kDes: Excels at long-range magical combat and can command the five elements of Water, Fire, Wind, Earth, and Ghost.

10060200028._kDes: Capable of using more powerful magics. Although their poor close-quarter combat ability being their weakness as past, by mastering the four elemental stats of Water, Earth, Fire, and Air, they can still be a powerful addition to the team with their incredibly wide-range AOE magics.

10060200029._kDes: Can amplify the power of Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind elemental bolts for terrifying ST damage, but lacks large-area magic attacks.

10060200030._kDes: These magic experts own overwhelming magic potential already, but now their magics are at a complete different level: they are capable of wielding the power of Neutral magics, or even utilizing their Psychokinesis power to control gravity.

10060200031._kDes: Warlocks are the ultimate form of the Mage path and the most complex class in the entire Magic system. They combine absolute mastery of the four Elements with the secrets of Soul Buster. A Warlock can weave the four Elements into an Entrapping Net or crush a single target through sheer force of will with Soul Buster.

10320000167._kDes: “Whoa... W-we’re so high up! The houses below look like tiny dots...”

10320000168._kDes: “Is this rickety ship going to fall out of the sky? The wind's so strong, Bobo's precious feathers are going to blow away!”

10320000169._kDes: “Hey, Master! Hold on tight to me! If Bobo falls, no one will be around to wake you up!”

10320000170._kDes: “…But the clouds here really do look like cotton candy. I wish I could take a bite…”

10320000171._kDes: “The winds are calm—perfect weather for Flying. Thank You for your protection, Goddess Freyja.”

10320000172._kDes: "The White Dove's an old friend of mine. She may sail steady now, but she once saved my life in a storm."

10320000173._kDes: “This route used to be the lifeline of merchant caravans. Now... those damned sky pirates have thrown it into chaos.”

10320000174._kDes: “They’ve defiled the freedom of the skies. Someday, they’ll pay the price.”

10320000175._kDes: “Check the safety rope three times, and keep your weapon within reach. Those are the rules.

10320000177._kDes: “Remember, you can never let your guard down. The skies are every bit as dangerous as the land.”

10320000178._kDes: “Hey, newbie! What do you think? This view—the scenery—is amazing, right?”

10320000179._kDes: “Hahaha! Judging by the look on your face, is this your first time on an airship? Nervous? Relax—I’ve got your back!”

10320000180._kDes: “Once we reach the desert, I'll show you a real sunrise over the sea of sand. Now that's a magnificent sight.”

10320000181._kDes: “Once night falls, we'll camp atop the dunes, and I'll treat you to the strongest desert ale around!”

10320000182._kDes: If you insist on staying on deck instead of going into the cabin, you'd better hold tight to the railing.

10320000568._kDes: Enemy forces are gathering south of Prontera. All defenders, prepare for battle!

10320000569._kDes: The main enemy force is highly likely to attack from the south!

10320000570._kDes: Scattered enemies have also appeared to the east and west, but Prontera South Gate remains our primary defensive line.

10320000571._kDes: The Goddess's army has begun its invasion! Prontera South Gate is under direct assault. Head there and engage the enemy immediately!

10320000572._kDes: Numerous invading monsters have appeared at Prontera South Gate. Nearby Adventurers, provide support immediately!

10320000573._kDes: A small group of invading monsters has been discovered at Prontera East Gate. Nearby defenders should handle them first; there is no need for everyone to fall back and defend the gate.

10320000574._kDes: The battle at Prontera South Gate has intensified! The enemy is trying to break through the outer defenses. All combat-ready personnel, reinforce the South Gate first!

10320000575._kDes: Enemy forces are harassing Prontera West Gate. Nearby defenders, suppress them before the flank falls!

10320000576._kDes: Prontera South Gate's defenses are under pressure, and the enemy continues to gather. More defenders, reinforce the gate immediately!

10320000577._kDes: South Gate defenders, take heed! The enemy is advancing into the city, and the Inn area may become the next battlefield!

10320000578._kDes: The enemy has breached the South Gate perimeter and is advancing toward the Inn! Fall back and defend the Inn area immediately!

10320000579._kDes: The Inn's defenses are under heavy pressure! The enemy is trying to push into the southern district. Support the Inn immediately!

10320000580._kDes: Signs of enemy activity have been discovered near the Library. All defenders, stay alert!

10320000581._kDes: Invading monsters have appeared near the Library. Some defenders should assist there while the rest continue holding the Inn!

10320000582._kDes: The situation at the Inn is critical! If it falls, the enemy will directly threaten the central district!

10320000583._kDes: Numerous invading monsters have been discovered in the Inn area. Nearby Adventurers, eliminate them!

10320000584._kDes: Signs of a breakthrough are mounting! Enemy vanguards have appeared on the central district's main road. Prepare to fall back toward the center!

10320000585._kDes: Alert! The enemy is nearing Prontera's core, and the central defensive line is about to become the Main Battlefield!

10320000586._kDes: The enemy has pushed into the central district! Head to the central perimeter defenses and engage them immediately!

10320000587._kDes: Large numbers of invading monsters have appeared along the central perimeter. All mobile defenders, provide support immediately!

10320000588._kDes: Enemy stragglers are still harassing the South Gate, but our top priority is holding the central district's defensive line!

10320000589._kDes: The central district's defenses are under pressure! The enemy is closing in on Prontera's core. Prioritize the central defenses!

10320000590._kDes: All defenders, fall back to the center immediately! The enemy is closing in on the heart of Prontera! This is our last line of defense!

10320000591._kDes: Elite enemy forces have appeared in the central area! All combat-ready personnel, assemble there immediately!

10320000592._kDes: The central defenses are under heavy attack! If they fall, Prontera will quickly be overrun!

10320000593._kDes: A powerful enemy has arrived! A high-threat target has appeared in the central area! Focus your attacks and eliminate it immediately!

10320000594._kDes: The central area is under relentless assault! All defenders, fight with everything you have! Do not Move back!

10320000595._kDes: This is our last line of defense! All defenders, hold the center at all costs! The fate of Prontera will be decided here!

10320000596._kDes: Attention, all defenders! Final Settlement is imminent! Hold the central defenses!

10320000597._kDes: Good news! Prontera's central defenses have held, and the Goddess Legion's latest assault has been repelled!

10320000599._kDes: Terrible news... Prontera's central defenses have been breached, and the capital has fallen!

10320000600._kDes: Quick, we can't hold out much longer...

10320000601._kDes: Help! Help! Can anyone save us?

10320000602._kDes:
Bobo
They ran into Eddga! Let's go help them!

10320000603._kDes:
Bobo
The great king has arrived! All you monsters and fiends, clear the way!

10320000604._kDes:
Bobo
(Gasps) W-w-why is it Eddga?!!! (Squeezes eyes shut) Never mind! Saving them comes first! Adventurer, let's go!

10320000605._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa! Watch out for its claws!

10320000606._kDes:
Bobo
Eddga jumped into the air! Get Away from it!

10320000608._kDes:
Bobo
Something's wrong with these flames! Don't stand too close!

10320000609._kDes: We actually defeated Eddga! I can't believe it!

10320000610._kDes: (Wipes away tears) We're saved... Thank you, our saviors...

10320000611._kDes:
Bobo
Hehe, we did it! We really defeated Eddga!

10320000612._kDes:
Bobo
(Flies around in circles) Hehe! We got to help people and Complete the Commission! We're amazing!

10320000613._kDes:
Bobo
The sound's getting louder! It's just ahead!

10320000614._kDes: Wule, this is an emergency! Use the signal flare, quickly! If Eddga reaches town, we're in serious trouble!

10320000615._kDes: Player, I need a little more time to launch the signal flare. Can you hold off Eddga for a while?

10320000616._kDes: (Panting) Rookie, you shouldn't have come... Cough, cough...

10320000617._kDes:
Bobo
Aah! What a huge tiger! Bobo's going to be eaten!

10320000618._kDes:
Wule
^{1}PlayerName^{2}, quick! The red circle marks Eddga's attack range. Get out of there!

10320000619._kDes: We can't go on like this. If only someone nearby could help us...

10320000620._kDes: This is humiliating... We actually let a rookie protect us...

10320000621._kDes: There's only one option left. Let's hope there are other Adventurers nearby.

10320000622._kDes: You still have a signal flare? Let's take our chances!

10320000623._kDes:
Bobo
Aah! What do we do? We really can't hold out much longer!

10320000625._kDes: Call for backup! I'll heal him first~

10320000626._kDes: I have fire armor! Healer, cast Safety Wall on Me!

10320000627._kDes: Everyone, use Water skills if you can! They're effective against Eddga!

10320000628._kDes:
Bobo
Wow! Fighting together makes such a difference! I think we're going to win~

10320000629._kDes: You found Eddga already? You're amazing, Party Leader~

10320000630._kDes:
Bobo
I Discover you, crate thief! You dared to steal our cargo, so today we're turning you into lamb skewers!

10320000631._kDes:
Bobo
Master, watch out! Stay out of Baphomet's attack range!

10320000632._kDes:
Bobo
Quick, hide behind the pillar!

10320000633._kDes:
Bobo
Hehe, Baphomet isn't so tough after all!

10320000634._kDes:
Bobo
There are more crates ahead. Let's see if any of the Professor's supplies are inside!

10320000635._kDes:
Bobo
Is this the Shadow Clone Technique of Legend...?!

10320000636._kDes: Phew! Giving it a good beating made me feel much better!

10320000638._kDes: There are more crates ahead. Let's check them out together!

10320000639._kDes:
Bobo
We almost beat it! Let's try again!

10320000640._kDes:
Bobo
Ugh, I'm so dizzy... Where are we?

10320000641._kDes:
Bobo
Pharaoh?! Did Pharaoh trap us inside a coffin?

10320000642._kDes:
Bobo
No fair, ganging up on us! Be careful, Master!

10320000643._kDes:
Bobo
Stay Away from those beams! They'll burn you!

10320000644._kDes:
Bobo
We must have entered Pharaoh's illusion. He appeared and vanished so quickly. How strange...

10320000645._kDes:
Bobo
Ugh, I don't understand any of this. Let's go ask the Professor.

10320000646._kDes:
Bobo
This Pharaoh is stronger than any monster we've faced before. Is it because of the Relic?

10320000647._kDes:
Bobo
Ugh, I don't understand any of this. Let's go ask the Professor!

10320000648._kDes:
Bobo
We almost beat it! Let's try again

10320000649._kDes:
Bobo
I heard Maya's minions built an underground kingdom for her. Is this it?

10320000650._kDes:
Bobo
The sand is moving... No good, I'm being sucked in! Quick, save Me!

10320000651._kDes:
Bobo
(Cries echo from nearby) Waaah! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, are you there?!

10320000652._kDes:
Bobo
(A splat, as if something was hit) Aaaaah! What is this stuff? It's all sticky!

10320000654._kDes: Use the movement wheel or the A and D keys to steer. Be careful to avoid the ant eggs.

10320000655._kDes:
Bobo
 There's a big pit up ahead. I'll go check it out!

10320000656._kDes: There seems to be a huge pit up ahead...

10320000657._kDes: Ah! Why is the sand moving?! No good, I'm being sucked in!!!

10320000658._kDes:
Bobo
 Aaaah... This hole is so deep! Help!

10320000659._kDes:
Bobo
You're finally here! Any later and you would've lost the world's Cutest Bobo!

10320000660._kDes:
Bobo
Ugh, I'm filthy! I can barely even spread my wings.

10320000662._kDes:
Bobo
It's a dead end... Aaaah, look over there! Something's crawling toward us! It's all black... Huh? It looks like an ant!

10320000663._kDes:
Bobo
It seems to like those glowing things—I've got it! Let's gather some to bribe it into carrying us across.

10320000664._kDes:
Bobo
It's so big, but surprisingly Agile! Maybe I should recruit it as my minion!

10320000665._kDes:
Bobo
It's too narrow here for the ant. Should we squeeze through?

10320000666._kDes:
Bobo
It seems to know exactly where it's going. Is there something special over there?

10320000667._kDes:
Bobo
This should be enough. Let's go find that giant ant!

10320000669._kDes:
Bobo
Ah, it's Maya! (Covers mouth with wings) I don't see the professor. Did she hide him somewhere?

10320000670._kDes:
Bobo
Whatever! Let's defeat her first!

10320000671._kDes:
Bobo
Hmph! Maya wasn't so tough! I heard monsters hide their treasures in their nests. Could the professor be here?

10320000672._kDes:
Bobo
Where could the professor be?

10320000673._kDes:
Bobo
There's a path up ahead! Let's check it out!

10320000674._kDes:
Bobo
Do you think the Professor is still alive...?

10320000675._kDes:
Bobo
(Shakes head) No, no, no! He has to be okay! We still need him to pay our commission!

10320000676._kDes:
Bobo
There are so many ant eggs, and I can just make out pieces of armor... It looks like a lot of people died here...

10320000678._kDes:
Bobo
That's the professor's voice! Let's hurry and get him down!

10320000679._kDes: (Clutches lower back) Owww... I feel like every bone in my body is falling apart...

10320000680._kDes: Whoa... We're Flying s-so high! The houses below look like tiny dots...

10320000681._kDes: Is this wreck going to fall out of the sky? The wind's so strong, it's going to blow away Bobo's precious feathers!

10320000682._kDes: Hey, you'd better hold on tight to me! If Bobo falls, there'll be no one to wake you up!

10320000683._kDes: ...But the clouds up here really do look like Cotton candy. I wish I could take a bite...

10320000684._kDes: The skies are calm. It's perfect weather for Flying. Thank You for your protection, Goddess Freyja.

10320000685._kDes: The White Dove and I go way back. She may be steady now, but she once saved my Life in a storm.

10320000686._kDes: This route used to be the Life line of merchant caravans. Now... those damn air pirates have made it anything but peaceful.

10320000687._kDes: They've defiled the freedom of flight. Someday, they'll pay for it.

10320000688._kDes: Check the safety ropes three times, and keep your weapon within reach. Those are the rules.

10320000690._kDes: Remember, never let your guard down. The sky is every bit as dangerous as the land.

10320000691._kDes: Hey, rookie! How's it feel? This view is amazing, isn't it?

10320000692._kDes: Hahaha! Judging by your face, you must be nervous about your first airship ride. Relax—I've got your back!

10320000693._kDes: Once we reach the desert, I'll show you a real sunrise over the sea of sand. Now that's a magnificent sight!

10320000694._kDes: When night falls, we'll camp atop the dunes, and I'll treat you to the strongest desert ale around!

10320000695._kDes:
Captain
If you're set on staying on deck instead of going inside, you'd better hold on to the railing.

10320000696._kDes:
Captain
If the wind blows you off the airship, don't blame me! Hahahaha!

10320000697._kDes:
Bobo
Waaaaah! I can't keep my balance... What's happening?

10320000699._kDes:
Eden Group Leader
Could it be the Desert Eagles? Aren't we just "lucky"?

10320000700._kDes:
Captain
It's those damn air pirates! They just won't leave us alone!

10320000701._kDes:
Eden Group Leader
The ship will fall apart at this rate! Wuller, take some people belowdecks and assess the damage! You're quick on your feet—get to the starboard Turret and launch an Auto Counter! Show them what we're made of!

10320000702._kDes:
Captain
Aim before You fire! Conserve ammo and target their engines and sails!

10320000703._kDes:
Eden Group Leader
This is bad. Their ship is getting closer. Wuller, Boya, prepare to defend!

10320000704._kDes:
Captain
They're probably planning to board us and seize both the crew and cargo. I'll leave the fighting to you while I try to shake these bastards!

10320000705._kDes:
Air Pirate Boss
All right, boys! Charge! Take this ship, and everything aboard is ours!

10320000706._kDes:
Wuller
Hey, rookie! You handle the small fry over here! We'll stop their leader!

10320000707._kDes:
Air Pirate Lackey
Take out the one with the pet!

10320000708._kDes:
Air Pirate Boss
Don't... celebrate just yet... By the Desert Eagles, I swear... Blood... will be repaid in blood...

10320000709._kDes:
Captain
Bah! If blood truly had to be repaid in blood, you'd have died eight hundred times over!

10320000710._kDes:
Eden Group Leader
Those air pirates were tougher than I expected. You did well, rookie. You took down quite a few enemies.

10320000711._kDes:
Boya
Ha! When we work together, those air pirates don't stand a chance!

10320000712._kDes:
Captain
Uh... Adventurer, could you come over here?

10320000713._kDes:
Bobo
Oh no! The Captain looks hurt! Let's go check on him!

10320000715._kDes:
Captain
Damn... Don't tell me they have... reinforcements?

10320000716._kDes:
Bobo
We almost won. Let's Try Again!

10320000717._kDes:
Professor Ryan
(Checks inside his coat) Good, it's not damaged.

10320000718._kDes:
Bobo
Look! There's a treasure chest up ahead!

10320000719._kDes:
Bobo
We're rich! What a haul! Hehe!

10320000720._kDes:
Bobo
We almost won. Let's Try Again!

10320000721._kDes:
Bobo
Waaaah! It's a huge Sandstorm! We can't dodge it! I'll help You!

10320000722._kDes:
Bobo
Is that... a tornado?! Run!

10320000723._kDes:
Bobo
Ooh, what does riding a giant ant feel like? Does it make You dizzy? Bobo wants to try too...

10320000724._kDes: Help! Help! Won't somebody save us?[g@{1}]

10320000725._kDes: Help! Help! Is nobody really going to save us?[g@{1}]

10320000727._kDes:
Moonlight Flower
Taunt them, then start the game again!

10320000728._kDes:
Louis
Guess which Bell my cat is hiding in!

10320000729._kDes:
Louis
Congratulations, you got it right! Let's go again—this time it'll be harder!

10320000730._kDes:
Louis
Sorry, wrong guess! Let's try again.

10320000731._kDes:
Moonlight Flower
I'm about to catch you! Watch out!

10320000732._kDes:
Moonlight Flower
You're pretty good at hide-and-seek! Play with me a little longer!

10320000733._kDes:
Moonlight Flower
I didn't know you were so good! I had a great time~

10320000734._kDes:
Louis
Let's start the game! Guess where my cat will move!

10320000735._kDes:
Louis
Darn, you got it right again! I give up.

10320000736._kDes: Hide in the darkness and don't let them Discover you!

10320000737._kDes: Meow, meow! Let the hide-and-seek begin!

10320000738._kDes: Hehe, I'm the Moonlit Challenger of hide-and-seek!

10320000740._kDes: You're no good at hide-and-seek! Hahaha! Play with me again~

10320000741._kDes: I didn't know you were so good! I had a great time~

10320000742._kDes:
Bobo
The device is over there. Let's hurry and bring it back to the Professor.

10320000744._kDes:
Bobo
Got it! Let's get out of here~

10320000749._kDes: Looks like you're not taking this very seriously.

10320000752._kDes: Tsk, tsk. It's only the first round.

10320000753._kDes: You actually lost that? You're not even smart enough to be a lackey...

10320000755._kDes: Hahaha, Martha, calm down. Give him one more chance.

10320000758._kDes: This round really is a little tricky, but...

10320000759._kDes: Tch... No idea what you were acting so smug about at first.

10320000760._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? Someone over there is waving at us~ I guess we can go see what they want!

10320000761._kDes:
Rhine
Hey, Adventurer! Are You here for the Novice Trial? Come over here.

10320000762._kDes:
Bobo
The Elder Lady said we could use the Fly Wing once we reached the forest. This must be the place, right?

10320000763._kDes:
Bobo
Did you hear something? It sounded like it came from up ahead.

10320000765._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa! W-What's happening? This compass is glowing!

10320000766._kDes:
Bobo
Ugh, why do these Chonchons keep following us? Shoo!

10320000767._kDes:
Bobo
There's a man over there covered in dirt. Could he be the Professor?

10320000768._kDes:
Bobo
Whew, we're finally back! I'm going to get some beauty sleep!

10320000769._kDes:
Bobo
Master, look at these claw marks... Baphomet might be nearby.

10320000770._kDes:
Bobo
Hey, there's another chest over there. Waaah—!! M-Master, help! Is that Baphomet?!

10320000771._kDes:
Bobo
Found it! It's this shiny thing right here~

10320000772._kDes:
Bobo
(Shakes head) I feel awful as soon as I get near this place... Is the Relic causing it?

10320000774._kDes:
Guard
This monster's tough... Ngh... Hah!

10320000775._kDes:
Bobo
That must be the Relic up ahead! Whew, we finally found it!

10320000777._kDes:
Bobo
This famous port city lives up to its reputation! I can already feel the sea breeze!

10320000778._kDes:
Mysterious Boy
Professional Job Advance tests! Step right up and don't miss out!

10320000779._kDes:
Rhine
Adventurers here for the Novice Trial, please come this way!

10320000780._kDes:
Bobo
Master~ That hunk of junk is glowing again... This can't be good!

10320000781._kDes:
Bobo
Look! Prontera is just beyond that gate! Let's go!

10320000782._kDes:
Young Male Voice
Can we be reasonable here? You've been sitting here since five in the morning without fighting a single monster! You're hogging the spot and doing nothing!

10320000783._kDes:
Elderly Male Voice
Young man, all that anger is bad for your liver... This is the best spot around for soaking up the sun.

10320000784._kDes:
Gruff Voice
So you're the ones who ruined my plans, huh? Take this!

10320000785._kDes:
Vendor's Cry
Step right up! Freshly forged Novice Steel Swords! With one of these, your mom will never worry about you running into a Fabre again!

10320000786._kDes:
Vendor's Cry
One bottle perks you up, two keep fatigue away! Limited-time special!

10320000788._kDes:
Weak Voice
Help me... I need water...

10320000792._kDes: The ball is about to begin. Get ready!

10320000793._kDes: Quickly press the arrow key corresponding to the direction of Luna's Dance Move.

10320000794._kDes:
Bobo
Hey, hey~ Master! That Elder Lady over there seems to be waving us over. Let's go see what she wants.

10320000795._kDes: Explosive barrels blast a cross-shaped area. Be sure to dodge!

10320000798._kDes: How could you get that move wrong?

10320000803._kDes:
Professor
I knew it! You really can activate it! Hahahahaha!

10320000804._kDes:
Bobo
A coffin? What do You mean?

10320000806._kDes: The Professor was taken?! What do we do now?

10320000807._kDes: Was I seeing things just now? Maya actually carried someone off? My goodness, I can't believe I witnessed something like that...

10320000808._kDes: Follow Me. See that door over there?

10320000809._kDes: You've glimpsed the truth of this world. Be careful~

10320000810._kDes:
Martha
Darn it! We almost won. Louie, let's challenge them again!

10320000811._kDes:
Louie
A bet's a bet, Martha. This investigator is truly skilled. We admit defeat.

10320000813._kDes:
Church Knight
You couldn't have come at a worse time. Watch out!

10320000816._kDes:
Merchant
In business, the goods have to match the order. You brought them back way too quickly. There's no way you did a thorough job, so I can't give you the original price for these airship tickets anymore~

10320000817._kDes:
Boya
Say that again! I'll kick your head around like a ball! I hate cheats more than anything!

10320000818._kDes:
Merchant
F-Fine... You win. You got the better of me today!

10320000819._kDes: W-What are you going to do?!

10320000822._kDes: Huh? The investigator is a dog?

10320000824._kDes: Ah! Why did it suddenly run off? Could it be...

10320000825._kDes:
Sprazzi
Beginners, please gather over here!

10320000827._kDes: The village chief never said there'd be a test...

10320000828._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? It looks like Fervor stopped someone up ahead!

10320000829._kDes:
Cockroach Researcher
Ugh, stupid dog! Go away! Stay away from me!

10320000830._kDes:
Cockroach Researcher
T-That was terrifying... I've been afraid of dogs since I was little. I'm getting out of here!

10320000831._kDes:
Bobo
Seriously... I hope this Clue is actually useful. Let's hurry and follow Fervor.

10320000832._kDes:
Bobo
Could that little thief be inside the Culvert? Let's hurry over and see~

10320000833._kDes:
Mysterious Woman
Is anyone there? Help Me~ Help Me~

10320000834._kDes:
Bobo
Come on, hurry! Let's get on the airship already. I can't wait!

10320000835._kDes: Why are you walking so slowly—

10320000836._kDes:
Bobo
W-What's going on? Why is that compass on your chest glowing? That's scary! It's not going to explode, is it?!

10320000837._kDes:
Bobo
Hurry and Take off the compass so we can check it!

10320000838._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa, why is this thing glowing again?

10320000839._kDes:
Bobo
I've got a bad feeling whenever this lousy compass lights up. Hurry and check it, bo!

10320000841._kDes:
Bobo
You rotten thieves! You're the ones who stole the Professor's instruments, aren't you?!

10320000842._kDes:
Louie
Well, well. I'm surprised you managed to follow us all the way here.

10320000843._kDes:
Fervor
Woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof!

10320000844._kDes:
Bobo
Look! That's a Peco Peco nest over there, right? And there are two people there!

10320000845._kDes:
Soldier
Reporting, Commander! Something unusual is happening at the Pyramid!

10320000846._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa! There are so many people up ahead. What are they doing?

10320000847._kDes:
Rhine
Hey, Adventurer! Are you here to take the Novice Trial? Please come over here.

10320000848._kDes:
Bobo
Could that be the egg we're looking for in those bushes?

10320000849._kDes:
Bobo
Oh no! We flew right into a horde of monsters!

10320000850._kDes:
Boya
Damn, this Eddga is really tough!

10320000851._kDes:
Bobo
Izlude may be right next to Prontera, but the scenery is completely different.

10320000852._kDes:
Bobo
The Party Leader who was carried off by a bird? Could it be that Peco Peco up ahead?

10320000853._kDes:
Monster Research Adventurer
Damn it, these blasted Chonchons! Please Help Me!

10320000854._kDes:
Bobo
Where's the Professor? These ants didn't bury them in the sand, did they?! Hurry and drive these pesky ants away!

10320000855._kDes:
Bobo
There's no one here. We may need to look farther inside. But these ants are so annoying! Why don't we clear them out while we're at it? We'd be doing everyone a favor!

10320000857._kDes:
Bobo
The place circled in red in the notes must be the Professor's destination. Looks like we need to keep going.

10320000858._kDes:
Bobo
Look! Could that old man be the Professor?

10320000859._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa, there's a hole here!

10320000860._kDes:
Bobo
Fervor ran off! Hurry, follow him!

10320000861._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? It looks like he stopped up ahead.

10320000863._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? He stopped. Is he scared of that swarm of bats up ahead?

10320000864._kDes:
Bobo
Look! Fervor stopped someone. Could that guy be the thief?

10320000865._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? He stopped. Is there another Monster up ahead that he's afraid of? Are all dogs this timid?

10320000866._kDes:
Bobo
Why did he stop again? I hope it's not because of food this time...

10320000867._kDes:
Bobo
Why did he stop next to the Culvert inlet? The thief couldn't be inside, could they?!

10320000868._kDes:
Bobo
Those three little thieves have no taste at all. Why would they set up their headquarters in the Culvert? It stinks...

10320000869._kDes:
Bobo
Hey, look at these claw marks... Baphomet may be Nearby.

10320000870._kDes:
Bobo
There's someone over there! Could he be looking for the goods too?

10320000871._kDes:
Bobo
Look! There's a chest over there~

10320000872._kDes:
Bobo
Something doesn't feel right around here...

10320000873._kDes:
Bobo
We found them. It's this shiny thing right here~ Let's hurry back. That old man must be getting impatient!

10320000874._kDes:
Bobo
I feel irritated whenever we Enter the Pyramid. Is the Relic causing it?

10320000875._kDes:
Struggling Soldier
Damn Monster, get away!

10320000876._kDes:
Struggling Soldier
Thank goodness... Thank you for your help!

10320000877._kDes:
Injured Soldier
This Monster is tough... Ngh... Hah!

10320000878._kDes:
Injured Soldier
I almost couldn't hold out any longer. Good thing you came.

10320000879._kDes:
Bobo
Huh? Something's wrong up ahead! The Professor and the others are surrounded by Monsters!

10320000881._kDes:
Bobo
(Flies up from the ground) We tried to help, but we got beaten up instead! Huh? Where's the Professor?

10320000882._kDes: Monsters are about to appear. Get ready!

10320000883._kDes: A huge wave of monsters is approaching!

10320000885._kDes:
Bobo
(Sniff, sniff) Something's not right. I smell monsters!

10320000886._kDes:
Bobo
Whoa! What's going on?! There are monsters everywhere!

10320000887._kDes:
Bobo
C-could it be because of that egg?!

10320000888._kDes:
Bobo
Aaargh! There are more?! Adventurer, you have to hang in there!

10320000889._kDes:
Bobo
They just keep coming~ This egg-stealing request is both dangerous and unethical...

10320000890._kDes:
Bobo
Whew, it's finally over~ Thank goodness we're still alive!

10320000894._kDes: You will obtain a Personal Skill in @{1}s!

10370000000._kDes: Thank you for using our services!

10370000015._kDes: I'm just a little kitty. Why do I have to work, meow?

10370000018._kDes: Meowcici Mining Company at your service~ Oh, you're still a new adventurer! Come play with me once you reach Lv. @{1}~

10370000020._kDes: Don't go pining after me. I'm out of your league, meow.

10370000021._kDes: The weather's lovely today, meow~ What can I do for you?

10370000022._kDes: This little kitty has been working for so long. Can I go out and play for a while, meow?

10370000023._kDes: Once I make some money, I'm gonna freaking eat, eat, eat, meow~

10370000024._kDes: Why is it raining? Because thinking of you has me sweating buckets, meow!

10370000025._kDes: Where the stars converge, the Starshatter Dragon shall descend once more.

10370000026._kDes: I Want to Summon the Dragon

10370000029._kDes: The time has come. Begin the ritual.

10370000031._kDes: This is also in speech-bubble format@{1}

10370000034._kDes: Hmph... Why did you stop us? What are you after?

10370000035._kDes: Oh, please don't be so nervous. I'm Spratzi, and I welcome Novices arriving at the South Gate.

10370000036._kDes: In that case, could you show us your staff ID?

10370000037._kDes: Well, uh... We haven't been issued staff IDs yet.

10370000039._kDes: I'm also a freshman receptionist at Criatura Academy. Rest assured, I'm not anyone suspicious.

10370000040._kDes: Before entering Prontera, you'll need to pass the Novice Trial at the South Gate.

10370000041._kDes: Once you pass the trial, you can head To Prontera for your Job Advance...

10370000042._kDes: Sorry for the lengthy explanation. The Eden Group staff should be waiting for you, so please hurry along.

10370000043._kDes: Hello, I'm Rhine. I'm responsible for recording and evaluating the Novice Trial.

10370000044._kDes: The Novice Trial is easy. Complete two basic quests to prove you have the potential to take on a regular job. Then you'll receive proof that allows you to go to Prontera for your Job Advance.

10370000045._kDes: For your first task, collect @{1} pieces of ^{3}【Sticky Mucus】^{4} from the nearby ^{1}Porings^{2}. Porings don't hit very hard, but as a beginner, you should still be careful.

10370000046._kDes: Good work. Your combat record shows that you handled yourself consistently well.

10370000047._kDes: Now for the next step. The Medicine workshop needs 【Sticky Mucus】 dropped by Porings as a stabilizer for basic medicinal ingredients.

10370000048._kDes: Collect ^{1}@{1} pieces of 【Sticky Mucus】^{2} from the Porings you defeat. Make sure the texture is uniform, as impurities will affect the Medicine's effectiveness.

10370000049._kDes: Oh, that's right. This is adventuring gear issued to beginners by the Eden Group. It should help with your task.

10370000050._kDes: Well? Have you completed the task?

10370000053._kDes: For your next task, defeat ^{1}Fabres^{2} and collect ^{3}@{1} pieces of 【Fluff】^{4} from them.

10370000054._kDes: Fabres are usually found near Prontera South Gate. Their soft yet durable fur can be used to craft all kinds of equipment. Stay safe.

10370000055._kDes: Well done. You've completed the Novice Trial.

10370000056._kDes: Keeping your equipment up to date will be a great help in future battles.

10370000057._kDes: Here, this certificate proves that you passed the Novice Trial. Take it to the Chief Job Advance Mentor in the city, and he'll conduct your Job Advance ceremony.

10370000058._kDes: Best of luck on your journey.

10370000059._kDes: Hey, I'm really curious. Do you give these same tasks to every Novice?

10370000060._kDes: Doesn't that mean you have to Repeat the same lines hundreds of times? Don't you ever get tired of it?

10370000062._kDes: I've got it! You're actually a robot! Or a magical doll!

10370000063._kDes: Hehe... Of course not. Since you're in no hurry, how about letting me study you? Samples of highly intelligent Demon Porings are quite Rare.

10370000064._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}! Your Job Advance is imminent. We must act at once.

10370000065._kDes: Hello, Adventurer. If you wish to undergo your Job Advance, you must first submit your trial certificate.

10370000067._kDes: Hmm, everything is in order. It seems you've built a solid foundation. I'm Alphonse, the Chief Job Advance Mentor. I guide qualified Novices to ^{1}Criatura Academy^{2} for their Job Advance. Are you ready?

10370000069._kDes: Excellent. Clear goals and decisive action are the first qualities of a powerful Adventurer. The teleportation spell is ready. Don't resist its power—it will deliver you safely to your destination.

10370000070._kDes: Head to the main lecture hall. The Mentor is already waiting for you there.

10370000071._kDes: (Lowers voice) Ahem! O lost lamb, meeting this great prophet is the blessing of eight lifetimes!

10370000072._kDes: Come, extend your hand and let this great prophet guide you to your true path!

10370000073._kDes: (Shakes head with feigned solemnity) The worst thing a Novice can do is have no idea what their goal is.

10370000074._kDes: Tell you what—give me @{1} Crystal, and I'll reveal which job suits you!

10370000075._kDes: Darn it! I fell for it!

10370000076._kDes: (Looks down in thought) Hmm, fascinating. I've never heard of a crystal ball shining so brilliantly before.

10370000077._kDes: Just keep moving forward. Alphonse will help you complete your Job Advance.

10370000079._kDes: Thousands of years ago, the continent of Midgard suffered an unprecedented catastrophe.

10370000080._kDes: The Demon King Morroc invaded these lands, while Jormungand, the colossal World Serpent, sought to devour the world.

10370000081._kDes: In that dark hour, the ancestors of the Rune Kingdom's seven royal families rose to the challenge.

10370000082._kDes: They were joined by six exceptional heroes, each representing a different job. Together, they defeated the demons and protected the continent.

10370000083._kDes: I hope you will follow their example and press onward along the path to mastering your job.

10370000084._kDes: The Book of Job Advance ahead records the traits and potential of every job. Young sprout of Midgard, go forth and choose the path that suits you.

10370000085._kDes: Such dazzling light... (Strokes beard) It seems we're about to witness the birth of a new legend. Congratulations on completing your Job Advance, new Adventurer.

10370000086._kDes: After your Job Advance, try ^{1}allocating stat and skill points^{2} to unlock your newfound power.

10370000087._kDes: Perhaps you could test how much you've grown in the ^{1}Tower of Trials^{2}.

10370000088._kDes: For a new Adventurer, the ^{1}【Eden Group】^{2} is an excellent place to go.

10370000089._kDes: You can grow quickly by taking on requests from the Eden Group.

10370000090._kDes: Go take a look. The receptionist will send you there.

10370000092._kDes: Oh, you must be the newcomer Rhine mentioned. You've certainly got courage, but otherwise you look pretty average...

10370000093._kDes: Tell you what—I'll give you a request with a generous reward. Go to ^{1}【Payon】^{2} and help the Elder Lady solve the case of the missing livestock.

10370000094._kDes: Hey, newbie! I'm Tilpy, the best Adventurer advisor around. Every rookie I've coached has become a hero~ Answer three questions with your gut, and I'll reveal your destined job!

10370000095._kDes: Question one. Imagine you're leaving your village to seek adventure. Dawn has just broken, and your pack is on your back. The village is still asleep, except for a few early-rising little Porings chirping away. You stand at the village entrance, where the road leads out into the wider world. What do you do?

10370000099._kDes: Hmm, whether it's the tranquil morning light, joyous laughter, or a heartfelt embrace, each is a beautiful way to say goodbye before setting out.

10370000100._kDes: Question two. After a long journey, you finally reach a forest, where the fog is as thick as Milk. You're completely lost! Then you come upon three paths, each of which looks... well, interesting. Which one will you follow?

10370000103._kDes: The road to the ancient castle

10370000104._kDes: Whether your future takes you through forest paths echoing with Orc roars, along desolate trails, or into the depths of an ancient castle, never forget the burning courage within your heart.

10370000105._kDes: Question three. After facing countless dangers and battling terrifying monsters, you finally emerge victorious! Now a dust-covered treasure chest lies before you, with light shining through its keyhole! You rub your hands together, your heart pounding. What treasure do you hope to find inside?

10370000108._kDes: Water from the Spring of Renewal

10370000109._kDes: At the end of every story, heroes grasp the blades of divine weapons, open the covers of spellbooks, and scoop up the shimmering waters of sacred springs. But never forget what first set you on your journey.

10370000110._kDes: All right, you've completed every test. Please wait while I determine your results...

10370000112._kDes: Ta-da! The Crystal of Fate has revealed your result! Let's see... Oh? Not bad!

10370000113._kDes: The soul of a Swordsman burns within you! A Lion lives in your heart, courage is your blade, and protection is your shield. Go forth—the Prontera Chivalry awaits!

10370000114._kDes: So, how accurate was Erpi's reading? Don't dawdle—go complete your Job Advance! The legend of Midgard is yours to write.

10370000115._kDes: What a warm light... It's the calling of an Acolyte! Your heart is as soft as a Poring, yet your strength surpasses that of an angel. Remember, your hands, which can heal anything, are more precious than any weapon.

10370000116._kDes: Wow! What a mysterious magical glow... Your head must be filled with stars and arcane runes. Those old scholars in Geffen Tower will be fighting over you!

10370000117._kDes: Shh! The shadow of the Thief has chosen you. Your footsteps are lighter than the wind, and your eyes are sharper than a hawk's. The black market of Morroc... Ahem, I mean the whole wide world awaits your talents!

10370000118._kDes: I hear the sound of Zeny... You have the makings of a Merchant! There's an abacus clacking away in your head, isn't there? Remember to give me a discount when you open your shop!

10370000119._kDes: Whoosh! Right on target—the eagle eye of an Archer! You like to keep your Distance, wait for the perfect moment, then strike true. Hey, you might just become the greatest Archer in Payon!

10370000120._kDes: Mm-hmm, just leave it there... Wait, aren't you here to deliver food?

10370000122._kDes: Oh! You're the new recruit from the Eden Group! My eyesight's just like my Lain's—I can't tell people from animals at five meters, and at ten meters, the whole world's one big happy blur. Hahaha!

10370000123._kDes: The gyroscope... Let me think. Its core needs sturdy spacers, and Stag Beetle shells have just the right density. Bring me some ^{1}【Hard Shells】^{2} from Stag Beetles.

10370000124._kDes: I'll also need a barrel of ^{1}【High-Quality Sticky Mucus】^{2} from Willows to use as damping fluid. The last time I went looking for some, I mistook a regular tree for a Willow and spent half an hour talking to it...

10370000125._kDes: Finally, I'll need ^{1}【Eddga's Mane】^{2} for the balancing bristles. That big cat has been prowling around the bamboo forest lately, terrifying the villagers... and making so much noise I can't focus on my experiments! Go bring me some of its mane—and quiet it down while you're at it.

10370000126._kDes: That big cat isn't easy to find. Ask the old Hunter in the forest if he knows its exact location.

10370000127._kDes: I'm here to collect the mount.

10370000129._kDes: You're a new face. This forest's been dangerous lately, so don't wander around without good reason.

10370000132._kDes: Oh? That old lady with the poor eyesight? This is about the airship, isn't it? Eddga's mane... Yes, that certainly sounds like something she'd need.

10370000133._kDes: That beast is clever and always on the move. It won't just sit in one place waiting for you to find it.

10370000134._kDes: Here, take this. It's called a ^{1}【Fly Wing】^{2}. Crush one, and it'll teleport you a random Distance through this bamboo forest.

10370000135._kDes: It's a common trick among Adventurers. You rely on luck to cross paths with it. Whether you find it is up to chance.

10370000136._kDes: Is this... really going to work?

10370000137._kDes: Thanks. I'll give it a try.

10370000138._kDes: It beats wandering aimlessly through the forest like a headless fly. Back in our day, this was how we tracked down elusive monsters like that.

10370000139._kDes: Good luck. Remember, if you encounter Eddga, approach it carefully. That beast is ferocious.

10370000140._kDes: You're back. How did it go?

10370000142._kDes: Oh? That was fast. Hmm... The materials all meet my standards. Excellent! You're far more capable than that silly boy of mine who does nothing but read.

10370000143._kDes: Speaking of Lain... That boy's a hopeless bookworm. He can't think about anything but his research. If the royal family hadn't personally commissioned the Eden Group to find him, I'd be afraid he'd get himself lost in the desert...

10370000144._kDes: Haha, don't worry! Our leader is handling this personally, and with such a capable new recruit helping us, we'll bring Professor Lain back safe and sound. He's essential to the research on the 【Nail of World Law】. We'll protect him with our lives!

10370000145._kDes: All right, rookie. Excellent work on the mission. The airship is ready, so it's time to meet up with the others. Your true adventure is about to begin!

10370000146._kDes: Boya, wait here for a moment. I'll give you the repaired gyroscope. ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, this Card is for you. It should be very helpful on your adventures ahead.

10370000147._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, go learn all about Cards first. They're essential for every Adventurer. I'll meet you at the village entrance later.

10370000148._kDes: Go find the black market merchant at the tavern.

10370000149._kDes: All right, I'm on my way.

10370000150._kDes: I'm the proprietor NPC. I don't know where the black market merchant is, either.

10370000151._kDes: All right, I'll ask someone else.

10370000152._kDes: I'm the veteran Adventurer NPC. I don't know where the black market merchant is, either.

10370000154._kDes: The threads of your fate... are entwined with some very intriguing possibilities. There is a certain... “special” energy emanating from you.

10370000158._kDes: Time... is a one-way road for your kind. But every so often, ripples appear.

10370000159._kDes: This old compass is yours. It will warn you before disaster strikes.

10370000160._kDes: When a great crisis approaches, it will guide you. Use it wisely...

10370000161._kDes: Who were you just talking to? There's no one here.

10370000162._kDes: Could you be under some kind of illusion? Maybe there's a fox spirit or something lurking near Payon...

10370000163._kDes: Whoa! Could it be a ghost?! So scary, so scary~

10370000164._kDes: Master~ Have you been secretly dating an invisible girl?

10370000166._kDes: Anyway, we need to get moving. The Eden Group Captain is still waiting at the ^{1}Airship Port in Izlude^{2}. If we take any longer, she's going to be furious.

10370000167._kDes: Black Market Merchant, I'll come by later to buy a ticket.

10370000168._kDes: All right, I'll be there soon.

10370000169._kDes: Would you like to buy a ticket?

10370000171._kDes: You already have a ticket? Then I'll teleport you there.

10370000173._kDes: Captain! We got the gyroscope, and ^{1}PlayerName^{2} did a great job!

10370000174._kDes: Excellent work. Rookie, welcome to the operation. This is Instructor Wulf. Relax—from now on, we'll Fight Alongside each other.

10370000175._kDes: Hello, rookie. The supplies have been inventoried. We can board whenever you're ready.

10370000176._kDes: Time is short, so I'll be brief. Our mission is to travel to the ^{1}Sograt Desert^{2} and find the missing Professor Ryan.

10370000177._kDes: This is a covert mission. The professor's research is crucial to the kingdom's future, so the fewer people who know about it, the better.

10370000178._kDes: Rhyne and Boya have both reported on your previous performance. You've proven that you're capable and dependable. Welcome to the team.

10370000179._kDes: We'll take the 【White Dove】 cargo airship to Morroc, at the entrance to the desert. If there's anything else you'd like to know, ask me now.

10370000184._kDes: Good eye! The 【White Dove】 belongs to Valkyrie Air, and it symbolizes the cooperation between the Papal State and the Republic. It's officially a cargo ship, but it still has a passenger cabin, making it perfect for a team that needs to keep a low profile.

10370000185._kDes: Its structure has been Enhanced, giving it greater speed and stealth than an ordinary passenger ship. It's also equipped with basic defensive cannons.

10370000186._kDes: Wulf knows this ship inside and out. Don't worry—he's a dependable old friend.

10370000188._kDes: He's one of the kingdom's foremost scholars and studied abroad in Juno. He specializes in ancient magic technology and is... a somewhat absentminded genius. He's the key to unraveling the mystery of the 【Nail of World Law】.

10370000189._kDes: His safety is our highest priority.

10370000190._kDes: Exactly. That's why we have to find him.

10370000191._kDes: This commission comes directly from the royal family. That means it's a high-level mission, and it also means... the potential danger may be beyond anything we can imagine.

10370000192._kDes: So don't worry. Just follow my lead. I'll bring every one of you back safely. I always Keep my word.

10370000193._kDes: All right, no more questions, then. Keep your ticket handy, rookie. Prepare to board—next stop, Morroc!

10370000194._kDes: Good afternoon. Please present your boarding pass and confirm that your carry-on luggage is not overweight.

10370000195._kDes: Pass confirmed. The White Dove has been cleared for departure, and its engines are warmed up. We expect to depart in three minutes.

10370000196._kDes: Are you ready to board now?

10370000199._kDes: Have a pleasant journey. May the winds grant you clear passage.

10370000200._kDes: We're off, we're off! Up into the clouds!

10370000201._kDes: All right. Please board before the departure horn sounds. We will not wait for late passengers.

10370000202._kDes: Huh? Is something still not ready? Bobo can't wait any longer, bo!

10370000203._kDes: Well, rookie? This is your first time seeing the view from an airship, isn't it?

10370000204._kDes: Ready to go? Just don't throw up on the ship.

10370000207._kDes: You have another @{1} minutes. Don't dawdle.

10370000208._kDes: Then... let's be off. White Dove, launch!

10370000209._kDes: Finally awake, huh? You were really out cold.

10370000210._kDes: Hahaha! Welcome back to the land of the living! After that crash, I thought you'd be getting up close and personal with the sand for three days and three nights!

10370000211._kDes: Wah... Stupid Master! You scared Bobo half to death! Bobo thought the crash had broken your head!

10370000212._kDes: All right, everyone's here. Looks like the White Dove is a total loss, and there's no point going to Morroc now.

10370000213._kDes: According to Wulf, our landing site is actually closer to our destination, the ^{1}【Adventurer Camp】^{2}. Let's rest briefly, then move out.

10370000214._kDes: To help you survive the battles ahead, I have some spare materials you can use to repair your weapon.

10370000215._kDes: Go ahead, Master! Bobo thinks it'll become super—powerful, bo~

10370000216._kDes: Oh? Eikuni, long time no see! Are you here in the desert to Complete the Commission?

10370000217._kDes: Hahaha, of course I'm here for work. It's been a while, Hawke. How have you been?

10370000218._kDes: Same as always. Ant breeding season is almost here, and there have been frequent Adventurer disappearances lately. It's a real headache... But enough about that. You must have something more important to discuss, right?

10370000219._kDes: Yes. I'm looking for someone. Have you seen a scholar named Levin recently? He wears glasses, has very poor eyesight, and is quite refined.

10370000220._kDes: Levin, glasses, poor eyesight... Is he from Payon? And didn't he study in Juno?

10370000221._kDes: Yes, that's him! Do you know where he went?

10370000222._kDes: He's been staying at the camp for the past week, leaving early and returning late every day. Oh! I even said hello to him before he left this morning. He took his equipment to ^{1}【Ant Hell】^{2} again at the crack of dawn, saying he was going to collect some kind of 【Memory Particles】. He's incredibly stubborn. I tried to convince him to take someone with him, but he wouldn't listen.

10370000223._kDes: That's a relief. At least he's safe. But Ant Hell is dangerous. We need to find him and make sure nothing happens.

10370000224._kDes: I'll leave finding the professor to you for now. I need to report the White Dove disaster to headquarters first. As soon as that's taken care of, I'll meet up with you.

10370000225._kDes: Master, looks like it's up to the two of us this time!

10370000229._kDes: Huh? Where did this... giant talking Chonchon come from? Or is it a living ball of soot?

10370000230._kDes: You're the Chonchon! Your whole family's made of soot! Bobo is a noble Demon Poring! Get a good look, bo!

10370000231._kDes: Uh... Adventurer? Thank You for helping me, but may I ask who you are...?

10370000233._kDes: Go back? But my research is at a critical stage, and the energy readings here are unprecedented! If I stop now, all my work could be for nothing.

10370000234._kDes: Insist on Taking the Professor Back

10370000235._kDes: ...Fine, fine. Since you insist, I'll go back with you. But give me a little more time to finish one last sample.

10370000236._kDes: Actually, before that, could you do me a favor? Look over there, in the corner...

10370000237._kDes: That ^{1}【poor girl】^{2} hasn't moved at all. Could she be injured? Oh, it's chilly in this cave. Do you have any spare clothes? Please help her.

10370000238._kDes: Master, that lady looks a little strange... But maybe the professor got it right this time? There really is someone over there!

10370000240._kDes: Why is it just the two of you? Where are the captain and the others? ...You didn't find Professor Levin?

10370000242._kDes: I knew it! The Adventurers who've disappeared in the desert over the past few months weren't lost or taken by bandits... They've probably all become the queen ant's emergency food supply!

10370000243._kDes: There may be one enormous ant colony beneath this entire desert. What we discovered before was only the tip of the iceberg.

10370000244._kDes: Wh-Whoa... M-M-Master! Doesn't that mean we're standing on the lid of one giant cooking pot?!

10370000245._kDes: Aquinnie and the others haven't returned yet, and there's no one at the camp to spare for a rescue mission.

10370000246._kDes: This ^{1}【Pathfinder Ant】^{2} is a Piere we captured. It's instinctively drawn to the queen ant's pheromones. Release it inside Ant Hell, and it'll lead you to the entrance of the queen's nest.

10370000247._kDes: But I recommend waiting for the captain to return before taking action. The situation down there is far worse than we imagined. Going in alone would be suicide.

10370000248._kDes: Professor Meat Is Sour, So Ants Won't Eat It

10370000250._kDes: It's Extremely Risky, but There's No Other Choice

10370000251._kDes: Silly Master... Are ants vegetarians? And how do you know the professor tastes too sour to eat?! What kind of reason is that?!

10370000252._kDes: This rescue mission will be exceptionally difficult. If you're determined to go, consider bringing a pet into battle. It could be a great help.

10370000253._kDes: Master, do you have another little pet when I'm not around? Boo-hoo... Bobo's being abandoned...

10370000254._kDes: Ahem. Bobo, was it? There's a big difference between combat pets and companion pets. Don't worry. A companion pet with as much personality as you could never be replaced.

10370000256._kDes: That Depends on How You Do

10370000257._kDes: Hmph! By the time reinforcements arrive, the professor will already have become... become you-know-what! You're not usually this scared, Master.

10370000258._kDes: Don't worry! When the time comes, you can hide behind Bobo, Master!

10370000259._kDes: Sniff... You're right, Master. The professor can't wait that long! Bobo... Bobo will protect you, bo!

10370000260._kDes: I knew you were the best, Master!

10370000263._kDes: There you are! Are you both okay?

10370000264._kDes: Oh, you know. We only nearly got eaten by the queen ant.

10370000265._kDes: Next time something like this happens, don't go off on your own. You must wait for us to return. Come on, let's head back to camp.

10370000266._kDes: Oh, you're here... Thank You for rescuing me. You were a tremendous help.

10370000267._kDes: I actually came here to extract this—^{1}【Memory Form】^{2} . You can think of it as energy formed from intense human emotions and memories.

10370000268._kDes: I've spent several months investigating the area around the desert. I managed to Discover that the queen ant's mimicry actually came from a girl she devoured, so I came here to search for a Clue...

10370000269._kDes: I finally managed to find some samples, but then... uh, I nearly got eaten.

10370000270._kDes: But I got it in the end! Look—(Raises bottle)

10370000272._kDes: You're awake. It brought you back here after all... somewhat sooner than I expected.

10370000273._kDes: Welcome to the ^{1}【Garden of Time】^{2}—the crossroads of countless possibilities and the final resting place of every unfinished story.

10370000274._kDes: The compass in your hand can do far more than foresee danger.

10370000275._kDes: And what you just experienced was but one insignificant note in a grand symphony.

10370000276._kDes: Curious about this place? Feel free to look around. I'll be waiting up ahead.

10370000277._kDes: You've arrived. Are you... satisfied with the view?

10370000278._kDes: Those drifting visions are worlds that once truly existed—some have already withered away, while others continue to Struggle.

10370000279._kDes: And you will be among those who decide their fate.

10370000280._kDes: Wow! It's so beautiful here! Much comfier than Master's Backpack~

10370000281._kDes: But... why does this place feel kind of familiar?

10370000283._kDes: What happened just now? You suddenly froze up and even broke the thoughtform storage vial!

10370000284._kDes: Did the desert heat give you heatstroke? You look awful.

10370000285._kDes: It's okay! Master just got scared by some ants earlier, that's all~ Right?

10370000286._kDes: Never mind. Good thing I have a backup. Let's head back to Prontera for now.

10370000287._kDes: Let's go. The airship wreckage recovery team should have arrived by now.

10370000288._kDes: Not bad, youngster. Thanks to you, the mission to protect the Professor went perfectly.

10370000289._kDes: The Professor really trusts you now. The latest request specifically names you for the job!

10370000292._kDes: You're here! A caravan was attacked by ^{1}【Baphomet】^{2} the day before yesterday! That beast is now holed up in the nearby forest.

10370000293._kDes: The worst part is, that cargo contained parts I ordered from Juno... Without them, I can't even start this device.

10370000294._kDes: Damn it! The Church won't let us near the stone pillar, but they'll let monsters steal our cargo?

10370000295._kDes: You're my only hope, my adventuring buddy~ Don't worry! The pay is great.

10370000296._kDes: You're here on the Professor's behalf, right?

10370000297._kDes: I'm so sorry. The Professor paid us so much, and we still let the cargo get stolen...

10370000298._kDes: Damn you, Baphomet! You'll pay for this!

10370000299._kDes: Did you find the missing items?

10370000301._kDes: Great! We've recovered most of our cargo too, though quite a few pieces of valuable porcelain were broken...

10370000302._kDes: (Strokes chin) Looks like I'll have to sell Baphomet skewers to recoup my losses.

10370000304._kDes: Oh? You actually collected everything. I'm impressed. Let me process the materials first.

10370000305._kDes: You didn't expect that? So you really didn't consider our safety at all!

10370000307._kDes: All right, it's done. Just place this into ^{1}【the device next to me】^{2}.

10370000308._kDes: Be careful not to touch it with your fingers. It doesn't look very clean.

10370000309._kDes: Oh, come on! I purified them. They're nothing like they were before.

10370000310._kDes: Once that's done, take the device to the stone pillar and attach the wire to ^{1}【the stone pillar】^{2}.

10370000313._kDes: Can I help you? Unauthorized personnel are not allowed near this area.

10370000315._kDes: I'm here on the Professor's behalf.

10370000316._kDes: So it's him. I can't believe the Queen is letting someone from Juno handle this.

10370000317._kDes: From Juno? Isn't he from Payon?

10370000318._kDes: He studied in Juno for over a decade. He might as well be a foreigner...

10370000321._kDes: We meet again, Adventurer from afar. It seems the 【Nail of Cosmic Law】 has taken quite a liking to you.

10370000322._kDes: They should have remained asleep, yet your touch awakened them... What a fascinating twist of fate.

10370000323._kDes: I have traveled through many worlds, but this is the first time I've met someone like you who can awaken a 【Nail】.

10370000324._kDes: Rest assured, I am here to help you. I have been searching for you in this world for a very, very long time.

10370000325._kDes: Come see me again... tomorrow. Perhaps it's time you learned more.

10370000326._kDes: My name is Bragis Skjald. I am a bard.

10370000327._kDes: What I must tell you is that this space-time is on the brink of catastrophe. You are the chosen one, and only you can resolve this crisis.

10370000328._kDes: My explanation may sound clichéd, but the Nail of Cosmic Law reacted to you just now. That is proof.

10370000329._kDes: Please take this necklace. Think of it as a protective charm. It will keep you safe on the journey ahead.

10370000331._kDes: Hello. This area is very dangerous right now, so civilians aren't allowed inside.

10370000332._kDes: I'm here to investigate the Relic.

10370000333._kDes: The Relic lies deep within the forest. Ever since it suddenly appeared, the monsters nearby have been restless. Are you sure you can handle it?

10370000334._kDes: We're here to investigate the Relic! Don't worry about our safety.

10370000335._kDes: All right. You seem like a rather capable Adventurer. Could I ask you a favor?

10370000336._kDes: My colleagues are probably locked in a fierce battle with the monsters in the forest... If you encounter them, could you please help them?

10370000339._kDes: Ugh, hah, ha! I'm... fine. I can still... keep... going!

10370000341._kDes: Go on ahead... to the glowing... place... and help out...

10370000342._kDes: He doesn't look fine at all... Oh well, let's go see what's up ahead.

10370000344._kDes: Those people from the Holy See are such a pain. They insist this thing is Odin's Relic and won't let me anywhere near it.

10370000345._kDes: Religion really can turn people into stubborn fools. But now that you're here, how about you distract them while I sneak over and investigate?

10370000346._kDes: We meet again. Ah, I just couldn't resist stepping in.

10370000347._kDes: Next, I'll show you the truth... Whether you can accept it is up to you.

10370000348._kDes: I'll be waiting up ahead. Follow me when you're ready.

10370000349._kDes: The world you see is but one of countless leaves on the World Tree.

10370000350._kDes: After Ragnarök, its branches gradually began to decay... and countless timelines are withering away.

10370000351._kDes: Then we found the three 【Keys】 left behind by the gods—the Realm Sandbox, the Nail of Cosmic Law, and your compass.

10370000352._kDes: The Realm Sandbox selects heroes, while the Nail of Cosmic Law stabilizes spacetime... And your compass can gather echoes of souls to restore life to the World Tree.

10370000353._kDes: But you are the most extraordinary of all—an 【Adventurer】 from a higher dimension.

10370000354._kDes: Only your touch can awaken these dormant 【Keys】.

10370000355._kDes: None of this is mere coincidence.

10370000356._kDes: When the true crisis arrives... we will meet again.

10370000357._kDes: You're finally awake! That was far too close. If you hadn't stepped in when you did, many more people could have been hurt.

10370000358._kDes: While you were unconscious, the Holy See took the Relic away. It's being kept at the Prontera Library for now. If you're interested, you can go see it later.

10370000359._kDes: After everything you've been through, you need a good rest. I'm a member of the ^{1}【Oak Inn】^{2} in the capital. Give them my name, and they'll arrange their finest room for you.

10370000360._kDes: Come on. Let's head back to Prontera.

10370000361._kDes: Welcome to the Oak Inn! Do you have a reservation?

10370000363._kDes: Ah! You must be Professor Levin's honored guest! He asked us to prepare a quiet room by the window on the second floor. The professor said you needed a good rest.

10370000364._kDes: Here is your key. Dinner will be delivered to your room in one hour. If you'd like hot Milk or herbal tea, just ring the bell.

10370000366._kDes: Kiddo, what brings you all alone to a remote place like Payon Village?

10370000367._kDes: All right, it's easy to get lost in the forest. Take this Flying mount—it'll help you cross the forest in no time!
