10370000370._kDes: I'm Allen. I'm new here... I heard you often go on quests with the Eden Group. You know Instructor Boya pretty well, right?

10370000371._kDes: I-I'd like to learn more about her. Like what she likes and what she doesn't...

10370000372._kDes: Actually... when she helped me fight ants last time, I thought she was incredible. She unleashed this huge Magnum Break in a flash!

10370000373._kDes: (Suddenly blushes) E-Even though it singed off a lock of my hair...

10370000374._kDes: I joined the Eden Group afterward because I hoped I'd get to see her more often...

10370000375._kDes: I want to give Instructor Boya a gift to thank her for helping me train. But she's often away on assignments, so I hardly ever see her, much less get to know her...

10370000378._kDes: If you want the girl, court her yourself.

10370000379._kDes: Um... I want to give her something she'll like. Do you know what would make a good gift?

10370000381._kDes: I heard Luna from the Knight Order is a good friend of Instructor Boya's, and Mentor Alphonse knows her well too. Could you ask them for me?

10370000383._kDes: I-I tried... But whenever I think about how close they are to the instructor and how they might mention me to her, I just can't bring myself to ask...

10370000384._kDes: Please help me! I'll reward you!

10370000385._kDes: I-It's only a thank-you gift! I'm definitely not trying to confess my feelings! Do you know what she likes best?

10370000386._kDes: Looking for me? What is it?

10370000387._kDes: Oh~ You want to know about Boya? (Leans in for a closer look) Are you asking for yourself, or for someone else?

10370000388._kDes: I'll tell you, but on one condition—you'll be my partner for the opening dance at the royal banquet later.

10370000389._kDes: If you dance poorly and step on my feet... (Wags a finger) then I won't say a word about what Marika likes or dislikes.

10370000390._kDes: Perfect timing! The music just started. (Extends a hand invitingly) Come on. You promised me the opening dance.

10370000392._kDes: Oh, it's you. Would you like to review the second-job class paths?

10370000393._kDes: Boya? (Strokes beard) Haha! It seems that young lady is quite popular.

10370000394._kDes: When she passed her knight exam, I gave her a set of refined-steel gauntlets. She complained that they slowed down her sword arm, then had Hollgrehenn Reforge one into a thumb ring.

10370000395._kDes: I heard a young mage gave her a glowing quill last year. She casually traded it to a merchant with a Stall for a quiver.

10370000396._kDes: (Shakes his head with a laugh) That young lady has always been blunt. If she doesn't like your gift, she won't spare your feelings.

10370000398._kDes: Haha! She disliked every gift I gave her, and you still dare ask my opinion?

10370000399._kDes: (Strokes chin) When she came to the academy to turn in a commission a few days ago, she mentioned that a monster had damaged her Helmet. A new Helmet should be a safe choice.

10370000400._kDes: You're back! So... did you find anything out?

10370000402._kDes: (Blushes to the tips of his ears) L-L-Long ears?! Instructor Boya likes little bunnies? That's so adorable... If I dressed as a bunny for patrol, would she notice me?

10370000405._kDes: You're right. Let's decide what gift to give her first.

10370000406._kDes: (Looks down and wrings his hands) That would still be a little embarrassing. Let's decide what gift to give her first.

10370000407._kDes: B-Bunny ears? A hair band you wear on your head?! (Frantically tugs on the player's sleeve) Did you hear that? It must be a revelation from Odin!

10370000408._kDes: Let's go find the headgear merchant too!

10370000409._kDes: Welcome~ Oh, a new face! Looking for a gift for your girlfriend?

10370000410._kDes: The merchant brings out a Bunny Hair Band, a School Hat, and Antlers.

10370000411._kDes: Which one do you like? (Picks up the Bunny Hair Band) This one's really popular lately, especially with girls~

10370000412._kDes: (Quietly) She's not my girlfriend... I'll take the Bunny Hair Band. How much is it?

10370000413._kDes: (Raises a finger) It's not for sale~ Just gather these materials for me: @{1} Fluffs, @{2} four-leaf Lucky Clovers, @{3} Pearls, and... (Lowers voice) the Cat Ear Hair Band my rival sells!

10370000415._kDes: (Puts hands on hips) Young man! True love must be put to the test!

10370000416._kDes: Gathering Fluffs seems easiest. No talking, no Connect, just keep my head down and swing my sword... (Counts on fingers) Defeating about @{1} Fabres should be enough.

10370000417._kDes: (Eyes sparkling) Could you gather the other materials? (Presses a coin pouch into the player's hands) These are all my savings. You can keep whatever's left!

10370000419._kDes: Let's split up and meet back here once we've gathered everything!

10370000420._kDes: Are you done gathering your materials too? Let's go trade them to the merchant.

10370000421._kDes: You're done already? You must've worked hard. Here, the Bunny Hair Band is all wrapped up. Good luck confessing your feelings!

10370000423._kDes: (Holds the Bunny Hair Band overhead with both hands and bows deeply) Instructor Boya! Thank You for helping me fight those ants in Ant Hell... Please accept this Bunny Hair Band!

10370000424._kDes: Ant Hell? (Suddenly slaps thigh and bursts out laughing) Oh, that time! I was testing whether my new fire oil could roast a whole rabbit head in one go. Think I singed someone's hair too. Was that you?

10370000426._kDes: Yeah, spicy rabbit head. It's pretty good. Once you've learned Magnum Break, I'll teach you how to roast one. (Hooks the hair band with the sword's scabbard and inspects it) This thing... (Suddenly shoves it into your hands) You take it!

10370000427._kDes: (Ruffles Allen's hair) Enough with this nonsense. Get back to training!

10370000428._kDes: (Grins foolishly) Instructor touched my head... and is going to teach me how to roast rabbit heads. Hehe...

10370000431._kDes: Please, keep it. I-I'm already so happy! Thank You for helping me with so much. If you don't mind, consider it your reward!

10370000433._kDes: Hey, friend! Settle this for us! These old folks were obviously hired to hold these spots!

10370000434._kDes: They've been sitting at the most efficient monster-farming spots since early this morning, and they only move aside for certain people. There must be some kind of Trade going on behind the scenes.

10370000435._kDes: We reported them to the guards, but they said this is a public area and they can't stop people from waiting in line.

10370000438._kDes: Win them over one by one

10370000439._kDes: That's way too unfair. No, we have to think of something. We can't let them keep pushing everyone around.

10370000440._kDes: No, we can't do that! If they get hurt, we'll never be able to afford their medical bills.

10370000441._kDes: Breaking them up from within is a good idea! Let's ask why these old folks are willing to work for those scalpers, then get them on our side.

10370000442._kDes: Let's split up. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} and I will deal with the hardest one to persuade, while Kiki talks to the others.

10370000443._kDes: Let's break them up from within instead! We'll ask why these old folks are willing to work for those scalpers, then get them on our side.

10370000444._kDes: That could work. Let's split up. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} and I will deal with the hardest one to persuade, while Kiki talks to the others.

10370000445._kDes: (Steps forward and forces a smile) Grandma Gwen, we're back. We'd like to talk things over with you again...

10370000446._kDes: (Scowls) There's nothing to discuss! There's plenty of room here. This old woman just likes sitting in the sun and knitting. That's not against the law, is it?

10370000448._kDes: (Her expression softens slightly, and she instinctively strokes the sweater) ...Hmph. At least you've got a good eye. My grandson will wear this to school, so of course it has to look nice.

10370000449._kDes: We don't mean anything by it. You just look like you haven't been sleeping well. You have dark circles under your eyes, and your hands are shaking while you knit. Is something wrong? Maybe we can help.

10370000450._kDes: Help? What could you possibly do? A gang of bandits moved into my attic, and they haven't let me sleep for days.

10370000452._kDes: (Irritably) Don't bother! It's a bunch of Vocals! For some crazy reason, they've been holding concerts in my attic at midnight. All that clanging and banging is about to bring down the roof!

10370000453._kDes: That's easy enough. We'll take care of it!

10370000454._kDes: Jack says he knows a pest-control expert who can drive away the Rockers. What can you do?

10370000455._kDes: Jack's the one who hired you, isn't he? Don't worry, I already have a plan! Rockers love Whispering Flowers. We can use them to lure the Rockers out into the wild!

10370000456._kDes: You're a quick thinker, young man. All right, I'll trust you this once.

10370000457._kDes: Don't worry, we've got this! We'll go pick the flowers right now!

10370000458._kDes: Finished already? Young folks sure are quick on their feet. Come on, I'll take you to my house.

10370000459._kDes: This is my house. See if you can lure them into the woods to the south.

10370000460._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, You place the Whispering Flower. I'll build them a little stage at the destination. Once we lure them out, they'll need somewhere to settle down.

10370000461._kDes: Everything's just about ready. Now let's see if the Rockers take the bait.

10370000462._kDes: Well, I'll be... Those little rascals really came! Look how happily they're bouncing around!

10370000463._kDes: Now these old bones can finally get a good night's sleep! You're good kids. You're a hundred times more capable than that braggart Jack!

10370000464._kDes: I'll talk to my old friends too and tell them to stop helping Jack bully decent folks!

10370000465._kDes: As soon as you and Lemon approach, old Bob straightens his back and pretends to be diligently holding the spot.

10370000466._kDes: (Helplessly) Grandpa, why put yourself through this?

10370000467._kDes: (Stares at the ground, guilty but defiant) Enough! This old man... I just like standing here and breathing the fresh air! What, do you own this place?

10370000468._kDes: (Suddenly notices something) Grandpa, why are your pant legs all torn up? It looks like something's been biting them.

10370000469._kDes: You bet! It's a pack of those blasted white rats! Snow-white fur, bright red eyes—they look downright fancy, but act like a bunch of bandits!

10370000470._kDes: I don't know why, but they've made themselves at home in my yard and wreak havoc every day. Forget the pants—they've even gnawed a hole through the base of the wall!

10370000471._kDes: That kid—oh, Jack—said he could get the best mousetraps in town... as long as I keep sitting here for him for a few more days...

10370000472._kDes: Mousetraps? Those are so old-fashioned! Take us to the fields, and we'll take care of it right away!

10370000473._kDes: If you... if you really have a plan, old Bob here will get up and go right now! Sitting in this dump is killing my back!

10370000474._kDes: You got it, you got it! Let's go!

10370000475._kDes: This is the place. Look, they're still poking their heads out! They've got some nerve!

10370000477._kDes: (Tears streaming down his face) Incredible! Simply incredible! That Jack is all talk—he's been pulling the wool over my eyes! You two are the ones who actually get things done!

10370000478._kDes: Don't worry. I won't let Jack rope me into any more of his nonsense. I'll tell my old friends not to go, either.

10370000479._kDes: Hahaha! I may be getting on in years, but I'm an elder here. My word still carries some weight.

10370000480._kDes: Great! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, it looks like our plan to Win them over one by one is Active. Let's go tell everyone the good news!

10370000481._kDes: J-Just you wait! You have no idea who you're messing with! I've got powerful friends!

10370000482._kDes: Oh? You mean Elder Bob? We've already "bought him off"!

10370000483._kDes: What?! You got me! But this isn't over! You can have this turf—I'll find somewhere else!

10370000484._kDes: (Shouting) Everyone heard that, right? Step up patrols for the time being. Don't give this guy a chance to cause trouble!

10370000485._kDes: Understood. I'll send out patrols to drive off any troublemakers who threaten the village's peace.

10370000486._kDes: Your timing is perfect. Jack just got a sound thrashing from ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

10370000487._kDes: (His face turns purple) Y-you... Remember this!

10370000488._kDes: You came at just the right time! I've got a fresh batch of treasures, still hot off the forge!

10370000489._kDes: Take a gander at this 【Iron-Slicing Sword】! Look at that grain! Hear that ring!

10370000490._kDes: (Flicks the blade with a finger, making it ring with a crisp hum) Forged from fine southern steel and personally quenched by the apprentice of a distant cousin of a dwarven Moonlit Challenger! One swing turns a Poring into sashimi and a Dummy into a toothpick!

10370000491._kDes: I like you, so I'll give you an honest price! I'd charge anyone else @{1} Copper Coins for this sword, but if you're serious, it's yours for @{2}!

10370000492._kDes: What do you say, Adventurer? This is a rare opportunity—how about buying one?

10370000496._kDes: Ahem... well... great teachers produce great students! This craftsmanship was passed down by a true master! Just look at the workmanship, the attention to detail—it's absolutely Moonlit Challenger caliber!

10370000497._kDes: (Clutches chest) You drive a harder bargain than this sword's edge! That wouldn't even cover the cost!

10370000498._kDes: Ah, brave adventurer! A moment, please! I couldn't help but notice your keen eye as you surveyed the market—and the tremendous potential within you! Those are not the eyes of someone destined for mediocrity!

10370000499._kDes: Look at these plodding masses! They're content with an ordinary steel sword and a cheap potion! But not you! I can tell by your stride that you yearn to rise above the ordinary!

10370000500._kDes: Tell me, have you ever gazed up at the stars and wondered how you could finally live up to your gifts and truly... live?

10370000501._kDes: (Leans in slightly and lowers their voice) The Adventurers' Guild is looking for exceptional people just like you! We're not offering you a mere job, but the ultimate opportunity to rewrite your destiny and rise to the top!

10370000502._kDes: Don't just take my word for it—please accept this invitation. We're hosting an exclusive welcome gala at the most luxurious venue in town, the 【Oak Tavern】! There'll be endless gourmet food and fine wine, not to mention countless elite Members who've already achieved the life of their dreams!

10370000503._kDes: Give me one evening, and I'll prove that everything you've worked for has merely been preparing you to join us! What do you say? Will you give yourself a chance to reach out and touch the future?

10370000506._kDes: Now that's character! I admire your candor! But believe me, a promise from Jax carries more weight than adamantine! Come see for yourself, and you'll know I speak the truth!

10370000507._kDes: (Overjoyed) Wise! Incomparably wise! Come with me—our future begins with this dinner!

10370000508._kDes: (Wiping away tears) Ever since my husband joined his guild, he hardly ever comes home. The last time I saw him was three months ago...

10370000509._kDes: The last time my son came home to get some clothes, his eyes were bloodshot, and he could barely stay awake on his feet! He called it “voluntary extra training,” but I say he’s been brainwashed!

10370000510._kDes: Dear families! Please understand! This is all for a happier future! They're all willingly striving for their dreams! This brief separation will lead to a joyous reunion!

10370000511._kDes: Come with me, everyone! Once you see them hard at work, you'll understand just how happy they are!

10370000512._kDes: John, the last time you came home was three months ago. You ate, said you'd wash the dishes later, then rushed off for an “emergency assembly.” I've been waiting for you to wash them ever since.

10370000513._kDes: Ah! Now I remember! Don't worry, honey. Once we defeat the Giant Kun, we can use His Majesty's reward to buy a set of solid-gold dinnerware!

10370000514._kDes: Oh? Should I learn a “turn stone into gold” spell first, so the two of us don't starve into statues before those solid-gold plates ever show up?

10370000515._kDes: (Staring blankly) Last night, I dreamed I was fighting monsters... I was even more efficient than during the day... If only it were real.

10370000516._kDes: Come on, child. Let's go home. You need a good night's sleep.

10370000517._kDes: I thought I saw my mother. She should be in the Mjolnir Mountains. I must be dreaming again...

10370000518._kDes: New here? I've got a 【Hardcore Grinder's Secret Elixir】 that'll keep you sharp and alert, even if it burns through your Life. It works like a charm—I use it myself! You look like a good sort, so I'll charge you just 8 tenths of the regular price!

10370000519._kDes: (Hands on hips) Burning through your Life? I keep you well-fed and comfortable, and you're here burning through your Life?

10370000520._kDes: H-Honey, it's just a figure of speech! It's all to make money, to make money...

10370000521._kDes: Well? Aren't our Members fired up? Now make your choice! Will you join us and build the future together? Or... settle for mediocrity among those who cannot comprehend our lofty ideals?

10370000524._kDes: Heh, to each their own. What a shame. Please accept this small gift as a Thank You for your help earlier. May life always be so... “easy” for you.

10370000525._kDes: Excellent—a wise choice! Welcome to the Fighters' Guild. Here's your signing bonus!

10370000526._kDes: Hello! What can I get for you?

10370000528._kDes: All set—I've packed it up for you. Thanks for your business!

10370000529._kDes: Ah, a sandwich! Thank you so much! I can't get delivery out here, and I'm practically starving.

10370000530._kDes: I called you all the way out here to show you this! My masterpiece—the 【Pseudogyne Pheromone】! One spritz, and the Giant Ants will treat you like their queen!

10370000531._kDes: Well, well. Looks like someone's already forgotten the time the ants carried you off like a takeout order??

10370000532._kDes: C-Captain! That was valuable field data, and this time, I have a flawless product of science. Emotions lead to mistakes, but science never does.

10370000533._kDes: All right, great scientist. Should I send a team of Adventurers with you so you don't get carried off again?

10370000534._kDes: N-No need to trouble yourself. This reliable warrior here is all I need to assist with the test...

10370000535._kDes: Fine. You two stay safe. But Professor, if anything goes wrong again, the Order may have to... temporarily take charge of your personal freedom.

10370000536._kDes: It a-absolutely won't! I'm confident there won't be any problems this time.

10370000537._kDes: That's good. Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm leaving this remarkable Professor in your care. Don't let him get too carried away.

10370000538._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, here—take my precious [Pseudo-Queen Pheromone]. Don't drop it! Just sprinkle it on You.

10370000539._kDes: It's a resounding success! It's so docile around you—far beyond my expectations. This proves the bond created by the pheromone is stable and emotionally grounded. I imagine riding it will go smoothly too...

10370000540._kDes: Captain Aikuni, do you see this? Such a gentle temperament! Such a powerful physique! This will be a revolutionary innovation! Giant ants could become stronger, more Excellent mounts than Peco Pecos. And according to my research, their adaptability to difficult terrain is also Excellent.

10370000541._kDes: Professor, the most important quality in a proper mount is reliability. My Peco Peco won't suddenly throw its rider off or... ahem, develop any unnecessary [Romantic Feelings]. Safety first, right?

10370000542._kDes: ...That's prejudice! A conservative attitude toward unknown technology! My giant ant's pheromones have been calibrated, and its stability has been calculated. Your Peco Peco is the one that's... a featherbrain!

10370000543._kDes: Oh? A featherbrain, maybe, but at least it won't turn your research into another rescue mission. So you think your "calculations" can beat the reliability Peco Pecos have proven over thousands of years?

10370000544._kDes: O-Of course! Science is about constantly challenging and surpassing tradition.

10370000545._kDes: Talk is cheap. As it happens, I know an abandoned Peco Peco racetrack. How about a race between your giant ant and my Peco Peco? Let the results speak for themselves. Unless... you're afraid?

10370000546._kDes: You're on! My research will never lose to some bird! PlayerName, let's head to the racetrack.

10370000547._kDes: Hahaha! All right. Let me know when you're ready.

10370000548._kDes: Well? Ready to face my Peco Peco?

10370000550._kDes: Sigh... The specimen is gone, and I didn't even finish recording the valuable field data. But! This incident proves there's one crucial area where my theory can be improved—

10370000551._kDes: Pheromone stability is positively correlated with the host's physiological state. The adrenaline or some other metabolic byproduct produced during the race must have interfered with normal pheromone receptor binding. This wasn't a failure—it eliminated one major false lead!

10370000552._kDes: Professor, are you saying you plan to continue your research? That thing nearly ate all three of us!

10370000553._kDes: Every great innovation comes with risks. Juno's first airship didn't get far on its maiden flight either. I need to adjust the formula's concentration and application method—not abandon the entire field of research.

10370000554._kDes: All right, I get it. Stopping you from doing research is harder than making an ant obey. But Professor, we're setting some ground rules. Before your next experiment, you must submit an "Extremely Detailed Safety Plan" to me.

10370000555._kDes: The caravan was attacked again? By Baphomet? Peace has been hard to come by in that area lately. Professor, did you have more important equipment shipped here?

10370000556._kDes: Wh-What?! W-Where did you say? The Black Forest?! Baphomet?! No, no, no! This is a disaster!

10370000557._kDes: Is it that important? If necessary, we can find a way to get you another one. I have some connections in Juno—

10370000558._kDes: It's not equipment! It's alive! There's something alive in that crate!

10370000560._kDes: Professor, be clear. What do you mean by "alive"? What kind of creature did you ship? Don't tell me you've violated the kingdom's safety regulations again!

10370000561._kDes: It's [Little Bean]! An old classmate of mine in Juno could no longer care for the kitten, so they entrusted [Little Bean] to me. I-If Glenn finds out I lost Little Bean, he'll never speak to me again...

10370000562._kDes: So it's a pet cat. Professor, what were you thinking? Why didn't you transport it by airship?

10370000563._kDes: I heard animals sometimes suffocate in airship cargo holds, so I specifically hired a company that transports animals overland... What do I do? What am I going to do?!

10370000564._kDes: Enough! This is no time to panic. We need to head to the scene immediately and find that cat before Baphomet—or anything else—can hurt it.

10370000565._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, the situation has changed. This is no longer a simple search for cargo. We have to act. Let's leave immediately.

10370000566._kDes: Hello! Are you the reliable Adventurer Captain Aikuni mentioned? It's a pleasure to meet you. You're here about the bounty notice, correct?

10370000567._kDes: To be honest, this case has us stumped. There have been three thefts in the city recently, but the victims and stolen items are completely different. We can barely find anything they have in common.

10370000568._kDes: The first victim was Blacksmith Hollgrehenn. He lost a fine sword. The second was Nita, a young woman who lives on the west side of the city. She lost a piece of jewelry. The third was a Mage from Geffen who reportedly had a very important spellbook stolen.

10370000569._kDes: We didn't uncover much in the way of a Clue during our interviews... You should visit them yourself. You may Discover some detail in their accounts that we overlooked.

10370000570._kDes: Hey! A new face! Are you an Adventurer looking to refine your gear? Then Hollgrehenn's your man! Bring me good materials, and I'll hammer your gear as high as you dare!

10370000572._kDes: Oh, that. Yeah, I lost a fine weapon. A longtime customer left it with me to Enchant. Sigh... I really let them down after they placed their trust in me.

10370000574._kDes: Honestly, I don't remember how it vanished. The shop was packed that day, and I was running all over the place. I left the weapon on that rack, turned away for a moment, and it was gone. Who did it? What did they look like? I don't remember a thing.

10370000576._kDes: Something unusual? Now that you mention it... Heh, there was one thing. Just before closing, a particularly... uh... passionate lady came into the shop. And the way she was dressed... Whew! She was like a blazing flame!

10370000578._kDes: She didn't really do anything. She just watched me smithing for quite a while. Then she came over, leaned in real close, and said I looked so strong and manly while working the forge...

10370000579._kDes: I'd never heard anything like that before! My heart was pounding, and my head got all fuzzy. She complimented me a few times, then left with a smile without buying anything. It still makes me happy just thinking about it! Haha!

10370000580._kDes: But happy as it made me, the weapon is still missing. Sigh... I wish I could be more help. You don't think that beautiful lady took it, do you? She didn't look like a bad person.

10370000581._kDes: Welcome! Would you like a bouquet for someone special? The birds of paradise look especially vibrant today!

10370000582._kDes: Oh, you mean my gold ring... It was the most precious thing my mother left me. I always took such good care of it. I truly don't understand how it could have disappeared.

10370000583._kDes: That day... I was tending the flowers and helping customers, just like always. I kept the ring on my finger, but I never noticed when it disappeared. It was as if it just... vanished without me realizing.

10370000584._kDes: Something unusual? Now that you ask... Yes, there was! I think I had... a fateful encounter!

10370000586._kDes: That evening, just as I was about to close the shop, a gentleman passed by. His clothes were a little worn, and he looked exhausted, but... he was so handsome! He had this melancholy air, like a noble knight fallen on hard times in a story!

10370000587._kDes: He shyly asked if I had anything to eat because he was so hungry he could barely walk. Oh my, can you imagine? It was exactly like something out of a novel!

10370000588._kDes: What do I do after that?

10370000589._kDes: I happened to have a ham sandwich for my dinner, so I gave it to him. He ate it so elegantly, then gave me a solemn Thank You and said my kindness had brightened his dreary day. Just thinking about it makes me so happy!

10370000590._kDes: But... my ring disappeared after that. Maybe I dropped it somewhere by accident? That prince-like gentleman couldn't possibly have taken it, could he? No, of course not!

10370000591._kDes: ...It makes no sense! Absolutely none! The protective barrier wasn't triggered, and the seal on the chest is completely intact. How could the book simply vanish? This violates the third, fifth, and seventh of the Twelve Fundamental Laws of Protective Magic!

10370000592._kDes: Are you the investigator? Thank goodness! Please, you must help me recover the missing book. It's no ordinary spellbook—the knowledge it contains is extremely dangerous. If misused, the consequences could be catastrophic! I must take it back to Geffen Tower and seal it away.

10370000593._kDes: How did the book go missing?

10370000594._kDes: I... I don't know. I checked countless times. It was in my lockbox, and I even confirmed it was there after arriving in Prontera. But before I was ready to leave for Geffen, it vanished. There were no signs of forced entry whatsoever.

10370000595._kDes: Anything unusual? Everything went according to protocol. If I had to name something that disrupted my carefully planned itinerary... Hmm... there was one insignificant little incident.

10370000597._kDes: On my way to the Guild, I spotted a creature in an alley. It was a... uh... Siamese cat. Strictly speaking, these cats are only found in the faraway East. They're extremely rare! Its figure was quite... Ahem! Anyway, it was sunning itself and looked very docile.

10370000599._kDes: I... I looked around and made sure I wasn't violating the Geffen Code of Public Conduct... Then, out of basic concern for a living creature, I crouched down... and patted it on the head.

10370000600._kDes: Its purring... According to current research, it has a soothing effect on the nerves... But that has absolutely nothing to do with the theft! It was merely a brief, perfectly reasonable Interaction.

10370000601._kDes: Right, there couldn't possibly be a connection! Are you accusing an innocent little kitten purring in the sun of being a thief? Absurd! This must be the work of some sophisticated spatial magic yet unknown to us!

10370000602._kDes: Help... Help me... Water... Just one sip... The desert... shows no mercy to the careless...

10370000603._kDes: Hey, my friend! You're back! Judging by the look on your face, do you have good news for me?

10370000605._kDes: Wonderful, that's really it! Thank You so much—you've done both me and one of my longtime customers a huge favor!

10370000606._kDes: Come on, tell me—who was it? How did they pull off something so skillful? I still can't figure out how they did it.

10370000609._kDes: Wh... what? It was... her? But how...? She sounded so sincere when she praised my smithing... Could it be... was all that just so she could steal from me? Ugh, this hurts worse than failing a +@{1} refinement...

10370000610._kDes: Oh! I get it now! It's one of those "can't say too much" situations, right? Like with certain high-level commissions.

10370000611._kDes: Anyway, getting the weapon back is wonderful news! I, Hollgrehenn, won't forget what you've done. Next time you need equipment refined, I'll give you a discount!

10370000612._kDes: Oh, it's you! What kind of flowers do you need today? ...Hmm? Judging by your expression, is something important going on?

10370000614._kDes: Oh my gosh! It's my ring! The ring my mother left me! Thank goodness! I really, truly can't thank you enough!

10370000615._kDes: Um... if you don't mind, could you tell me who took it? I'm really curious.

10370000617._kDes: …Huh? That… prince-like gentleman? Th-That can't be…

10370000618._kDes: So... when he said he was starving... and all those words of gratitude... was it all just... just so he could steal Mom's ring? So... there was never any fateful encounter at all...

10370000619._kDes: I understand! You must be trying to protect someone, right? Just like in the knightly tales~

10370000620._kDes: It's okay. Getting the ring back is the best ending I could have hoped for. Thank you for helping me complete this "mission." From now on, whenever you buy flowers from me, I'll always give you twenty percent off~

10370000621._kDes: Investigator! You're back! That look on your face... Could it be...?

10370000623._kDes: Odin be praised, the seal is completely intact... Thank You! You prevented what could have been an academic catastrophe!

10370000624._kDes: Protocol requires me to ask: Have you identified the thief? This is crucial to improving our security measures going forward.

10370000626._kDes: Wh... what? You're accusing that... that Siamese cat with pupils as clear as amber?!

10370000627._kDes: No, that's impossible! It completely contradicts the fundamental principles of Non-Sapient Creature Behavior! It was so docile, and spectral analysis of its purring showed that it was completely relaxed! Could... could all of this have been some kind of higher-dimensional mimicry disguise?!

10370000628._kDes: I see. When dealing with a thief of this caliber, their very identity is classified information that must remain sealed. I understand why you need to keep it confidential.

10370000629._kDes: In any case, you've recovered the forbidden tome and made an invaluable contribution to the stability of the academic community. Please accept my gratitude. From now on, I'll give your research into magical items priority support.

10370000630._kDes: Hey, wait! Prontera is holding a festival soon, and coordinating all the supplies is driving me crazy. I've got a list of errands here. Could you take care of them for me?

10370000631._kDes: First, find Antonio for me. He promised to bring the festival banner back from Morroc, but there's still no sign of him. And while you're at it—

10370000632._kDes: Monsters are overrunning Sograt Desert. Help me take some of them out first.

10370000633._kDes: The banner? According to regulations, I handed it over to the Merchants' Guild for delivery 3 days ago. But the caravan leader said they ran into monsters and got stranded along the way. I was just about to head there Myself.

10370000634._kDes: Since you're here, how about taking care of them for me?

10370000635._kDes: Oh...that. The Fireworks are finished. But Yesterday, I suddenly decided the Normal gold was too boring, so I stayed up all night changing them to a 7-color gradient with sparkling trails.

10370000636._kDes: The Effect will be spectacular! There's just one tiny problem—

10370000637._kDes: The fuse is a little short, so you have to run the moment it's lit. Remind whoever lights the Fireworks to be quick on their feet. Or maybe You could first help me find a way to lengthen the fuse?

10370000638._kDes: The signal tower? Oh! That! Theoretically, I finished calibrating it last week.

10370000639._kDes: I also added a Ranged communication Function while I was at it. The signal can reach all the way to Izlude Island! There's just one little bug—the messages it sends get translated into cat language.

10370000641._kDes: According to the records, the 7th revised edition of the Festival Procedure Manual...does need an update. An accident forced a last-minute change to the schedule last year, but no one told me. So I wrote a correct version Myself, only to be told it was too long.

10370000642._kDes: I've prepared a [Complete Version] archive and a [Condensed Version] for the host. Remember, don't lose them again.

10370000643._kDes: According to the records, monster populations rise abnormally before and after the festival. I suspect the festive atmosphere excites them. Take out 10 before You leave, and I'll add that to next year's manual.

10370000644._kDes: It's settled! The Swordsman team's month of Lineup practice won't go to waste. The Mage team will use Ice Fog for special Effects, and the Acolyte team will offer Blessings along the route—the Archer team wanted to shoot apples with their Bows, but I put a stop to that.

10370000645._kDes: There are 48 people in all. Here's the list. Could the Kids walk at the front of the procession? They're so excited that if they walk in the back, they'll step on everyone else's Cloaks.

10370000646._kDes: Honestly, every festival in Prontera is chaotic, but seeing everyone—including an Adventurer like You—pitch in makes me realize what a wonderful city this is.

10370000647._kDes: Here's your reward. Don't forget to come to the festival. Seth's Fireworks may have short fuses, but they'll definitely be beautiful!

10370000648._kDes: Huh? You felt it too? The flow of Elements in Geffen has definitely seemed strange Recent.

10370000649._kDes: Ask the Item Merchant what's going on. He works with gathered Materials year-round, so he should know more about the monsters' movements than I do.

10370000650._kDes: You're just in time! The concentration of Poison Mushroom spores has more than doubled, and over half the medicinal herbs I've collected are ruined.

10370000651._kDes: Miss Smile was also complaining a few days ago. She said monsters keep intercepting the Jellopy she uses to make masks. Could You ask her about it while you're there?

10370000652._kDes: Oh my, Adventurer, your expression looks even more tense than usual. I'm not short on Materials, but the Foreign Merchant across the street said a while back that he had an ancient Stone that could calm monsters.

10370000653._kDes: But he already returned to the Morroc Ruins. Head there. The sandstorms are fierce, but the Clue should still be there.

10370000654._kDes: Oh, that Stone? I did acquire it, but I already passed it on to Baisulist. He said it was connected to an ancient seal in Geffen Tower.

10370000655._kDes: But You need to hurry. I've seen more aggressive monsters over the past few months than I did in the previous 3 years combined. That's No good sign.

10370000656._kDes: So You're the Adventurer Miss Smile mentioned. This ancient Stone is indeed a fragment of the seal. The weakening seal is what caused the monsters to become agitated.

10370000657._kDes: Aorufeng is guarding the formation at the top of the tower. Take the fragment to him. He knows how to fit it back into the base.

10370000658._kDes: You're finally here. Once this fragment is back in place, the magical field beneath the tower will become stable again.

10370000659._kDes: You've worked hard traveling from Geffen to Morroc and all the way back. Geffen owes You one, Adventurer.

10370000660._kDes: Are You here to help that Young Man from Geffen? He spent ages browsing my shop a few days ago, but eventually said he couldn't afford anything and left looking dejected.

10370000661._kDes: Tell You what—I'll prepare a gift for You first. But monsters have been appearing along the delivery route Recent, so clear them out before they trample the gift box.

10370000662._kDes: Well, this is a surprise. That gift box You're holding needs a proper decorative case, right? I can make one, but I'll need the fragrant wood that only grows around the roots of ancient trees.

10370000663._kDes: Ask the Pet Merchant. His little Porings run around the forest all day, so he should know which trees have good wood beneath them.

10370000664._kDes: I'll take care of the lumber! But first, you'll have to drive away those wolves Nearby. Me Porings have been too scared to leave their cages for two days.

10370000665._kDes: These little ones are timid enough already. If you don't help, I'll never get them to tell me where the spicewood is.

10370000666._kDes: I hear you're helping someone prepare a gift. Here, take this dry-cured ham too. When you're out adventuring, nothing's more reassuring than having some meat in your pocket.

10370000667._kDes: Come to think of it, haven't the monsters seemed unusually restless lately? The Monsterologist has been collecting samples. Go have a word with him—he's in the little cabin by the tower.

10370000668._kDes: I can tell from your Battle scars. Recent monster attacks have increased in both frequency and range, perfectly in sync with the tower's magical fluctuations.

10370000669._kDes: But enough about that. The Young Man asked me to tell you that if everything's Ready, he'll be waiting by the fountain. Don't keep him waiting too long.

10370000670._kDes: Not a single thing is missing. From Prontera to Geffen, from the gift to the spicewood and ham... You really helped me gather every last thing.

10370000671._kDes: She'll love it. If you ever need anything, just come find me here by the fountain. My name is Reia. Remember it.

10370000672._kDes: The appearance of the Sky Rift heralds the arrival of a new world. That unknown land holds immense energy, and the magical power of Arcane Crystals may be the key to defending ourselves against the unknown. If we all work together to gather Arcane Crystals, we may be able to withstand the power that is about to descend upon us.

10370000676._kDes: Donate all ^{1}${1}^{2} Magic Crystals? You will receive ^{3}${2}^{4} Donor Badges.

10370000678._kDes: Oh, Crystal donations require the support of a guild... Go find some like-minded adventurers!

10370000680._kDes: You don't have any Magic Crystals yet. Come back when you've collected some.

10370000681._kDes: This is a test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the first line of the first quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000682._kDes: This is a test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the second line of the first quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000683._kDes: This is a test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the first line of the second quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000684._kDes: This is test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the second line of the second quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000685._kDes: This is test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the first line of the third quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000686._kDes: This is test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the second line of the third quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000687._kDes: This is a test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the first line of the fourth quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000688._kDes: This is test dialogue for a Season quest. This is the second line of the fourth quest. Ahahahaha!

10370000691._kDes:
Welcome! The Kafra Corporation is always here to provide you with the finest service.
How may we assist you?

10370000694._kDes: Are you sure you want to teleport to ${1}? It will cost ${2}!

10370000696._kDes: Do you want to leave the Realm Law Sandbox?

10370000698._kDes: Turn in supplies to earn guild rewards!

10370000699._kDes: I want to turn in supplies.

10370000700._kDes: Did you finish today's task? You can claim your reward!

10370000701._kDes: Congratulations on completing the task! Here's your reward!

10370000702._kDes: Welcome! I'm a voting campaign representative sent to Prontera by Kafra Headquarters. How may I help you?

10370000703._kDes: This is Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Welcome! Would you like an introduction?

10370000705._kDes: Hello! I'm a voting campaign representative sent here by the Zonda Planning Agency. How may I help you?

10370000706._kDes: We have the finest flowers in Prontera! Adventurer, why not buy a bouquet?

10370000707._kDes: Bring a gift to someone you love!

10370000708._kDes: What item are you looking for? I've got everything!

10370000709._kDes: Somewhere in this land, a tremendous power is beginning to reveal itself in subtle ways...

10370000710._kDes: Can you feel it? Something incredible and unpredictable is happening...

10370000711._kDes: Oh, come on! Where could they all be hiding?

10370000712._kDes: Our valiant knights will sweep away every villain who threatens the kingdom's peace!

10370000713._kDes: I heard there's a bard near the city gate who can't sing. Have you seen him?

10370000714._kDes: They say you can make lots of friends in a guild. Could such a wonderful place really exist?

10370000716._kDes: It's so cool beneath the fountain, don't you think?

10370000717._kDes: I'm so bored. Hmm... Times like these call for a song. Hmm...

10370000718._kDes: The weather was lovely during my vacation, so my family and I went on a picnic in the forest. Then we ran into an enormous swarm of bees.

10370000719._kDes: Did you know? Creamy larvae are called Fabres, and when a Fabre forms a cocoon, it becomes a Pupa. Although their forms differ, they're actually the same species of Insect. They can even survive in the desert, or so I've heard.

10370000720._kDes: The Prontera Chivalry regularly hunts monsters. It keeps their skills sharp and the city safe—two birds with one stone.

10370000721._kDes: Keep at it! The future of Prontera rests on our shoulders!

10370000722._kDes: Every day feels so rewarding... Joining the Chivalry was definitely the right choice! Hahaha!

10370000723._kDes: Aster of the Wind sings for no one.

10370000724._kDes: A bard who sings only for himself.

10370000725._kDes: I won't sing for you. Go away.

10370000726._kDes: Odin is the god we serve. He is known as both the God of War and the God of Children. He would even sacrifice one of his own eyes for his children.

10370000727._kDes: I hear the bronze statue in that fountain was sculpted in his likeness.

10370000728._kDes: Welcome to the Oak Inn. How may I help you?

10370000729._kDes: Oh... Are you out for a walk too? This is a rather strange place for a stroll...

10370000730._kDes: Hee-hee~ More and more people are showing up!

10370000731._kDes: Our library carefully classifies monsters from every corner of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. We house essential reading for every Adventurer, so please feel free to browse.

10370000732._kDes: Would you like to trade headbands with me?

10370000733._kDes: There are so many Adventurers here! I guess that's to be expected in a kingdom's capital!

10370000734._kDes: Hello! Are you here to trade for a Smiling Mask?

10370000735._kDes: Every weapon here is certified by the assessment board for its respective class. Shop with confidence!

10370000736._kDes: Our meat is fresh and affordable. You can't go wrong!

10370000737._kDes: This fruit comes straight from our orchard. If it isn't delicious, it's free! Come try some!

10370000738._kDes: We're looking for curious and courageous Adventurers. Brave souls, come take on the challenge!

10370000739._kDes: I'm looking for warriors who will stand with me through life and death! If you have both brains and brawn, hesitate no longer—join me!

10370000740._kDes: As long as we possess the brilliant Metal that guides our destiny, the gods will never abandon us!

10370000742._kDes:
Hah! Hah! Hyah!
Whew... I'm feeling a little more confident now. Long live the Prontera Chivalry!

10370000743._kDes: This is Geffen, the City of Magic. Welcome! Would you like an introduction?

10370000744._kDes: You can mix and match different outfits in the Wardrobe~

10370000745._kDes: Hello! I'm Nia, the fifth disciple of the Demon Lord, who creates fun games and brings joy to everyone.

10370000746._kDes: Hey~! Hello, human! I'm Meow-Mew! Wahaha~

10370000747._kDes: I hear that if you travel south from Geffen, you'll reach a vast forest inhabited by monsters called Orcs.

10370000748._kDes: Some say they have their own language and culture, just like humans.

10370000749._kDes:
When's a good time for a drink~?
On the days of earth, sun, and moon~?

10370000750._kDes:
Which day is best for drinking?
Why do I only get to drink one day?

10370000751._kDes:
Tell me which day you drink~
And I'll tell you which day I drink~.

10370000752._kDes: I've heard of a Magic Staff that converts its wielder's mental energy into physical force, increasing its destructive power.

10370000753._kDes: With a Magic Staff, even someone who isn't naturally strong can convert mental energy into tremendous physical power.

10370000754._kDes: On a beautiful day like this, I'd love to pack my bag and head deep into the mountains to gather rare and interesting items.

10370000755._kDes: Do you believe in the miracles of Hacha? If you do, repeat this spell after me! Hachabra, Hachabra, Hachabra~~!!

10370000756._kDes: What beautiful weather! It's a perfect day for refining!

10370000757._kDes: The road of adventure is long, so fill your belly before you set out!

10370000758._kDes: Past events will never return. Even the greatest magic cannot change that—as we speak, time continues to flow.

10370000759._kDes: In Al De Baran, there is a skilled weaponsmith who lives with his four sons.

10370000760._kDes: But while developing a new weapon, all four of his sons tragically lost their lives. He alone survived.

10370000761._kDes: You can use an incubator to hatch an adorable pet. Want to try?

10370000762._kDes: Hmm... I need to put the song...

10370000763._kDes: An ancient tome on magic once mentioned that Legend says the Yggdrasil Leaf, seeds, and fruit that shaped this world are closely connected to all Life in creation...

10370000764._kDes: Why am I not the most Excellent Sage you've ever seen?

10370000765._kDes: If you have no business with me, please get out of my sight!

10370000766._kDes: Because I need to think, and I don't want to be disturbed by someone with nothing better to do.

10370000767._kDes: Greetings. I'm a scholar who travels the world studying monster ecology. Would you help me collect some items essential to my research?

10370000768._kDes: My name is Zenji, and I like origami.

10370000769._kDes: Yesterday, I folded a huge boat for Mom. She said, "Thank You," and patted me on the head!

10370000770._kDes: I hear the Hornets living on the plains spend their entire lives gathering Honey under the Mistress's orders.

10370000771._kDes: They say that Honey isn't just sweet and delicious—it's also highly nutritious and sells for a hefty price.

10370000772._kDes: Honestly, Alberta is so far away. It's such a pain that I can't pick up the items I ordered...

10370000773._kDes: When will my 【Feel-Good Arc Wand】 finally arrive...?

10370000774._kDes: Heh heh heh! At last, I Discover the truth! Magic that makes mushrooms grow on your head is truly terrifying!

10370000775._kDes: Having mushrooms growing on your head makes everyday life terribly inconvenient, so you have to pull them out and turn them into hair ties!

10370000776._kDes: Did you need something? If not, I'll be on my way...

10370000777._kDes: Swordsmen don't need any other skills—just one punch! Bash! Bash! Bash! That's all it takes!

10370000778._kDes: If you're a Swordsman, make good use of Magnum Break! Bash is merely a stepping stone on the path to mastering Magnum Break!

10370000779._kDes: Let's run away~ Just the two of us, leaving everything behind~ Beneath Java's blue skies and starry nights~

10370000780._kDes: To celebrate our @{1}th wedding anniversary, we've decided to return to Java, where we spent our honeymoon!

10370000781._kDes: When you miss your beloved, you have to shout like this!

10370000783._kDes: Then my darling will drop everything and come running straight to me, right?

10370000784._kDes: When I call him, of course he has to come~ Darling, I love you!

10370000786._kDes: Hello! I'm an Alchemist, a class that Merchants can reach through Job Advance.

10370000787._kDes: I'm making potions. A quiet place really does feel like it improves the chances of success.

10370000788._kDes: Now that I'm in Izlude, I've got a good feeling about this. Heh... Appear!

10370000789._kDes: We couldn't have a child for many years, but ten years ago, we were unexpectedly blessed with a son in our old age.

10370000790._kDes: I want to cherish my precious son, but my wife says we need to discipline him strictly.

10370000791._kDes: I'm worried that if this continues, my only son will go astray.

10370000792._kDes: I suppose every parent worries about this, don't they?

10370000795._kDes: Have you seen our little Jugem bouncing around and playing?

10370000797._kDes: Where has that boy run off to now? He can't even stay home for a single hour!

10370000798._kDes: Huh? What's going on? Where am I?

10370000799._kDes: Are you in love with someone?

10370000801._kDes: Drink plenty of Milk if you want to grow tall!

10370000802._kDes: Meow, these shrimp are delicious! What are you staring at? The fact that I can eat so many just proves how fresh they are!

10370000803._kDes: That young man sitting over there... He's been staring at the refining machine for hours. It looks like he's lost all his weapons and only has a small knife left?

10370000804._kDes: Shh! Keep it down! I'm concentrating on refining an item.

10370000807._kDes: Refining can Enhance items. Weapons in particular gain ATK, so a successful refinement can be a tremendous help.

10370000808._kDes: Appear! Please, hurry up and appear!

10370000809._kDes: Welcome to Izlude Island, a satellite city. Would you like an introduction?

10370000810._kDes: I gave it everything I had.

10370000811._kDes: Shilude will return safely, won't they?

10370000812._kDes: Uh... Hello, adventurer. I'm so exhausted I can't even move...

10370000813._kDes: I'm exhausted after working for a while...

10370000814._kDes: But it's all worth it for Shilude...

10370000815._kDes: I like it here. Now leave—this is no place for you.

10370000816._kDes: Thank You for flying with Valkyrie Air. Would you like to board an airship?

10370000817._kDes: At the entrance to Southeast Payon, there's a bridge connecting the desert and the forest. You can see every kind of Poring there—it's an absolutely adorable place.

10370000818._kDes: Welcome to Izlude Island! Izlude is a satellite city of the capital, Prontera. We not only train Swordsmen, but also patrol the seas, making this a very important city.

10370000819._kDes: Long ago, serious criminals were sentenced to death. The enchanted sword used for their executions was called the Executioner.

10370000820._kDes: This arena gives young people from across the kingdom a chance to test their skills. It summons different monsters to duel you based on your level. So, would you like to take on the challenge?

10370000821._kDes: Heh heh heh~ Hm? Want to know why I'm so happy?

10370000822._kDes: Ahh... It's hard to find work these days. I'm sure you know that, right?

10370000823._kDes: You can make a tidy profit by hunting monsters and selling their loot to merchants!

10370000824._kDes: Humans look so strange. Are they... giant hairless cats?

10370000825._kDes: Ahem! Izlude Island is responsible for protecting not only the land, but the vast seas as well! Our large telescope lets us watch the distant waters so we can be Ready for any crisis.

10370000826._kDes: You've always got to be prepared!

10370000827._kDes:
The Royal Criatura Academy was founded to help the many young people taking their first steps
into this world.

10370000828._kDes: I'm just a low-ranking employee who does odd jobs, but seeing our graduates stride confidently into the world always makes me happy.

10370000830._kDes: Welcome to Morroc, the Desert City! Would you like me to tell you about it?

10370000831._kDes: What are you looking at? I'm furious, so leave me alone!

10370000832._kDes: Hee hee... Hic! You're from out of town, aren't you? Since fate brought us together, I'll let you in on something I happened to overhear while having a drink at the tavern~

10370000833._kDes: Demon King Morroc has apparently returned through a Revive, emerging from a rift in time and space... Hic...

10370000834._kDes: It looks like a jumbled pile of junk.

10370000835._kDes: What are you looking at? Huh? Is my name funny?

10370000836._kDes: Ha! You don't know anything! It's a stage name—a stage name! It means a Thief who leaves no tracks in the sand. What a cool stage name!

10370000837._kDes: Pfft. Life, money... What a filthy world!

10370000838._kDes: Sheesh... Ptooey... What are you looking at?!

10370000839._kDes: Have you heard the Story of the Curse on the @{1} types of gems?

10370000840._kDes: I heard that the Diamond of Ruin, one of those four gems, suddenly appeared recently...

10370000841._kDes: Phew~ It's so hot again today. Why does it have to be this hot?

10370000842._kDes: ...When are the items I ordered finally going to arrive? I'm starting to get angry!

10370000843._kDes: The village is half destroyed, yet people are still coming here... That shouldn't affect the secret base much, right?

10370000844._kDes: Um... I was sent here... to work on... the reconstruction of Morroc.

10370000845._kDes: Meeting someone who has died is essentially impossible. Even if it were possible, their soul would probably have none of the memories they had while alive.

10370000846._kDes: If they experienced things that were familiar to them in life, could that possibly restore their memories?

10370000847._kDes:
I've heard of an enchanted sword called Mysteltainn, made from an Orc's canine tooth harder than steel. Only a certain Blacksmith living
in Prontera knows how to make it.

10370000848._kDes: Unfortunately, that Blacksmith has left Prontera, and no one knows where they went.

10370000849._kDes: Hello. Lovely weather, isn't it? Um... If you don't mind, may I tell you a little about myself?

10370000850._kDes: Morroc, the Desert City, has a charm all its own. The blazing sun and hot winds by day, the hills dyed red at sunset, and the freezing hours before dawn... These are all sources of pride for Morroc.

10370000851._kDes:
But human greed knows no bounds.
So, besides these treasures of the desert, I also want to surround myself with things from elsewhere.

10370000852._kDes: I'm a traveler who loves journeying from country to country. It certainly is hot here.

10370000853._kDes: Welcome! You've come to the Stile family shop, renowned for making the 【Stop Sign Headgear】.

10370000854._kDes: Our family began making traffic signs long before horse-drawn carriages became the main form of transportation. We have been in business for two hundred and fifty years.

10370000855._kDes: Lately, we've received many custom orders for the 【Stop Sign Headgear】. Wearing one as an accessory is quite fashionable now.

10370000857._kDes: That man is scary! Mommy! Help me find my mommy! Waaaaah!

10370000858._kDes: Even with sand and dust swirling through the air, I'd recognize you like the one shining star in the night sky.

10370000859._kDes: So don't worry. Not even the blazing sun or the terrifying desert sandstorms could stop me~

10370000860._kDes: I'd definitely recognize you... Go... Get out of here! Can't you see I'm busy?

10370000861._kDes: I'm searching for treasure. I heard someone with inside information lives north of Morroc Village.

10370000862._kDes: If it's already been dug up, there's nothing we can do. Still, we could ask around. Maybe we can dig up some other information.

10370000863._kDes: Just as every sunset brings a sunrise, Morroc's tireless nomads labor in the shadows to maintain the inexhaustible water supply that sustains Morroc.

10370000864._kDes: Heh. So many adventurers and travelers have been coming and going lately that I can't tell the villagers from the visitors anymore.

10370000865._kDes: Buy a ring for your sweetheart.

10370000866._kDes: You don't have a sweetheart? Then you can buy one for me!

10370000867._kDes: (Whispering) I sell some secret equipment here. Want to take a look?

10370000868._kDes: Magic mirror, tell me true: Who's the fairest of them all?

10370000869._kDes: Did you know? The Witherless Rose only grows in the desert.

10370000870._kDes: Bananas... Heh heh... Bananas for sale... Heh heh...

10370000871._kDes: Come one, come all! You'll need these items!

10370000873._kDes: Buying monster drops at top prices!

10370000874._kDes: I'm a professional gem appraiser, and I only sell the finest gems!

10370000875._kDes: Welcome to Payon, the Mountain City! Would you like me to tell you about it?

10370000876._kDes: There are so many trees and flowers here. They seem to fill me with strength.

10370000877._kDes: I'm Leavren, the technician in charge of Enhance services for weapons and armor. It's hard work, but also a lot of fun.

10370000878._kDes: Getting completely drunk every night is making my head hurt~ I could really use a bottle of pale yellow Potion~ Hic~

10370000879._kDes: Hello! Traveling through the forest to get here must've been rough. Monsters have been running rampant around Payon lately, so we don't get nearly as many visitors. It's such a shame.

10370000880._kDes: And now my friends and I have so much less to talk about. Honestly~

10370000881._kDes: Oh my, what a chatterbox! She'll talk a stranger's ear off without a second thought.

10370000882._kDes: Don't get the wrong idea. Not everyone in Payon is as talkative as she is.

10370000883._kDes: But I don't think we've met before, have we?

10370000884._kDes: There was once a time when people here struggled just to eat and survive.

10370000885._kDes: People couldn't even afford burials for the dead, so some bodies were secretly left in the caves.

10370000886._kDes: They say the bodies in the nearby caves couldn't pass on to the afterlife, so they still wander this world. Ahh, how terrifying...

10370000887._kDes: Ciphers are works of art! Do you know the thrill of unraveling every layer until the secret is finally revealed?

10370000888._kDes: I’m working hard studying ciphers today just to experience that feeling... I’m so proud...

10370000889._kDes:
Sing~ Sing~
The song of Debuha Moni~
O Tree of Life~
The World Tree, evergreen,

10370000890._kDes:
The ash tree that blankets the sky,
White dew soaks the mighty tree,
White dew falls and becomes a flood,
The evergreen tree that embraces Urd's Well.

10370000891._kDes: My goodness~~ Payon's most handsome man has returned! Who would've thought that mischievous little rascal would grow up to be so handsome...

10370000892._kDes: He and this old lady were childhood sweethearts, you know. Hehehe~ Perhaps I'll tempt him with my beauty?

10370000893._kDes: If you're here, stop wasting time and show me the equipment you want refined!

10370000894._kDes: I'm the technician responsible for Enhancing weapons and armor. Some people say it's trivial work, but that's merely the biased opinion of amateurs.

10370000895._kDes: My name is Phoenix. In this world tainted by evil, I strive to purify myself and remain devoted to my training.

10370000896._kDes: ...You know, it's rude to stare at someone like that for no reason.

10370000897._kDes: Hello, everyone! I'm Miss Smile. Is there anything I can help you with?

10370000898._kDes: Broken watches and hair for sale~

10370000899._kDes: I vaguely remember traveling with my father and a caravan as a child. I think a giant snake attacked us as we passed through here, separating us from the caravan. I was separated from my family, and now I can't even remember what my father looked like.

10370000900._kDes: Now I have my own caravan and live comfortably, but the shadow of that day still haunts me.

10370000901._kDes: I thought I might find a Clue to my family's whereabouts here, but unfortunately, so much time has passed that there are no clues left.

10370000902._kDes: When I was about fourteen or fifteen, I had a crush on a boy. To get his attention, I picked on his Peco Peco, and we ended up having a huge fight.

10370000903._kDes: It turned out we both felt the same way, and we started dating. Oh my! I'm getting a little Shy just talking about it!

10370000904._kDes: We eventually got married, but he always felt guilty for not giving me a wedding ring.

10370000905._kDes: On our fortieth anniversary, he went out to buy me a ring and never returned.

10370000906._kDes: The young lady I served was in poor health and always coughing, so she regularly took cough medicine.

10370000907._kDes: One day, the medicinal herbs delivered every month failed to arrive. I heard the caravan had been attacked by a giant snake.

10370000908._kDes: Sadly, the young lady eventually passed away. I've spent years searching this area for that snake.

10370000909._kDes: Gitan died long ago. Gitan has no regrets. Gitan isn't bad.

10370000910._kDes: Gitan... needs bracelet. Gitan's bracelet is precious.

10370000911._kDes: After Gitan finds bracelet, Gitan will find that snake. Bad snake killed Gitan.

10370000912._kDes: What could possibly bring anyone to someone living such a lonely Life?

10370000915._kDes: I know why you tried talking to me. It's because the Black Cat Ears I'm wearing are so cute, right? Hehe.

10370000916._kDes: This is the Payon Palace Annex.

10370000918._kDes: I am a man who yearns for luck! Bring me good luuuuuuck!

10370000919._kDes: There's only one thing I need! A four-leaf Lucky Cloverrrrr!

10370000920._kDes: Can anyone help me find a four-leaf Lucky Clover?!

10370000921._kDes: With the support of His Majesty Tristan, the Monster Research Society was founded to resolve problems caused by monsters.

10370000922._kDes: We're currently gathering talented people from across the continent to uncover the origins of monsters through research and exploration.

10370000923._kDes: You can exchange different-colored magic ores with me.

10370000924._kDes: The future belongs to the young. There's no place left for us old-timers anymore.

10370000926._kDes: Hm? You mean the cave in the mountain behind us? What's happening there has everyone worried.

10370000927._kDes: Welcome to the Producer's Lair! The Kafra Corporation is here to provide you with the finest service.

10370000928._kDes: If you have any questions about the shop, just ask me~

10370000929._kDes: So this is the Midgard Continent? It looks a little like my homeland.

10370000930._kDes: I'll definitely pass the Novice exam!

10370000931._kDes: D-don't come any closer... I'm a little seasick. Ugh...

10370000932._kDes: I really enjoy volunteering. Helping others gives my Life meaning.

10370000933._kDes: I've seen countless sights, but I still haven't found a place where I want to stay.

10370000934._kDes: People often suffer from heatstroke in the desert, so make sure you stay hydrated!

10370000936._kDes: I will always pray to Lady Freyja.

10370000938._kDes: Hey, Adventurer! Good to see you again! How have you been?

10370000940._kDes: Welcome! We just brewed a fresh pot of coffee today. You could smell it from the door, couldn't you?

10370000941._kDes: Ah, that's how it is with old houses. Fix one spot, and another crack appears right next to it.

10370000943._kDes: We'll have to walk this street again this afternoon. We went too fast earlier, so I didn't get a good look.

10370000944._kDes: After walking all morning, she's finally willing to Sit down and take a break.

10370000945._kDes: I've wanted to rest for ages, but she said there was still one more street to explore...

10370000946._kDes: The old king has been missing for years. Isn't it time to choose a new successor?

10370000947._kDes: Whoa there, old friend. You can't go saying things like that in the street.

10370000948._kDes: (whispering) My money's on the prince of House Bart. That Young Man is quite ambitious.

10370000949._kDes: House Kavo Barlög still has the best chance, doesn't it? After all, the current ruler is...

10370000950._kDes: Young people run Outside the City every day now. No idea what they're after.

10370000953._kDes: You ran even faster than they do.

10370000958._kDes: Let's go, let's go! We'll set out at dawn~

10370000959._kDes: There's some travel food and an old map in the Backpack~

10370000960._kDes: The map was left behind by the last traveler~

10370000961._kDes: Some of the roads don't exist anymore~

10370000962._kDes: That's all right. You make your own path~

10370000963._kDes: Worn-out soles can be replaced, and a wrong turn can be corrected~

10370000964._kDes: And that water flask—remember to fill it before you leave~

10370000965._kDes: He's in amazing form today. Just listen to that high note—

10370000966._kDes: One more song. Just one, and then I'm really leaving.

10370000967._kDes: (yawning) We agreed to meet here. Why isn't she here yet?

10370000968._kDes: That's enough for today. We're low on Material, so be sensible.

10370000971._kDes: I'm not easily moved, but art is...

10370000972._kDes: Those who get it, get it.

10370000973._kDes: I failed the second time... but I know what went wrong.

10370000974._kDes: I can submit another evaluation Request in a month. A month is plenty of time to practice.

10370000975._kDes: I really have No idea what kind of people the Eden Group is looking for...

10370000977._kDes: Come one, come all! See the finest show in Prontera! No admission fee—just a fateful encounter!

10370000978._kDes: If you feel a connection, toss me a coin. If not, you're welcome to stand and watch.

10370000980._kDes: That's a huge nail. Who hammered it in there?

10370000981._kDes: Can you feel it? The energy field here is quite unusual...

10370000982._kDes: ...Wait. This contradicts what was written in the previous volume.

10370000983._kDes: (flipping back) It does contradict it... Did the author not even notice?

10370000984._kDes: You know... the kind that gives you an upset stomach. It won't cause any real harm, right?

10370000985._kDes: Don't worry. I've sold dozens of orders, and everyone was fine once they'd emptied their bowels.

10370000987._kDes: It's exam season. Business is good.

10370000988._kDes: This price includes two packets. One is usually enough, but the second is insurance.

10370000989._kDes: But what if he drinks it and nothing happens?

10370000990._kDes: There's no chance it won't work. I run an honest business.

10370000991._kDes: Set yourself a goal, work hard, and come Learn here someday.

10370000992._kDes: Stop staring at the floor. Look up and remember this place.

10370000993._kDes: Someday, I hope they'll hang a portrait of Me here too...

10370000994._kDes: How long did this one live... 87 years.

10370000995._kDes: No worries. It's just a make-up exam. It's perfectly normal—lots of people take them.

10370000996._kDes: I never had the chance to study when I was young, but now I have the time.

10370000997._kDes: I made a chart listing the pros and cons of each class.

10370000998._kDes: But after looking it over, I have even less of an idea which one to choose.

10370000999._kDes: I've decided to Job Advance into a Magic Mage!

10370001000._kDes: I'm counting to @{1}. If he still hasn't apologized by then, we're breaking up!

10370001002._kDes: All I did was ask, “How much longer are we going to shop?” and she got Angry...

10370001003._kDes: I didn't Sound impatient, did I?

10370001004._kDes: Fresh fruits and vegetables! Come take a look and buy some!

10370001005._kDes: The Sound of the waves makes me feel Calm.

10370001006._kDes: Are you here on vacation? Is this your first time in Izlude?

10370001008._kDes: All right, all right. Izlude is great.

10370001009._kDes: Someone posted a wanted notice here—a white four-legged creature carried off a fish in its mouth and is very agile...

10370001011._kDes: I saw a commission flyer a few days ago. The reward was pretty good.

10370001012._kDes: ...It's gone. Did someone take it down?

10370001013._kDes: I'll just sit for one minute. Just one minute. I really can't keep fighting...

10370001014._kDes: My master says fighting Ant Eggs is the best way to train at this stage.

10370001015._kDes: I'll work hard and defeat all 9,999 of them. I won't let my master down.

10370001016._kDes: Ugh, why did I choose a partner like this? I'd be better off doing it myself.

10370001017._kDes: It's so dark in there. I-I don't want to go inside...

10370001020._kDes: The upside is that there's less stock left, so there'll be less pressure to sell it all.

10370001021._kDes: Last time, I didn't have enough Potions, and Maya took me down at the last moment. This time, I'm well prepared. I can do it!

10370001022._kDes: What's so scary about Maya? Just charge in!

10370001023._kDes: The price of Payon cloth went up this season. Prontera probably hasn't caught up yet, so I should get a good price there.

10370001024._kDes: There's a bird's nest in that tree. Could you walk a little more quietly?

10370001025._kDes: It was foggy this morning. This place was beautiful when the fog lifted. Too bad you didn't get here in time to see it.

10370001026._kDes: Don't let the quiet fool you. Calm doesn't mean everything's fine. Sometimes, Calm is the most dangerous sign of all.

10370001027._kDes: Before I joined the army, I thought being stationed in a forest would be nice—cool shade and fresh air.

10370001028._kDes: I never expected Goblins to be this noisy. They chatter from morning till night. It's louder than the city!

10370001029._kDes: Who built this well? What a wonderful person.

10370001030._kDes: When I was young, every monster in this Field would take a detour when it saw me.

10370001031._kDes: I'm not bragging. It's true! Go ask one of the veteran Adventurers.

10370001032._kDes: Patrol or rest today—(Flips coin) Rest.

10370001036._kDes: When we were young, this gate wasn't nearly this big. They expanded it later.

10370001038._kDes: It's still worth saying. They did a great job expanding it. It's much easier to come and go now.

10370001040._kDes: That little girl's bag looks just like our granddaughter's.

10370001042._kDes: She's too far away now. I can't see her.

10370001044._kDes: No idea how she's been doing Recent.

10370001045._kDes: Her last letter said she was doing well.

10370001046._kDes: As long as she's doing well.

10370001047._kDes: This costs @{1} Zeny in our village, but it's @{2} here?

10370001048._kDes: Before I left home, my neighbor said Prontera has everything, everything's expensive, and everything's fun.

10370001049._kDes: He was right about all three.

10370001050._kDes: One at a time! No need to rush. There's plenty for everyone.

10370001051._kDes: Sir! Don't squeeze that. If you damage it, you'll have to buy it!

10370001052._kDes: Hey, money's been tight Recent, hasn't it? I can see the worry on your face.

10370001053._kDes: If you're ever in trouble, come see me. I know a lot of people.

10370001054._kDes: No need to thank me. We're neighbors, after all.

10370001055._kDes: I've had this cart for 7 years. I've replaced the wheels twice and the handle once. This frame is the only original part left.

10370001057._kDes: When the weather's nice, it's more comfortable to stay out in the Field than in the city.

10370001058._kDes: Porings are so Cute! Why would anyone attack them?

10370001060._kDes: Bread, grilled meat, fruit, soup dumplings—hot or cold, we've got it all. Just tell me what you'd like.

10370001061._kDes: You need a full stomach to have the energy for adventure!

10370001062._kDes: You're a new Adventurer, aren't you? Come here, I'll show you. You're right here. Go this way to Prontera or that way to Izlude.

10370001063._kDes: Well? Got it memorized? If you're worried about getting lost, buy a map.

10370001064._kDes: I line up here at 6 every morning, rain or shine. You youngsters sleep in, so you end up behind me.

10370001065._kDes: This bakery only makes a limited number each day. It's too late to line up now, so buy one from me later for just an extra @{1}!

10370001066._kDes: No idea how long this place will stay popular. I should start looking for Other opportunities...

10370001067._kDes: I've collected Varmundt's complete set of notes!

10370001069._kDes: Hehe, I made a special trip to Juno University and spent ages searching the Library.

10370001070._kDes: Do you think someone like Varmundt will ever appear again?

10370001071._kDes: That won't be easy. He was a genius among geniuses.

10370001072._kDes: Sold out or not, I'll Close Stall when it's time. No need to overdo it.

10370001073._kDes: Yesterday, I devised a new way to arrange my wares. They're easier for customers to pick up, and my sales rate rose by 20%.

10370001074._kDes: Almost there. I'll sell a little longer, then Close Stall for the day.

10370001075._kDes: I still have to cook later. I hope that drunk at home hasn't made a complete mess of the place.

10370001076._kDes: Every Adventurer will find the path that's right for them.

10370001077._kDes: Hey, rookie! Here to take a request?

10370001079._kDes: Adventurer, you're here! Come with me—To the Academy!

10370001081._kDes: Your second Job Advance is a crucial stage in Choosing a Job path. Ask the veterans at the Academy about the unique features of each job branch.

10370001082._kDes: Once you've made your decision, touch the Book of Job Advance.

10370001083._kDes: Hello! Would you like to join us?

10370001084._kDes: I'm a Blacksmith who refines armor and weapons. I can refine the equipment you're wearing—which piece would you like to refine?

10370001085._kDes: Come, come! Hurry and take up a Life Skill! They say skills can change your destiny. You might even become as popular as me! Ohohoho!

10370001086._kDes: Marriage is about looking forward to a happy future. Is there someone you'd like to marry?

10370001087._kDes: If you meet like-minded Adventurers, form an Adventurer Guild together!

10370001088._kDes: I want to create an Adventurer Guild

10370001090._kDes: Would you like to leave the Academy?

10370001094._kDes: Danger ahead. Unauthorized personnel, keep away.

10370001095._kDes: I want to enter the Culvert

10370001096._kDes: Kafra Corporation reminds you: There are many roads, but safety comes first. Reckless driving brings tears to your loved ones. Mind your speed while escorting the wagon—the speed limit is @{1} meters per second.

10370001099._kDes: Every Adventurer is part of the reason the continent of Midgard endures.

10370001101._kDes: Thank You for delivering the Military Supplies!

10370001104._kDes: Please observe proper etiquette when entering the palace.

10370001105._kDes: I want to enter the palace

10370001106._kDes: Would you like to leave the palace?

10370001108._kDes: Would you like to leave the Court of Time?

10370001109._kDes: You are carrying ${1} supplies, which will add ${2} Military Supplies to the Guild. Submit them all?

10370001117._kDes: Only the brave can become Adventurers.

10370001118._kDes: *Sigh* The child's all grown up and still such a handful!

10370001119._kDes: Hello! Would you like to board the airship?

10370001120._kDes: Are you the Adventurer who came to help?

10370001121._kDes: We field researchers go anywhere we can reach.

10370001123._kDes: It's our duty to help residents in need.

10370001124._kDes: When will I finally become a proper Swordsman?

10370001130._kDes: Destiny will guide you where you need to go.

10370001132._kDes: (All you hear is the clash of blades.)

10370001133._kDes: Would you like me to test which job suits you best?

10370001134._kDes: Getting enough rest is very important.

10370001135._kDes: It looks like an ordinary chest.

10370001136._kDes: Hehe! Bobo is the cutest Poring in the whole world!

10370001138._kDes: We make our living buying and selling goods.

10370001139._kDes: I still need to earn a fortune to make my wish come true.

10370001140._kDes: I hope the caravan has a safe and smooth journey.

10370001141._kDes: These woods are perfect for hunting.

10370001142._kDes: This mission is sure to go smoothly!

10370001143._kDes: Whoa, finally, a new mission! I can't wait!

10370001145._kDes: Why is the Knight Guild holding a ball? Fighting would be way more fun.

10370001146._kDes: Animal headwear still sells best. Guess there are a lot of furry fans out there.

10370001147._kDes: Thank you for asking me to dance. The truth is, I've liked you for a long time.

10370001149._kDes: Hoho! It's been ages since the Knights joined an event like this. What a lively celebration!

10370001150._kDes: This is my first ball. I'm a little nervous...

10370001151._kDes: Haha, buddy! Couldn't find a dance partner either?

10370001152._kDes: Ahem. It's the taking part that counts. The taking part.

10370001153._kDes: I want to get stronger faster.

10370001155._kDes: Ugh, when will I finally get a good night's sleep...?

10370001156._kDes: At my age, I never thought I'd be made a fool of by a White Mouse. Sigh.
