10370001157._kDes: Nothing matters more than making money. What, a conscience? Hah! Can I sell it?

10370001158._kDes: Step right up! Get your freshly forged weapons here!

10370001159._kDes: Ask not what your guild can do for you. Ask what you can contribute to the guild storage.

10370001160._kDes: The Guild Leader led another team to defeat an incredibly powerful monster today! Amazing!

10370001161._kDes: I'm exhausted. I want to sleep...

10370001162._kDes: Shh... I'm calculating this week's profits. Let's see, we sold @{1} potions...

10370001163._kDes: What could possibly matter more than family? I just don't understand Hawk.

10370001164._kDes: My poor child, please come home.

10370001165._kDes: It's time he tried out my new washboard!

10370001167._kDes: Oh, my spellbook! Where in the world have you gone?

10370001169._kDes: Quit dawdling! We're going to pull off a big score this time!

10370001170._kDes: Hmph. Today's plan is flawless!... Probably.

10370001171._kDes: Those two idiots always make Easy things complicated. If we want to pull off something big, it's up to me.

10370001172._kDes: Welcome! Would you like to buy a bouquet?

10370001173._kDes: Lady Irmata is the most exalted of all.

10370001174._kDes: (Claps softly) That dance wasn't bad~ As for what Boya likes... When she was little, I think she especially loved fluffy things, particularly... ones with long ears? Ah! The church bells are ringing. It's my turn to patrol. (Smirks slyly) ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, good luck!

10370001176._kDes: Those dance moves... Did you learn them from a drunken Orc? (Smooths her skirt and offers her hand again) Still... since you're trying so hard. (Winks) How about one more chance? This time, focus and follow my rhythm, okay?

10370001177._kDes: Take her hand (Click to dance again)

10370001178._kDes: Are you ready to begin the competition?

10370001179._kDes: You'll have to meet my requirements before you can Trade with me.

10370001180._kDes: I hope this journey goes smoothly.

10370001183._kDes: What are you staring at me for? Hurry up and get this dog away from me!

10370001184._kDes: There sure have been a lot of petty thieves around lately. What is the world coming to?

10370001185._kDes: My luck has been terrible lately...

10370001186._kDes: If this keeps up, is our caravan going to go bankrupt?

10370001187._kDes: Once I catch that thief, they'll be sorry!

10370001188._kDes: Honestly, I think I should've come sooner. I'm the most talented of my generation!

10370001189._kDes: I earned First Place in my local assessment. I have no reason to be nervous.

10370001190._kDes: When my family saw me off, my dad said, "Work hard out there, and don't embarrass our village."

10370001191._kDes: Ever since I was chosen, I've been wondering which class to choose. For 3 months, I've changed my answer every day. Today, the moment of truth is finally here.

10370001192._kDes: An aura of ^{1}${1}^{2} is emanating from the rift. The Rift Stone may warp us to an entirely new location. Please be prepared.

10370001193._kDes: I need a little more time to prepare.

10370001195._kDes: Hello. I'm the Teleport Station Attendant.

10370001197._kDes: You finally found it. We're one step closer to that day...

10370001200._kDes: Hmm... There are still mysteries left unsolved. Talk to other Adventurers, and you may find the answers you seek.

10370001204._kDes: The incomplete movement is too difficult to decipher. Irmata's divine revelation came to you in a dream. Search every corner of ^{1}${1}^{2} City, and you may discover something. If your search proves fruitless, try asking other Adventurers for advice.

10370001205._kDes: Can you feel it? The echoes hidden throughout the world still resonate with the soul... You have solved one of the riddles. Once you have all the answers, you will be able to play the forgotten movement.

10370001206._kDes: Adventurer, there are still more notes to decipher. If your search leads nowhere, try asking your companions. They may be able to offer some insight.

10370001207._kDes: Hello. The escort mission isn't available yet.

10370001208._kDes: A new note! By Irmata, I seek not truth, but that which lies within the mist... Never mind. Please continue your search, Adventurer.

10370001209._kDes: What a beautiful note! Let the melody ring out, from one moment to the next.

10370001210._kDes: Congratulations on clearing this stage! When you're ready, head forward to the next stage.

10370001212._kDes: Whoa... We're Flying s-so high! The houses below look like tiny dots...

10370001213._kDes: Is this wreck going to fall out of the sky? The wind's so strong, it's going to blow away Bobo's precious feathers!

10370001214._kDes: Hey, Master! Hold on to me tight! If Bobo falls, there'll be no one left to wake you up!

10370001215._kDes: ...But the clouds here really do look like cotton candy. I wish I could take a bite...

10370001216._kDes: The skies are calm. It's perfect weather for Flying. Thank You for your protection, Goddess Freyja.

10370001217._kDes: The White Dove has been my trusty companion for years. She may fly steady now, but she once saved my life in a storm.

10370001218._kDes: This route used to be the Life line of merchant caravans. Now... those damn air pirates have made it anything but peaceful.

10370001219._kDes: They've defiled the freedom of flight. Someday, they'll pay for it.

10370001220._kDes: Check the securing ropes three times, and keep your weapon within reach. Those are the rules.

10370001222._kDes: Remember, never let your guard down. The sky is every bit as dangerous as the land.

10370001223._kDes: Hey, rookie! How's it feel? This view is amazing, isn't it?

10370001224._kDes: Hahaha! Judging by your face, you must be nervous about your first airship ride. Relax—I've got your back!

10370001225._kDes: Once we reach the desert, I'll show you a real sunrise over the sea of sand. Now that's a magnificent sight!

10370001226._kDes: When night falls, we'll camp atop the dunes, and I'll treat you to the strongest desert ale around!

10370001228._kDes: It's finally over. Without your help, I probably would've gone down with this swarm of Chonchons today.

10370001230._kDes: My injury isn't serious, but it's making the helm difficult to operate. If anything unexpected happens during the rest of the journey, I'll need you to take over.

10370001232._kDes: Don't worry. The airship has an automatic cruise Function. Human intervention is only needed in special circumstances, so just follow my instructions.

10370001238._kDes: Welcome to the Bonfire Party! The event consists of @{1} stages. Stage @{2} is the preparation stage, during which Adventurers can collect Live Coals scattered throughout the territory and add them to the Bonfire to earn rewards. Stages @{3}-@{4} are the main party stages, during which Adventurers can defeat mischievous monsters to earn rewards and enter the prize drawing.

10370001243._kDes: You must be the Job Advance candidates recommended by the villages and towns. Welcome, everyone! Keep going and complete the Novice Trial, then you'll be able to enter Prontera for your Job Advance. Good luck!

10370001244._kDes: The Novice Trial is Easy. Complete ^{1}two Basic Quests^{2} to prove you have the potential for a Regular job. Then you'll receive certification and can head to Prontera for your Job Advance.

10370001245._kDes: Your First Quests is to Defeat ^{1}@{1} Nearby Porings^{2}. They don't have much ATK, but Beginners should still approach them with caution.

10370001246._kDes: Of course we finished it! But ^{1}PlayerName^{2} is hurt! What do we do? Please help us!

10370001247._kDes: Don't worry. Take this Red Potion. Remember to restore your HP promptly in the Field, and don't let You become Weak.

10370001248._kDes: Exactly! You need to take care of yourself, or who'll protect me...

10370001249._kDes: Not bad. You've recovered nicely. It looks like you've mastered how to use Healing on You.

10370001250._kDes: Next, I'll teach you how to Learn New Skills so you'll be prepared for more advanced Challenges.

10370001251._kDes: Mmm, you're a quick learner. More skills will become available after you successfully Job Advance, so remember to Learn new skills often and keep improving.

10370001252._kDes: All right, your second Trial Quests is to Defeat ^{1}@{1} Fabres^{2}. These monsters are more dangerous, so stay safe.

10370001253._kDes: You mean those Green, hairy bugs? Gross... ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, don't hit them too hard. If you splatter bug juice on me, I'll never forgive you.

10370001254._kDes: Hehe~ Let's go complete your Job Advance! I can't believe you're this strong. I sure know how to spot talent~

10370001255._kDes: Thousands of years ago, the continent of Midgard suffered an unprecedented catastrophe. The Demon King Morroc invaded, while the colossal World Serpent Jormungand sought to devour the world.

10370001256._kDes: At that moment, the ancestors of the Rune Kingdom's seven royal families rose to the challenge. Aiding them were 6 exceptional Warriors from various jobs. Together, they Defeated the Demon and protected the continent.

10370001257._kDes: Touch the Book of Job Advance ahead and choose the path that's right for You.

10370001258._kDes: Excellent. From this day forward, you officially walk your own path. Remember, this is only the beginning.

10370001259._kDes: Great! ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, now we can finally start adventuring to our hearts' content!

10370001260._kDes: Not so fast. Your Job Advance granted you Newfound Power, but you must learn to understand and master it.

10370001261._kDes: Take some time to familiarize You with your new skills. They'll be the most reliable Weapon on your future adventures.

10370001262._kDes: Well done. You've grasped your new skills faster than I expected.

10370001263._kDes: However, the power of your skills comes from within. Only a stronger physique or deeper magical power will let you use these techniques to their fullest potential.

10370001264._kDes: Yeah, yeah, I know! Fancy tricks aren't enough. You're only strong if you put your STR to good use!

10370001265._kDes: Every ^{1}Level-up^{2} grants new ^{3}Stat Points^{4}. How you distribute them will directly determine your future growth.

10370001266._kDes: Now, complete your first Stat Distribution based on your job's strengths.

10370001267._kDes: Excellent. It seems you've learned to control your own STR. That's the foundation of becoming a Qualified Adventurer.

10370001268._kDes: My instruction in Prontera ends here. True growth requires You to hone your skills out in the wider world.

10370001269._kDes: Find the Eden Group Trial Officer ^{1}outside the South Gate^{2}. They'll have Quests suitable for Beginners.

10370001270._kDes: Hehe, now that we're this strong, the next set of Quests will be a piece of cake!

10370001271._kDes: Hello, we meet again. You seem much more composed than before. It appears you've successfully completed your Job Advance.

10370001272._kDes: Here's a Basic commission for you: clear out @{1} monsters Nearby the South Gate. Also, take this Weapon Box provided by the Eden Group for Beginner Adventurers.

10370001273._kDes: Wow, new equipment! The Eden Group is pretty generous. Hurry and choose something that feels right~

10370001274._kDes: Equip your new Weapon, and you can begin your commission. Stay safe.

10370001275._kDes: Oh? You've obtained new equipment. That was faster than expected. When adventuring in the Field, knowing when to Change Equipment based on the situation is key to becoming stronger.

10370001276._kDes: Each piece of equipment has different Affixes. You'll need to figure out how to combine them into the best Preset to get the most out of your gear. Open the equipment screen and take a closer look.

10370001277._kDes: Affixes? That sounds so technical... Come on! Let's check them out!

10370001278._kDes: Looks like you've gotten the hang of changing equipment. Every Adventurer on this continent grows stronger by acquiring equipment through adventures and Battle. Make sure you carefully consider which equipment suits you best.

10370001279._kDes: This advanced equipment was prepared for you by the Eden Group. It includes a Weapon and Armor, so be sure to Receive it. You'll need this gear for your upcoming assignments.

10370001280._kDes: Wow, this set looks way better than the last one! Put it on and let me see~

10370001281._kDes: Good. Looks like you've changed your equipment.

10370001282._kDes: Hehe, clothes really do make the Adventurer. You look much more reliable now!

10370001283._kDes: You're just one step away from taking on higher-level assignments. Here, this Mount will greatly improve your Move speed, making long journeys much easier.

10370001284._kDes: A-A free Mount? Hurry and Receive it!

10370001285._kDes: Come on, try to Ride your Mount!

10370001286._kDes: You handle that Mount well. It looks like you're Ready to take on more advanced assignments. So tell me, what Difficulty would you like to start your adventure with?

10370001287._kDes: Do you even have to ask? The hardest one, obviously~ Like taking on Morroc alone or raiding the lair of that Jormun-whatever!

10370001288._kDes: Unfortunately, Morroc's seal remains secure, and Jormungandr has long since vanished from this world. However, there is an urgent assignment in Payon that requires attention.

10370001289._kDes: Eden Group Headquarters is recruiting Elite Adventurers to provide Utility support. Leave immediately and find Eden Group Instructor Boya in Payon. Tell her you're the candidate I Suggested.

10370001290._kDes: Hehe, I knew it wouldn't be that Easy! Since we've got a long trip ahead, this is the perfect chance to see how fast the new Mount can go!

10370001291._kDes: Hey there, rookie. What is it?

10370001293._kDes: Oh? So you're the rookie she Suggested? You certainly look eager.

10370001294._kDes: But let me warn you first: this Quest won't be Easy. We need to gather some Rare Materials. Seriously, some people will exploit any crisis—

10370001295._kDes: Complaining won't solve anything, Boya. We have no Other choice.

10370001296._kDes: I'll prepare for the final Quest. You two head to Southern Payon and gather the Other Materials. We don't have much time.

10370001297._kDes: Fine, fine, we'll do it your way. Rookie, I'll meet you in Southern Payon!

10370001298._kDes: Perfect timing. Let's tackle the first Quest—getting a few fresh Snake Gallbladders from the Boas.

10370001299._kDes: There's a pack of Boas in the Nearby forest, and each one has a nasty Venom Sting. They may be small, but one bite will leave you in agony. Be careful not to get bitten.

10370001300._kDes: What? They're that venomous? What if we get bitten?! It's way too dangerous to send a rookie like ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

10370001301._kDes: If you want to become an experienced Adventurer, you need EXP handling unexpected situations in the Field. Go on. Once you've gathered everything, meet us up ahead.

10370001302._kDes: That was fast. Looks like you did well on the Battle assessment. You didn't let me down.

10370001303._kDes: Now that we have the Snake Gallbladders, let's not waste any time. Next, we need to collect some Tree Bark from the Willows in the forest ahead. Those old things are tough, so put some muscle into your swings.

10370001304._kDes: I'll wait up ahead. Once you have the Tree Bark, hurry over. Don't drag your feet, or certain people might change their minds again...

10370001305._kDes: Haha! I knew something this Easy wouldn't stop you. You stripped that Tree Bark off nice and clean. Looks like you're pretty handy with that Two-Handed Axe!

10370001306._kDes: That's two Materials down. The last one will be the hardest—go steal the Snake King's egg for me. The Boas around here are extremely aggressive. The Snake King's nest should be hidden in the grass just up ahead.

10370001307._kDes: Wait a minute~ Why are we always charging in while you stand back here playing Commander?

10370001308._kDes: Uh... What would a Shorty like you know? I have to stay here and guard these two Materials. What if someone steals them? Besides, don't worry. If those snakes surround you, I'll charge in and rescue you immediately!

10370001309._kDes: Enough Chitchat. Get going. Bring the egg back as soon as you have it. We need to deliver everything to that crooked merchant before dark, because I'm not spending the night in this miserable forest.

10370001310._kDes: Hey! Where were you when those snakes surrounded us? You said you'd charge in and rescue us immediately, but I bet you just wanted to stand there and watch!

10370001311._kDes: Ahem, well... You two were working together so well that rushing in might've thrown off your rhythm... Yes, exactly!

10370001312._kDes: Oh, stop complaining. Look, you picked up a Card: Poring! Wow, that's a great find! It can grant your equipment unexpected STR.

10370001313._kDes: Hurry and equip it. Let's see if it can toughen you up, so you don't hit the ground before I can act next time. Go on, and don't dawdle.

10370001314._kDes: Yes, yes! The moment you slot in that Card, you look completely different! It's like giving a tiger wings! You won't even need to worry about little dangers like that anymore! Hahahaha!

10370001315._kDes: Hmph. Don't think this will make me forget how you stood by and did nothing...

10370001316._kDes: Ahem! That was... tactical observation! All right, all right. We have all the Materials, so let's get down to business.

10370001317._kDes: The final step is also the hardest. We need to find Eddga in the Deep Forest of Payon Forest! He's the ruler of this region, so stay sharp. Let's Move out and regroup in Payon Forest.

10370001318._kDes: Perfect timing. Listen up: Eddga isn't some Savage wandering by the roadside. He's the fiercest beast in this region. Tracking him won't be Easy, so we'll need to split up and search.

10370001319._kDes: Take this. It's a Fly Wing, and it'll make finding Eddga much easier. It'll save you from running yourself ragged, so use it a few times and search every patch of grass!

10370001320._kDes: You haven't used one before, have you? A Fly Wing can randomly Teleport You to another location within this area.

10370001321._kDes: Eddga is extremely dangerous. If you find him, don't Approach. Wait for us to meet up with You.

10370001322._kDes: Hey, with how scary you're making him sound, you're not planning to have the two of us take on that big cat alone once we find him, are you?

10370001323._kDes: Hahaha! What are you afraid of? I'm here! Even if it costs me my life, I won't let you die before me. All right, Move out. Signal us the moment you find him.

10370001324._kDes: Where did you come from? I've claimed this whole territory! If you want to hunt, go somewhere else!

10370001326._kDes: Nicely done! You went head-to-head with that monster, and you've clearly got some real skill. I knew Rhine was right about You. You've definitely got what it takes to become Elite!

10370001327._kDes: Your Battle skills are solid, and you remain calm under pressure. Since you obtained the Tiger Pelt, you've proven your Eligibility to undertake higher-Difficulty Quests.

10370001328._kDes: Hey, we could use a strong, reliable partner like You. So, are you interested in Joining us?

10370001329._kDes: Would you two stop conducting an interview over there? I'm still here! Did you forget that idiot almost got swatted away by Eddga?

10370001330._kDes: Haha, you really know how to hold a grudge, Shorty. But this is no time for Chitchat. We need to hurry back to Payon and deliver these items to that crooked merchant.

10370001331._kDes: Agreed. We should leave as soon as possible to prevent any further complications.

10370001332._kDes: All done! Here are the @{1} snake eggs, @{2} portions of Tree Bark, @{3} Snake King eggs, and @{4} Tiger Pelts you asked for. Hand over the tickets—we're in a hurry.

10370001333._kDes: Tsk... This Tree Bark is badly damaged, isn't it? And these Snake Gallbladders are too small. I think the price we agreed on was a little too high. As for these tickets... I'm afraid you'll have to pay extra.

10370001334._kDes: Hey, ^{1}PlayerName^{2} worked really hard to get all this!

10370001335._kDes: You're deliberately finding fault with everything! We risked our lives to get these, and now you're telling us this?

10370001336._kDes: Boya, calm down. Sir, a contract is a contract. What you're doing is dishonorable.

10370001337._kDes: Hurry up! My patience is wearing thin! Short us even one more ticket, and I'll break your legs!

10370001338._kDes: Don't... Don't kill me! I'll give them to you! Right now!

10370001339._kDes: Hmph! Serves you right! Weren't you acting all clever just now? Why are you cowering like a turtle now? Hand over the tickets, or I'll claw your face to ribbons!

10370001340._kDes: Here... This is everything! They're tickets for the White Dove, and they're absolutely real! Please, Warriors, have mercy and let me go...

10370001341._kDes: Smart choice! Try anything like that again, and I'll chop your stall into firewood.

10370001342._kDes: Ptooey! What a crooked merchant, bullying the weak and cowering before the strong...

10370001343._kDes: He hasn't learned a thing! If Boya's sword had veered off course just now, I'd like to see if he could still act so smug!

10370001344._kDes: Don't be so reckless next time. He may have been in the wrong, but if anything had happened to him, it would've cost us even more time.

10370001345._kDes: There's no reasoning with a crooked merchant like that. All right, we have the tickets. We can set out now.

10370001346._kDes: Oh, right. This Butterfly Wing is for you. You must be tired after getting back, so use it to Teleport directly to Prontera. Then Return to Town and report to Captain Aikuni. After that, we'll be ready to depart.

10370001347._kDes: Wow, will this let me fly? Boya, give me one too!

10370001348._kDes: Hehe, that was the last one. Next time. Next time.

10370001349._kDes: Hello, Adventurer. Is there something you need?

10370001350._kDes: Boya sent me to see you.

10370001351._kDes: I see. You must be the new recruit who helped them get the tickets, right?

10370001352._kDes: Oh? So you're the one. Boya has mentioned you several times in her letters.

10370001354._kDes: Curious, are you? She asked me to help you grow stronger, since we have an important commission for you later.

10370001355._kDes: I hear you've acquired the Equipment Forging manual. Excellent. Go see Blacksmith Hollgrehenn immediately and Enhance your Weapon and Armor until they glow.

10370001356._kDes: Wow, that's strict! We just defeated Eddga and haven't even caught our breath, and now we already have new Quests?

10370001357._kDes: Hahaha! Tough love is good for you, young one. Being too lenient only does harm, understand? Hollgrehenn is the finest craftsman in the Rune Kingdom. Off you go. I hope to see you return Fully Armed.

10370001358._kDes: Hey! You must be the new recruit Captain Aikuni mentioned. I hear you accomplished something impressive in Payon. Welcome!

10370001359._kDes: The Captain already told me you obtained the latest Crafting Blueprint. But if you want to turn it into real gear worthy of accompanying you on your adventures, you'll need to use Equipment Forging.

10370001360._kDes: Don't worry. The Craft process is Easy. Once you have all the required Material, I guarantee I'll make you the sturdiest equipment in all Prontera!

10370001361._kDes: Beautiful! That sheen, that feel—this is top-quality work. With my craftsmanship and your Material, you can't go wrong.

10370001362._kDes: Wow, it definitely looks way more impressive now~

10370001363._kDes: If you obtain a higher-grade blueprint later, be sure to Craft new equipment right away. For an Adventurer, a good set of equipment can mean the difference between life and death.

10370001364._kDes: That gear looks good. Seems Hollgrehenn didn't slack off this time. Now that your equipment is ready, there's only one thing left that might help you—

10370001365._kDes: Take these Adventurer Guides. They Record the wisdom gained by the Rune Kingdom's greatest heroes throughout the ages. Whenever you have No idea. where to go or lack the resources to grow stronger, open them up. They'll point you in the right direction.

10370001366._kDes: Go. Follow the Guides to improve your skills. Once you've mastered these Basic fundamentals, I'll have a top-secret commission of the utmost importance for you.

10370001367._kDes: Excellent work. It seems you've made the most of those Guides. Even among all the members I've trained, such rapid progress is rare.

10370001368._kDes: I'll explain the details of that top-secret commission later. For now, we need to head to Izlude and board the airship.

10370001369._kDes: An airship? You mean one of those huge ships that races through the clouds, where you can feel the breeze and enjoy the view from the deck? We're taking one on our adventure?

10370001370._kDes: That's right, little one. But this isn't a Normal outing. We're going to Complete the Commission, and we may face all kinds of danger along the way.

10370001371._kDes: Boya and Wule are already in Izlude making preparations to board. Pack your things, bring your new equipment, and meet us in Izlude.

10370001372._kDes: You're here. Perfect timing. Let me introduce you. This is Alton, Captain of the White Dove. We'll be relying on his enormous vessel to take us to the desert.

10370001373._kDes: Don't call it an "enormous vessel." This is a precision machine. We were supposed to take off in half an hour, but now... 30% of the cargo hold is still empty.

10370001374._kDes: Huh? 30%? Has someone not arrived yet?

10370001375._kDes: That space belongs to the Ash Caravan. Their people aren't all here, and their cargo hasn't been loaded. I can't take off early just for the few of you. It would violate shipping Rules.

10370001376._kDes: Tch. Of all the times for this to happen. Alton, are any members of the Ash Caravan Nearby? Let's ask around and find out what's going on. We don't have time to waste at this port.

10370001377._kDes: I believe there's one near the fountain. Go ask them yourselves. I'll inspect the engine. Send me a Notification as soon as you learn anything.

10370001378._kDes: It's over... It's all over... What am I going to do...?

10370001380._kDes: A-Are you with the Eden Group? Help Me! The airship is about to depart, but our Party Leader and all our cargo ran into trouble over by the Desert Crossroads!

10370001381._kDes: Trouble? Don't tell me those Peco Pecos carried them off?

10370001382._kDes: Exactly! The Peco Pecos abducted our Party Leader, while the remaining cargo was scattered everywhere and made a complete mess by the Mukas. There's nobody to guard it, and we don't have enough people to handle everything...

10370001383._kDes: Please, can you help us? We really don't have any time left...

10370001384._kDes: Thank You! Thank you so much!

10370001385._kDes: All right, All right! Another errand, just as expected. Let's go!

10370001386._kDes: Finally! I thought that fat bird was going to carry me off as a snack. Thank You, Adventurer.

10370001387._kDes: Huh? Who are you? Did the Peco Pecos capture you too?

10370001388._kDes: This is for you. Consider it a token of my gratitude and... something to help you recognize Me the next time we meet.

10370001389._kDes: Whoa, whoa, whoa! You're a strange Woman! Giving us a gift the first time we meet? This isn't some kind of trick, is it?

10370001390._kDes: Oh? An Adventurer encounters a beautiful Woman in distress, and she rewards her rescuer with a treasure—isn't that a common enough tale? There's no need to make such a fuss.

10370001391._kDes: The Woman thrusts the item into your hand before you have a chance to Reject it.

10370001392._kDes: All right, All right, go ahead and Receive it~ I'm no villain, merely a wandering Bard.

10370001394._kDes: Oh my, this poor man is still waiting for you to wake him. Why are you so curious about Me? I must be going, but we'll meet again very soon.

10370001395._kDes: Strange... Why does she feel so familiar...?

10370001396._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, she may have been acting all mysterious... but I can't shake the feeling that she's known you for a very long time. Oh well. Let's check on that Party Leader first. As for this compass... You should hold on to it for now.

10370001397._kDes: Oh my... I thought I was about to become lunch for those baby Peco Pecos! Those big-beaked little brats kept squawking in my ears and pecking me all over! It was terrifying!

10370001398._kDes: Ahem... Anyway, I really can't Thank You enough. If you hadn't arrived when you did, I'd probably be a skeleton picked clean in that nest by now.

10370001399._kDes: Now that you're all right, let's hurry back. The airship has been waiting for you for ages!

10370001400._kDes: You're right. It was all my fault... Once we get back and organize the cargo, we'll be ready to take off. Let's return to Izlude first. I promise I'll reward you handsomely when we get there!

10370001402._kDes: Of course! How thoughtful of you to ask. I'll be waiting at the harbor, Adventurer. See you there.

10370001403._kDes: We had a little mishap in the desert... Ahem, but our caravan has an excellent Reputation. As soon as we stack this cargo neatly, we can board and depart!

10370001404._kDes: Come, kindhearted Adventurer—^{1}PlayerName^{2}, are you Ready? Let's arrange the cargo together.

10370001406._kDes: Excellent work, rookie. Thanks to your help, we can take off immediately.

10370001407._kDes: Time is short, so I'll get straight to the point. Our mission is to travel to Sograt Desert and Find the missing Professor Ryan.

10370001408._kDes: We'll take the White Dove cargo airship to Morroc, at the entrance to the desert. If there's anything else you'd like to know, ask me now.

10370001409._kDes: What's so special about the White Dove?

10370001412._kDes: Good eye! The White Dove belongs to Valkyrie Airlines and symbolizes the partnership between the Church State and the Republic. It's officially a cargo ship, but it still has a passenger cabin, making it perfect for teams like ours that need to keep a low profile.

10370001413._kDes: His safety is the Quests' highest priority.

10370001414._kDes: That's why we must find him and ensure his safety.

10370001415._kDes: So don't worry so much. Just follow Me, and I'll bring all of you back safely.

10370001416._kDes: All right, no more questions, right? Take your ticket, rookie. Get ready to board.

10370001417._kDes: Oh, right! I almost forgot to give you a Talent Stone! If we run into trouble up there, you'll need some way to defend yourself. This thing will be a huge help, so take it.

10370001418._kDes: All right. Please gather your belongings and board immediately.

10370001419._kDes: Wah... You big dummy! You scared Bobo half to death! Bobo thought you'd hurt your head!

10370001420._kDes: Yes. I'm trying to Find someone. Have you seen a scholar named Ryan Recent? He wears glasses, has terrible eyesight, and is very refined.

10370001421._kDes: Ryan... Glasses, poor eyesight... Is he from Payon? Did he also study abroad in Juno?

10370001422._kDes: He's been staying at the camp for the past week, leaving early and returning late every day. Oh! I even said hello to him before he left this morning. He headed west^{2} of the camp at dawn with his equipment^{1}, saying he was looking for something called [Memory Particles]. He's so stubborn—he wouldn't listen when I told him to find someone to help.

10370001423._kDes: I'll leave the Find the Professor Quests to you for now. I need to report the White Dove's major accident to headquarters. Once that's taken care of, I'll rejoin you.

10370001424._kDes: Come on, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. It's time for the two of us to shine again.

10370001425._kDes: Phew... Finally, some peace and quiet. Thank You, my friend. These desert Chonchons are even more annoying than monsters. I've never seen you Nearby before. Are you new here?

10370001427._kDes: Yes. We're looking for a middle-aged man with glasses and Yellow hair. Have you seen him?

10370001428._kDes: Was he wearing a suit, too? Someone like that really stands out around here. About two hours ago, I saw him heading west—toward Ant Hell.

10370001429._kDes: Ant Hell? Just hearing that gives me the creeps. What's that old guy doing in a horrible place like that?

10370001430._kDes: Wait, did that Pet of yours just talk? My goodness! Is it a Poring mutant, or perhaps a highly intelligent Demon? It's an invaluable specimen for live dissection... No, for academic research!

10370001431._kDes: What are you staring at, you weirdo?! Don't Approach Me! And... I'm not his Pet!

10370001432._kDes: Hold still! Let Me measure your head circumference and the frequency of those wingbeats! I've never seen such an intelligent Deviling...

10370001433._kDes: Let's go! This guy's crazy. The Professor went that way, so let's get out of here!

10370001434._kDes: You didn't Find him? That old man is as slippery as a desert snake. I also sent a seasoned Adventurer to search Nearby Ant Hell. It's no place for rookies to wander around.

10370001435._kDes: I'll send you a Notification if I Discover a Clue. For now, stay by the campfire and don't wander off.

10370001436._kDes: You know, the true core of your Second Job combat power lies in the new skills you've acquired.

10370001437._kDes: Whoa! There are more new moves to learn? Like Summon a giant storm with one wave of your hand, or stomp so hard that Ant Hell collapses?

10370001438._kDes: Mastering your job takes steady effort. If you want to become a renowned Adventurer, you must start by mastering your new Second Job skills.

10370001439._kDes: Excellent. It seems you've fully grasped the essence of your new power. Knowing how to review and Allocate Skill Points. shows that you're beginning to think like a true Adventurer.

10370001440._kDes: But mastering skills isn't enough. After your Second Job, the new ^{1}[Talent]^{2} System has been unlocked. Go—this is the key to determining the limits of your abilities.

10370001441._kDes: You're back? The scout I sent just returned. They found Professor Ryan's Footprints on the first floor of Ant Hell. He should be inside, but we still don't know his exact location.

10370001442._kDes: Ugh, that place sounds terrifying. Let's wait for Boya and Wuhler to return, then go together.

10370001443._kDes: Those two are probably fighting Phreeoni Nearby, so I doubt they can get away.

10370001444._kDes: I shouldn't send a rookie like you, but you've just completed your Job Advance and seem capable. The Professor can't defend himself, so every second counts.

10370001445._kDes: Do you want to go? It's your call. But if any ants bite Me, I'm setting the whole cave on fire...

10370001447._kDes: Brave of you. That's an Eden Group member for you. If you're in danger inside Ant Hell, ask Fiennes for help. You've met before.

10370001448._kDes: Look! I think there's something on the ground!

10370001449._kDes: Could it belong to the Professor? Hurry, let's take a look.

10370001450._kDes: Hey! You're Professor Ryan, right? Are you okay?

10370001451._kDes: Hey there! Good to see you again.

10370001453._kDes: I'm the poor sap Hawke sent to Find the Professor and collect samples along the way. Allow Me to introduce myself. My name is Fiennes, and I'm an alchemy scholar.

10370001454._kDes: My goodness... You saw that, didn't you? Magnificent! Was that Maya's mimicry transformation? She actually assumed the form of a human woman! This is a miracle of monster biology!

10370001455._kDes: Hey, you have time to study this?! That giant ant freak carried off the Professor as emergency rations! We have to save him!

10370001456._kDes: Easy, easy—hear Me out. Ant Hell is really just the outer edge of the ant nest. Maya lives in its deepest reaches, where her brood chamber is also located.

10370001457._kDes: The passages there form a complicated maze, so you'll never Find the entrance on your own. But... a [Pathfinder Ant] can smell Maya's unique pheromones. Follow it, and it'll lead you straight to her lair.

10370001458._kDes: Here's the plan: take out a few Nearby ants and bring Me fragments of their bodies. Any Material will do! I'll catalyze it with alchemy and make you an obedient Pathfinder Ant.

10370001459._kDes: We're gathering Material again? Will this really work? Can the Professor hold out that long...?

10370001460._kDes: Trust in science, you little devil of a Poring. Hurry back—I guarantee results!

10370001461._kDes: Excellent! This Material is incredibly fresh! Watch closely—this is advanced alchemy!

10370001462._kDes: After a blinding flash and a cloud of acrid smoke, a strange, red-bodied ant with twitching antennae appeared in Phines's hand.

10370001463._kDes: It worked! This is the Pathfinder Ant. When you reach a fork in the road, Release it, and it'll automatically track Maya's pheromones. All you have to do is follow it. Notes: If it crawls into a hole, you'll have to follow it inside.

10370001464._kDes: What? We have to crawl into a hole?! Oh my gosh, it's not going to be full of ants, is it?

10370001465._kDes: It'll definitely be dangerous in there. It is Maya's lair, after all. But... it'd be such a shame if those ants hurt you, little one. By the way, is your Pet for sale? Name your price! I'll even trade you a newly refined, high-grade Pet!

10370001467._kDes: You lunatic! Are you even listening? I already told you I'm not his Pet!

10370001468._kDes: What a terrible waste... Fine, until we meet again. And we will meet again, little Poring. I know we will.

10370001469._kDes: Nicely done. After rescuing someone right from under Maya's nose, you've proven that you have the Eligibility to take on classified Quests of this caliber.

10370001470._kDes: Ahem. Thank You for your help. I made a Record of the Magic fluctuation Data along the way. It'll be very useful for my current research.

10370001471._kDes: All right, as long as everyone's safe. I don't want to spend another second in this wretched place. Pack up—we're returning to camp immediately.

10370001472._kDes: You all go on ahead. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} and I still have something to take care of. We'll return later.

10370001473._kDes: All right. This area is dangerous, so be careful.

10370001474._kDes: Heh-heh, dummy! After seeing how you handled that crisis, I fully acknowledge your strength.

10370001475._kDes: Let's form a pact. Then, whenever danger strikes, we can fight together.

10370001476._kDes: You're back? I heard you pulled the Professor right out of Maya's jaws. Not bad—you've certainly got some serious skills.

10370001477._kDes: Quests complete. Hawke, Thank You for the intelligence and backup.

10370001478._kDes: That's what old friends are for. Oh, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Phines asked me to give you this thing. He called it a "Pet Incubator," but didn't explain how to use it. He just said to return to Prontera and ask a Pet Merchant about it.

10370001479._kDes: That crazy alchemist? He actually gave you a gift? He's not after Me again, is he?

10370001480._kDes: Enough talk. Take it. Now, both of you, Return to Town. Stop standing around in this desert wind.

10370001481._kDes: Let's set out and return to Prontera.

10370001482._kDes: Ha! Didn't expect to see Me again, did you?

10370001483._kDes: Come on, hand me the incubator. This is the latest achievement in monster ecology. Just put an egg inside, adjust the temperature, and you'll soon Hatch a little creature that'll obey your every command.

10370001484._kDes: What kind of dangerous experiment are you running this time? If you Hatch some weird tentacle monster, I'll be the first to burn your shop down!

10370001485._kDes: No, no, no! This alchemical hatching method is all the rage across the entire Midgard continent. Go try it!

10370001486._kDes: Congratulations! You've learned the secret of Pet Hatching.

10370001487._kDes: This isn't just a Normal sidekick. It can help you in Battle, boost your stats, and even accompany you into high-Difficulty towers later on. It's incredibly useful!

10370001488._kDes: But... now that you have a new Pet, why not give Bobo to Me? I promise I'll take good care of Bobo~

10370001489._kDes: Hey, quit bragging! These guys look like a bunch of dimwits. There's no way they're stronger than Me!

10370001490._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're here. Captain Aikuni just sent word that she's swamped with work. From now on, if we need someone to run errands, lend a hand, or venture Into Peril, we're free to send you.

10370001491._kDes: What does she mean by "run errands"? She's gone a little too far.

10370001492._kDes: Quiet! You there—the black... soot sprite. Stay away from my experimental equipment.

10370001493._kDes: I've actually been studying the "Nails of World Law" appearing throughout Prontera. I believe they're connected to Juperos's long-lost "Thought Form" technology. Take a look at this. It's a sample I collected in the Ant Cavern.

10370001494._kDes: Handle it carefully. This is extremely valuable research Material... even if it does look like nothing more than a glowing mass of Magic.

10370001495._kDes: You've already seen the vision the compass showed you, haven't you?

10370001497._kDes: It was a glimpse of the future. But that isn't its only purpose. Keep it safe—it will play an even more important role in the future.

10370001498._kDes: As for everything else... I can't tell you much right now. All I can say is that everything you've experienced so far is merely the first measure of a grand symphony.

10370001499._kDes: And You will be the only one capable of deciding their fate.

10370001500._kDes: This place is beautiful! It's much more comfortable than ^{1}PlayerName^{2}'s Backpack~ But... why does it feel so familiar?

10370001501._kDes: It's almost time. You should go back.

10370001502._kDes: The next time we meet... I hope you'll bring Me a more interesting Story.

10370001503._kDes: Remember—falling is not the end. It is simply another beginning.

10370001504._kDes: What happened to you just now? You suddenly froze like a statue, and you even knocked over and shattered the "Thought Form" storage vial! I thought you'd caught some kind of desert fever...

10370001505._kDes: Sigh... It took me so much effort to extract that sample. Never mind. As long as you're all right. You've had a long day, so go get some rest. I need to reorganize the Data anyway.

10370001506._kDes: It's finally over! Today was even more exhausting than being chased by a Peco Peco! Time to get some rest~

10370001507._kDes: Adventurer, it has been far too long. Your mind and body have undergone a complete transformation since you were an inexperienced novice. At last, the time for your Advance has come.

10370001508._kDes: Since you're Ready, I shall perform the Tier Two Job Advance Ritual and let the power of the gods fully merge with your blood.

10370001509._kDes: Come. With your new job, You will face even greater Challenges.

10370001510._kDes: Congratulations, Adventurer. As of today, you have officially advanced to Trans. 2nd. Greater power brings greater responsibility, and it's time to improve your equipment.

10370001511._kDes: Go see Hollgrehenn. He has a gift from Tritura Academy for every Beginner.

10370001512._kDes: Ha-ha! I knew it was you! Long time no see, Adventurer! I heard you reached Trans. 2nd? Your growth has been nothing short of remarkable!

10370001513._kDes: That's right. Tritura Academy does work with me, so every Adventurer can come here to receive a gift.

10370001514._kDes: It's time for you to Craft your own advanced equipment. Here—this high-grade Material is a gift from the Academy. Use it for practice. Go on, give it a try! I bet you'll Craft a golden Legend!

10370001515._kDes: Unforgivable... The Church clearly promised to protect the research equipment, and look what happened! I spent three years calibrating that precision instrument!

10370001516._kDes: Come now, Professor, please calm down. It's just an instrument. We'll certainly compensate you for it...

10370001517._kDes: Compensate me? How? That was the only prototype on the entire Midgard continent! Without it, my research into the "Nails of World Law" will be set back by at least three years!

10370001518._kDes: Er... this was indeed our oversight. But our investigators have already taken a team to pursue the Clue. Please try to calm down. We'll take responsibility and recover it.

10370001519._kDes: Calm down? I don't believe a word of this irresponsible investigation! If you fail to recover it, which of you can replace years of my Research Results? The only person I trust now is my assistant.

10370001520._kDes: Sigh... Why put yourself through this? Fine, if you insist. We found this at the scene. The thief must have dropped it.

10370001521._kDes: You're the Professor's new assistant, right? Here, take this. This bow tie was left behind at the crime scene as evidence.

10370001522._kDes: Take this to the first floor of the Culvert and meet Fervor, an investigator with the Knight Order. He's a glutton, but he'll definitely be able to track the scent. Now hurry. All this scolding is giving me a headache.

10370001523._kDes: This bow tie... Why does it smell so bad? Don't tell me some Vagrant stole the device. This is going to be a lot of work.

10370001524._kDes: Huh? There's no one Nearby. Where's the investigator?

10370001525._kDes: Why don't we call out his name? Maybe he'll come out when he hears us. What do you think?

10370001528._kDes: I can't believe it... The investigator is a dog! Can that Knight really be trusted?

10370001530._kDes: Okay, okay~ It says it really is an investigator with the Knight Order and that we shouldn't look down on it.

10370001531._kDes: How can you understand a dog's Language?

10370001532._kDes: Good question. No idea. Maybe I'm just exceptionally gifted. After all, I'm the smartest Deviling on the entire continent of Midgard.

10370001534._kDes: It says you have some evidence on you, and it wants to sniff it. It probably means that bow tie, right?

10370001535._kDes: Tsk, tsk. Who left these Clothes here? Look at this fabric—there's barely more than a bandage, and it's covered in cat hair... Just how filthy is the owner? Could the device have been stolen by some sexy cat Demon wearing this?

10370001536._kDes: (Frantically paws at the ground, tail spinning like a propeller, and barks wildly at the vest) Woof, woof, woof! Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

10370001537._kDes: Hmph. It says there's no mistaking the scent. The thief who stole the device left this behind. I hate to admit it, but this border collie really does have a sharp nose.

10370001538._kDes: Since it's so excited, I suppose we can follow our dear investigator. If we follow this scent, we should be able to catch that perverted little thief.

10370001539._kDes: (Presses its nose close to the cardboard box, sniffing frantically and barking urgently) Woof! Woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof!

10370001540._kDes: Oh my gosh! What the heck is this now?! A cardboard box full of sand? What are those little logs inside? Ugh, they stink!

10370001541._kDes: It looks like a litter box.

10370001542._kDes: What??? You mean that's cat poop?!

10370001543._kDes: (Sticks out his tongue, about to lick the "Treasure" in the cardboard box) Woof, woof, woof!

10370001544._kDes: Stop! Fervor, don't you dare! You can't eat that! It's poop! Poop, understand?! Aaaah, I'm going blind!

10370001545._kDes: Is this really a Clue? I bet this dumb dog only tricked us into coming here because he wanted a snack!

10370001546._kDes: Fine... For the sake of that precious device, I'll trust this glutton one last time. Let's go, before I throw up...

10370001547._kDes: (Looks eagerly toward the Teleport portal Nearby) Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

10370001548._kDes: We have to go down another floor? What the heck is at the end of this Culvert...?

10370001549._kDes: Ugh, No idea. Can this dumb dog really be trusted? Let's go... But if there are any more "poop Clues" on this floor, I'm going on strike!

10370001550._kDes: Huh? What's wrong, Fervor? Isn't that just some passerby? Why are you stopping him?

10370001551._kDes: D-Don't bite me! I'm an academic! I'm studying... the population distribution of urban cockroaches! Yes, cockroaches! I'm a cockroach researcher!

10370001554._kDes: It's true! I'm not lying! Oh... I remember now! I put two meat sandwiches in my pockets this morning as bait for giant cockroaches. The smell must have attracted this dog!

10370001555._kDes: Here... give them to it! Just don't let it bite me!

10370001556._kDes: Hey, Fervor! Have you no shame?! You forgot all about the job for two lousy sandwiches? That guy is a criminal!

10370001557._kDes: At least it's Regular food this time. I still haven't forgotten how you snuck a bite of that "chocolate bar" from the litter box. That was so embarrassing.

10370001561._kDes: That's disgusting. It says it isn't full, and... that the sandwiches aren't as Delicious as the "chocolate bar."

10370001562._kDes: Woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof!

10370001563._kDes: Enough about food! You've been eating nonstop this entire time. Are you here to work or hit the buffet? Doesn't the Knight Order feed you?

10370001564._kDes: Fervor, could you please focus on the job? If food distracts you from your work again, I'll... I'll shave off all your fur!

10370001566._kDes: Hey, Fervor, why did you stop again? Did you smell something Delicious this time?

10370001567._kDes: A set of Clothes and a pair of Shoes are lying on the ground. They look kind of familiar...

10370001568._kDes: Huh? The guy vanished and left his Clothes here? What's going on?

10370001570._kDes: Wait... Aren't these the Clothes that guy was wearing? What respectable researcher would come down to this stinking drain, strip off all his Clothes and Shoes, and leave them here? He obviously felt guilty and ran away!

10370001571._kDes: (Spins through the air in fury) I knew that guy was acting suspicious! Forget those stupid sandwiches—he must've stolen something and deliberately used them as bait to throw Fervor off his trail! Fervor, sniff around! Which way did he go?

10370001572._kDes: Meow, meow, meow, meow... Meow, meow!

10370001573._kDes: Huh? No wonder they found us. Louie, Katie says these people have its bow tie! How despicable!

10370001574._kDes: You're the ones who stole the Professor's things! Who's really despicable here?

10370001575._kDes: Everyone, please, calm down~ Why all the hostility? Since we each have something the other party wants, why don't we resolve this in a more Peaceful manner?

10370001576._kDes: Do we have to? Why not just beat them until they lose their memories...?

10370001577._kDes: Allow me to give you a Regular introduction. I am Louie von Schillerkens, a poor soul failed by the current system and... well, the strategic advisor of this little group.

10370001578._kDes: We're willing to give you what you want in exchange. But now that you've Discovered our secret, we can't simply let you leave. How about this...?

10370001579._kDes: Let's play a game. The Rules are Easy. The three of us will hide inside these three Bells, and you'll have to guess where each of us is. Guess correctly, and we'll give you the item. Guess wrong... and you'll have to Join us, starting as our lowest-ranking lackey!

10370001581._kDes: So, in accordance with our Alternate plan, we've decided to move out immediately. Until we meet again~

10370001582._kDes: We've got the bow tie! You can keep that useless piece of junk!

10370001583._kDes: It's back? Oh my gosh... You really brought it back in one piece!

10370001584._kDes: That kind of efficiency would put those idiots in the Knight Order to shame. I knew giving the job to someone reliable would work better than making them fill out a hundred Request forms.

10370001585._kDes: Fortunately, the core parts are intact, but the Control components are slightly misaligned. Go take care of whatever You need to do. I have to start the Repair and calibration immediately, and it'll take at least three days and nights.

10370001586._kDes: That's it? You're just dismissing us? We crawled through filthy sewers and saw things we were never meant to see...

10370001587._kDes: Oh, good work. Um... take your payment. That'll be all.

10370001588._kDes: You're here! I desperately need your help.

10370001589._kDes: The evening before last, a caravan from Juno was attacked by Baphomet Nearby the Hidden Forest. That damned Monster is still occupying the area and blocking the road.

10370001590._kDes: Worse yet, the core part I ordered was on that wagon. Without that component, this instrument is nothing but scrap metal. There's no way to start it.

10370001591._kDes: How absurd! Those church officials guard the Nail of Discipline all day and refuse to let us Approach it, yet they allow Monsters to plunder cargo right under their noses? This is a complete dereliction of duty...

10370001592._kDes: I have no choice but to rely on you, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Of all your Quests, this one is very dangerous, but I can submit a Request to the Rune-Midgarts royal family for a special stipend as your reward. Please bring the part back!

10370001593._kDes: You're here on behalf of Professor Ryan, aren't you? How humiliating... We accepted such a large commission from the Professor, yet couldn't even protect half a wagonload of parts.

10370001594._kDes: That damned Baphomet descended from the sky, and even fighting for our lives did no good. He scattered the cargo everywhere, and now no one dares to retrieve it.

10370001595._kDes: Curse you, Baphomet! If I were only stronger, I'd skin that beast alive!

10370001596._kDes: This is it... the flow Control valve, completely intact! You actually took it back from Baphomet... No, I mean, retrieved it.

10370001597._kDes: Excellent. With this, I can finish the Repair of my device. Meet Me at the Knight Order outpost northeast of the city. I need to perform the final test at the Nail of Discipline.

10370001598._kDes: Hey! That's it? Aren't you going to praise us? We just fought a bull-headed Monster!

10370001599._kDes: Efficiency is a fundamental quality for any scholar. Arriving late could skew the Data... And stop calling it a "bull-headed Monster." That's Baphomet. Its scientific name is "Minotaur." Your terminology is terribly imprecise.

10370001600._kDes: You're here. Perfect timing—the instrument has just finished starting up, so we can begin the field test.

10370001601._kDes: Help Me move this instrument beside the base of the Stone Pillar. Handle it with extreme care.

10370001602._kDes: Once it's in position, we can perform the most critical step. Connect the mechanical flexible arm on top of the machine to the surface of the Stone Pillar. Then it can extract the energy flowing inside the Nail of Discipline.

10370001603._kDes: What exactly is this huge black Stone? Won't making Contact with it harm us?

10370001604._kDes: Enough nonsense! This is a serious experiment! Hurry—the energy window will only last a few minutes. If we miss it, we'll have to wait until tomorrow.

10370001605._kDes: Stop. This is the sealed area surrounding the Nail of Discipline. Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden to Approach.

10370001607._kDes: So you're with that deranged scholar... Hmph. I can't believe they're allowing an outsider from Juno to tamper with something vital to the kingdom's security.

10370001608._kDes: Someone from Juno? Isn't the Professor a scholar of the Rune Kingdom?

10370001609._kDes: He spent more than a decade in Juno studying the principles of Magic, filling his head with dangerous, heretical theories. How does that make him any different from a foreigner? Still, I have my orders, so I won't stop you.

10370001610._kDes: Go on, but be quick and exercise caution when making Contact. If you Destroy this miracle, the consequences will be far beyond anything you can bear.

10370001611._kDes: Hmph. You talk as if you're so responsible, but weren't you the ones who lost the instrument last time?

10370001612._kDes: That was indeed the Knight Order's responsibility. But I'm standing guard now, and I won't allow such a blunder to happen again. Go on and complete your mission as quickly as possible.

10370001613._kDes: My name is Bragis Skjald, a bard... and the chronicler of this timeline's epic.

10370001614._kDes: This timeline is on the verge of destruction, and you're the only one who can resolve this crisis.

10370001615._kDes: It may sound cliché, but the way the Nail of Natural Law responds to you is all the proof we need.

10370001616._kDes: Your compass... It should begin collecting Soul Echoes soon, shouldn't it? They're more important than you realize.

10370001617._kDes: Farewell, my friend. When you're ready, we'll meet again, and I'll tell you more.

10370001618._kDes: Calm down and tell me what happened.

10370001619._kDes: Sir, a strange Stone platform suddenly appeared in the Pyramid area this morning! The Monsters there have also become unusually agitated and extremely aggressive!

10370001620._kDes: Oh? What do you mean by "suddenly appeared"?

10370001621._kDes: Well... it simply materialized out of nowhere, almost as if a divine miracle had descended...

10370001622._kDes: What's causing the Monsters' unusual agitation?

10370001623._kDes: Ever since the stone platform appeared this morning, the Monsters in the Pyramid area have become extremely agitated for some unknown reason. Several Adventurers have already been injured! Our squad was sent to clear them out, but we can't handle them at all!

10370001624._kDes: Understood. Take Me there immediately so I can provide Utility support.

10370001626._kDes: Professor Ryan, we're carrying out official duties. This has nothing to do with you.

10370001627._kDes: I don't care. That thing appeared in exactly the same way as the Nail of Discipline, and at nearly the same time. There must be a connection. I have to investigate immediately.

10370001628._kDes: Why are you looking at Me? Didn't the queen order you to give Me your full cooperation? Is that a problem?

10370001629._kDes: ...Of course not. Fine, you can come with us.

10370001630._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, I'm heading there now. Come over as soon as you have time. I'm sure we'll have plenty of work for you.

10370001631._kDes: Stop! The first floor of the Pyramid has been declared a restricted area. Normal Adventurers are forbidden from entering. It's far too dangerous right now.

10370001632._kDes: The Relic... Are you with the Professor and Knight Isis? That object is deep inside the Pyramid. Ever since it appeared, the Monsters here have been agitated beyond Control.

10370001633._kDes: No worries. We're here specifically to deal with that Relic! I'm not afraid of the Monsters here. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} can definitely drive them away, right?

10370001634._kDes: All right. You're wearing Fine equipment, so you must be capable. In that case, could you do Me a favor? My comrades should be fighting the Monsters Nearby...

10370001636._kDes: If you encounter them inside, Please help them. The Monsters' ATK is absurdly high right now, and I'm afraid they won't last much longer!

10370001637._kDes: Thank You so much, Adventurer. I've marked the Relic's approximate location for you. Be careful.

10370001638._kDes: Thank You for your help! No idea what has gotten into these Drainliars, but they've become terrifyingly aggressive... It's too dangerous here. You should turn back immediately.

10370001639._kDes: Go back? You've got to be kidding! We're old man Ryan's assistants, and we're here specifically to protect him. Monsters at this level are no problem at all~

10370001640._kDes: Oh... You're with the scholar who came with the Knight? No wonder you're so confident. If you're determined to move Forward, then Please be careful. Ever since that glowing object appeared, every Monster in the Pyramid has gone Berserk, as if they'd been guzzling strong liquor.

10370001641._kDes: Which direction is the Relic? Could you mark it on our map? Thank You!

10370001642._kDes: Understood. I've marked the direction of the Relic on your map. Good luck, Adventurer... May Odin be with you.

10370001643._kDes: Th-Thank You! Why would you venture into a place like this? The entire Pyramid is under lockdown. It's extremely dangerous here!

10370001644._kDes: We're here to protect Professor Ryan. Once we accept a request, we see it through to the end. We also rescued several of your colleagues just now. They're safe.

10370001645._kDes: So you're with the Professor... Please be extremely careful. It seems Pharaoh, the most vicious Monster of Legend within the Pyramid, has awakened. If you encounter it, your chances of survival will be slim.

10370001646._kDes: Uh... Pharaoh? What is that? Is it strong? If it gets in our way, we'll chop it up and burn it for firewood, right, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}?

10370001647._kDes: Understood. The Relic should be in this direction. I've marked it on your map.

10370001648._kDes: It's terrifying. The closer we get to the Relic, the further the Monsters spiral out of Control. That Pharaoh we just saw looked as though it had crawled straight out of hell...

10370001649._kDes: After the sarcophagus dragged you away, Pharaoh disappeared as well. If you hadn't stepped Forward and lured it away, all of us would probably be nothing but bleached bones in the desert by now.

10370001650._kDes: I'm sorry. My attitude at the City Gate was No good. I take back what I said—you truly are an admirable Adventurer. Thank you for everything. You didn't suffer any internal injuries, did you? That suction looked impossible to survive.

10370001651._kDes: Hehe, not bad for a big dummy. ^{1}PlayerName^{2} is incredibly lucky, especially since they still have to take me out for dessert.

10370001652._kDes: Thank goodness you're all right. That Spatial Distortion caused quite a commotion. I was afraid you'd been pulled into Pharaoh's dimension and wouldn't make it back.

10370001653._kDes: Want to hear about my new Discover?

10370001656._kDes: The runic structure and residual energy on this Relic are identical to the Nail of Discipline Outside the City of Prontera. That can't be a coincidence. There must be some deeper connection between them.

10370001657._kDes: You're the only one who managed to Activate the Stone Pillar in the city. I spent months tinkering with it and got no response. So... would you like to try touching this? Don't worry, I have Isis standing by over there. If it throws you back, his sturdy frame should probably—maybe—be able to catch you.

10370001658._kDes: You stinky old man! What do you mean, "should probably—maybe"? If he doesn't catch my Adventurer, they'll be squashed flat! No good!

10370001659._kDes: Stay out of my research, you black sootball freak! I'm asking ^{1}PlayerName^{2}!

10370001660._kDes: Hahaha! That's my enlightened, motivated, and courageous Chief assistant!

10370001661._kDes: Hmph. I think you've really lost your mind...

10370001662._kDes: We meet again. It seems you've found the second piece of the puzzle.

10370001663._kDes: Breathing is normal, but there's no consciousness... Most likely... a protective coma caused by a concussion? If we wait a little longer, they'll wake up... right?

10370001664._kDes: This is all your fault! You insisted they touch that stupid Stone! Now ^{1}PlayerName^{2} has brain damage! What are we going to do?!

10370001665._kDes: Oof... Theoretically, an impact of this intensity shouldn't cause anything more serious... right?

10370001666._kDes: If the head trauma poses a risk of Suffocation, would you like me to perform rescue breathing? I am prepared to do so, even at the cost of my dignity.

10370001667._kDes: Uh... right! According to the Gold four-minute rule, we must intervene. Knight, you're up!

10370001668._kDes: All right. For honor and duty...

10370001670._kDes: ^{1}PlayerName^{2}, you're finally awake! I was worried sick!

10370001671._kDes: Phew... Thank goodness you woke up in time. We almost...

10370001673._kDes: Nothing, nothing. We were just discussing having this esteemed Knight carry you back to Prontera if you didn't wake up.

10370001674._kDes: Hahaha! Yes, exactly. Since you're okay, I'll be going. I still have a mission to carry out.

10370001675._kDes: Phew, you're finally awake! You really scared me... I never expected the recoil to be so powerful that it would knock you unconscious.

10370001676._kDes: Still, your unconsciousness proved quite valuable. It confirmed my theory once again—you may be the only person in the world capable of activating these things. The Church has already taken the Relic away and placed it in temporary storage at the palace.

10370001677._kDes: All right, you've been through one danger after another, so you must be exhausted. I'm a VIP member at the Oak Inn in southern Prontera. Go rest there and give them my name. They'll arrange their best room for you.

10370001678._kDes: Hey! You stingy old man! ^{1}PlayerName^{2} got hurt because of you, and all you're offering is a room for the night?

10370001679._kDes: Of course! That's already the finest treatment available. Now get going. I'll return to the laboratory and organize the Data, and you should catch up on sleep. Get plenty of rest—who knows what strange things will happen tomorrow?

10370001680._kDes: Welcome to the Oak Inn! Are you here for a meal or a room? Or perhaps a little drink~?

10370001681._kDes: A room! Put it on that stinky old Professor Rhein's tab! He sent us.

10370001682._kDes: Ah, the professor is one of our premium VIP members. He mentioned the two of you and specifically asked us to prepare a quiet room by the window on the second floor. He said you needed a good rest.

10370001683._kDes: You think back on everything you've experienced over the Recent few days. None of it feels real.

10370001684._kDes: As your thoughts wander, drowsiness overtakes you, and at last you close your eyes...

10370001685._kDes: I've been waiting for you, Adventurer. I'm a Monsterologist dedicated to creating a Record of every creature's ecology.

10370001686._kDes: I'm compiling an unprecedented Encyclopedia of Monsters. But I don't need a few scraps of fur—I need comprehensive Data. Listen: travel far and wide, hunt monsters, Kill as many as you can, and bring their information back to me.

10370001687._kDes: Only sufficient numbers will let me take my research deeper, and the deeper my research goes, the more amazing your rewards will be. We both win.

10370001688._kDes: All right, go give it a try.

10370001689._kDes: Good to see you again, Adventurer. You've managed to Level-up your equipment incredibly quickly. You must have been fighting for your life out there. Excellent work!

10370001690._kDes: Now that you've advanced, there's something I have to teach you—Refine! It's Midgard's greatest form of "legal gambling." Come on, hand over your equipment and let's see if we can smash it to pieces... Er, I mean, send it soaring to new heights!

10370001691._kDes: Uh-oh. Teaching someone to gamble is asking to get struck by lightning~

10370001692._kDes: Ahem... Don't talk nonsense. Remember, this is 30% LUK and 70% Fortify. Don't blame me if it breaks. After all, I'm just a humble Blacksmith who "delivers" the Goddess of Fortune's blessings.

10370001693._kDes: But don't worry too much. There's a beginner protection period, so the Success Rate is extremely high for your first few attempts!

10370001694._kDes: Today, I also want to tell you about a special event called the Commendation Vault.

10370001695._kDes: This isn't Battle training. It's a way to Obtain Resources. By participating, you'll have a Chance to earn plenty of money and EXP.

10370001696._kDes: Money and EXP? What a sweet deal! Bobo wants to join too!

10370001697._kDes: Come. Now I'll teach you how to unlock the Commendation Vault event.

10370001698._kDes: Hello, Adventurer! Our company is hosting a televised competition called Kafra Survivor Showdown. Come give it a try—the last contestant standing will win a fantastic grand prize!

10370001699._kDes: Let me show you how to register for the event~

10370001700._kDes: We meet again, my dear Adventurer, ^{1}PlayerName^{2}. Do you remember the compass I gave you? You've carried it with you all this time, but it has yet to reveal its true power.

10370001701._kDes: To Activate its deeper power, you must collect something called Soul Echo. These are the memories and powerful Emotions that living beings leave behind in the world. Each holds a unique frequency, making them exceptionally rare.

10370001702._kDes: Let me show you how to Insert these echoes into the compass. Awaken its true potential.

10370001703._kDes: Hello, we meet again. Don't ask why I've come to this scorching desert. To witness the growth of an Excellent prospect, these old bones of mine must travel far and wide.

10370001704._kDes: Wow, it's you again! We've gotten lots of new equipment Recent. What do you think? Do we look stronger?

10370001705._kDes: Equipment alone proves nothing. I can sense power surging within you, still not fully under control. It's time for your Second Job Change.

10370001706._kDes: Come, Kill some Nearby monsters and show me your current strength.

10370001707._kDes: Excellent. Your control over your STR is much steadier than when we first met. Your trials in this desert have truly transformed you.

10370001708._kDes: Remember, the Second Job isn't the end. It's your ticket to even harsher adventures. From this day forward, you'll shoulder greater responsibilities. Don't disappoint me or those who support you.

10370001709._kDes: That's amazing! After your Job Advance, will you be able to carry little Me to victory too? I don't want to hide in the back and cheer every time.

10370001710._kDes: All right, let's begin. Place your hand on the Book of Job Advance, and I'll guide you through your Second Job.

10370001711._kDes: What astonishing growth! You're ready for your third job change. Continue onward along your chosen career path!

10370001712._kDes: The road ahead is under construction and temporarily closed. Please come back later.

10370001713._kDes: Something in the abyss seems to be watching you... (Only the Party Leader can select a target)

10620000005._kDes: To the bumbling Investigator choking on our dust:

10620100001._kDes: Z, awaiting your arrival in shadows beyond the moonlight's reach

10620200000._kDes:
The Academy has witnessed the growth and potential you have shown throughout your journey. Now, you have reached a pivotal point on your path to power—the time has come for your second class advancement.
We cordially invite you to return to Kratu Academy and choose your specialized path. This advancement will determine your future development and shape your combat style and calling.
I will await your arrival at the Academy so that we may embark on this new journey together.

10620200002._kDes:
I can't believe you managed to slip away from Moonlight Flower. You've got some skill after all, unlike the fools who came before you.
It seems you've barely passed the first round of our carefully designed "qualification test." After all, anyone who can't even play the game has no right to challenge us.
But don't get cocky. That was just a warm-up. If you truly think you have what it takes to stand against us, come settle this at the Sandsea Labyrinth in South Morroc (exact coordinates: @{1}, @{2}).
We solemnly swear that we will keep our word this time and face you in a fair fight!
P.S. If you lose, everything you're carrying belongs to us. The victor deserves to take all.

10620200003._kDes:
I hope you can spare a moment. Ever since I heard about you riding a giant ant through the nest, I haven't been able to get that incredible image out of my mind. Drawing on our... ahem, less-than-pleasant shared experience, I successfully reverse-engineered a unique pheromone from the remaining Ant Queen carapace samples. I believe I've found the "key" to recreating your extraordinary feat!
This is an absolutely fascinating case study in biology, and I urgently need a witness. Please meet me in the woods near Prontera West Gate.
One more thing: If it's not too much trouble, could you bring me a sandwich on your way? My lunch has disappeared again.

10620200004._kDes:
I sent letters to both Professor Ryan and the Captain, but neither has responded. I suspect you're probably with them, so I'm sending this letter directly to you.
To make a long story short, we have a difficult situation. A caravan traveling overland from Juno with an important package for the Professor was attacked by Baphomet near the edge of the forest—again. The cargo is currently missing, but fortunately, most of the caravan members suffered only minor injuries and made it back safely.
This matter must be handled as soon as possible. If you can, please make sure the Professor and the Captain hear about it.
I've enclosed the exact location and details with this letter.

10620200005._kDes:
An interesting bounty was recently posted on the Prontera bulletin board. It's about an elusive band of Thieves. Those old sticks-in-the-mud in the guard have been investigating for ages without finding a single lead, and I thought this case would be right up your alley.
The pay is good, but more importantly, my instincts tell me there's more to this than meets the eye. You're resourceful, so I trust you to investigate it.
I've already spoken to the guards, so just go take a look at the bounty notice. Follow the trail wherever it leads, and if you need any help, come find me at Eden Group anytime.

10620200006._kDes:
Your pathetic attempt at sneaking around is downright painful to watch! What makes a Mouse hiding in the shadows like you think you're worthy of tracking the Z Group?
Your relentless pursuit may be laughable, but at least you've shown a little courage. In our boundless mercy, we've decided to give you a chance to settle this face-to-face.
If you don't want to spend your life as a coward who does nothing but chase rumors around town, come alone to the pond in Southern Payon. We'll be waiting to show you what true power looks like.
Of course, if you're scared, feel free to keep hiding in your shell!

10620200007._kDes:
After our last adventure in the desert, we've built an exceptionally solid foundation of trust.
The lovely Miss Aiquni told me that I could send any future requests your way and put you to work however I pleased. The more I thought about it, the more I liked the idea of making you my assistant for a while.
Come find me near the fountain. I have an extremely urgent matter that requires your help.

10620200008._kDes: Hello. I'm almost finished repairing the equipment those blasted little thieves damaged, but first I need your help. It's extremely urgent, so come see me right now!
