10960000000._kDes:
@{1}.Consume Equipment Blueprints and other specified materials to perform Equipment Forging.
@{2}.Forged equipment has random attributes.
@{3}.Equipment Forging always produces equipment of Purple Quality or higher. Orange and red equipment will be unidentified.

10960000001._kDes:
@{1}.Equipment Forging, defeating monsters, and other activities may yield unidentified equipment.
@{2}.Identifying equipment does not consume any materials. Its attributes are randomized upon identification. Tap the ^{1}Equipment Forging Info^{2} button to view the possible attributes for the equipment.

10960000002._kDes: Players who obtain a Throne Token can purchase throne-exclusive items from the Season Shop during the new Season.

10960000010._kDes: Can be unlocked by using the corresponding appearance item purchased or obtained from the Costume Shop. Once unlocked, the appearance will be added to the Wardrobe.

10960000011._kDes: Select an unlocked appearance in the Wardrobe to equip or switch to it.

10960000012._kDes: Each cosmetic has its own Fashion Points, which are automatically added to your total when the cosmetic is unlocked.

10960000013._kDes: Click the icon next to an appearance's name in the Wardrobe to mark it, making it easy to find your favorites in a large collection.

10960000014._kDes: Save your current outfit to an outfit preset so you can change looks more easily.

10960000015._kDes: Please confirm the item information and quantity before purchasing.

10960000016._kDes:
@{1}.Only players who are mutual friends can gift each other Appearance items sold in the Shop.
@{2}.You can Switch the recipient on the gifting screen.
@{3}.After you confirm the gift, it will be Sent to the recipient's Friend Chat. Once the recipient accepts it, the Appearance will be unlocked in their Wardrobe.
@{4}.The corresponding Currency will be deducted once the gift is confirmed. If the recipient does not accept it within the allotted time, the gift will expire and the deducted Currency will be Returned by mail.

10960000017._kDes:
@{1}.Each character has @{2} stat allocation presets and can freely switch between them.
@{3}.You can rename each preset.
@{4}.Keep your selected recommended stat allocation preset when switching presets.

10960000018._kDes: Resetting is free. After a reset, all allocated points will be refunded.

10960000019._kDes:
Guild Prestige Acquisition Rules:
@{1}.^{1}Guild Prestige represents a guild's Battle strength^{2}. It is not Cleared between Seasons. Every Season, all guilds across the server group are ranked by Prestige, and the results are Permanently Recorded.
@{2}.When Guild Members participate in guild battlefield modes—Guild Territory War (Stronghold War, Escort Battle, Regional Capital War/Royal City War)—their Defeats on the battlefield are converted into Guild Prestige.
@{3}.Victory or defeat in guild battlefield modes also affects the amount of Prestige awarded during Settlement.

10960000020._kDes:
How to Obtain Guild Funds:
@{1}.Guild Funds are extremely important and will be ^{1}used to purchase essential Currency and items, such as Guild Supplies, in Guild Territory War^{2}.
@{2}.During Guild Caravan, Guild Members can earn Guild Funds by submitting requested items.
@{3}.Completing a full round of caravan item requests grants a large amount of Guild Funds.

10960000021._kDes:
How to Earn Guild Contribution:
@{1}. Guild Contribution can be used to ^{1}upgrade Guild Buildings. Higher-level Guild Buildings unlock more Guild Benefits^{2}.
@{2}. Guild Members earn Weekly Guild Activity, Guild Contribution, and Personal Contribution by completing Guild Quests.
@{3}. Personal Contribution can be exchanged for items in the Guild Shop and will not be cleared when leaving the guild.

10960000022._kDes:
Guild Supplies Acquisition Rules:
@{1}.Complete Territory War quests to obtain Guild Supplies.
@{2}.Use Guild Funds to purchase Guild Supplies from other guilds.
Guild Supplies Usage Rules:
@{3}.Guild Supplies can be used to purchase siege weapons and vehicles from the Guild Store.
@{4}.Guild War technology Level-ups and limited-time Guild Strategy activations consume Guild Supplies.
@{5}.Guild Supplies are an important Currency in Territory War, so be sure to stock up~

10960000023._kDes:
@{1}.Authorized Guild Management personnel can send Notification Mail to every Guild Member.
@{2}.Group Mail can be sent ^{1}@{3} times per day^{2}. ^{3}The limit resets daily at @{4} a.m.^{4}.
@{5}.The number of emails available is tied to the Guild, so Guild Management should plan the mailing schedule wisely~

10960000024._kDes:
@{1}.Guild War Technology^{1} applies to Territory War^{2}. More effects gradually unlock with each Guild Institute Level Increased milestone.
@{2}.War Technology resets every Season. At the start of a new Season, Guild Supplies must be spent on Level-up again.
@{3}.During Stronghold Battles, Convoy Escort Battles, and Siege Battles, War Technology affects the stats of every Guild Member.

10960000025._kDes:
@{1}.Guild Limited-Time Tactics provide powerful temporary effects in Territory War.
@{2}.Authorized Guild management Members can spend Guild Supplies to activate and refresh Tactics.
@{3}.Limited-Time Tactics automatically refresh once daily at five o'clock in the morning. The number of Tactics that can be drawn each day also resets at that time.
@{4}.The Limited-Time Tactics pool unlocks over the course of the Season. Higher-quality, more powerful Tactics become available later in the Season.
@{5}.The Tactics your Guild can activate are limited by available points. If you have reached the point limit, you must unequip a Tactic before you can activate another.
@{6}.Unequipping a Tactic does not refund the Guild Supplies spent to activate it.
@{7}.A Limited-Time Tactic's duration begins counting down as soon as it is activated. When its remaining duration reaches @{8}, it will be removed from Current Effect.

10960000026._kDes:
@{1}.Guild Limited-Time Tactics provide ^{1}more powerful temporary effects in Territory War^{2}.
@{2}.Authorized management Members can spend Guild Supplies to activate and refresh Tactics.
@{3}.Limited-Time Tactics automatically refresh once each day at 5:00 a.m. The number of Tactics that can be drawn each day also resets at 5:00 a.m.
@{4}.^{3}The Limited-Time Tactics pool unlocks as the Season progresses^{4}. Higher-quality, more powerful Tactics will become available later in the Season.
@{5}.The Tactics your Guild can have active are limited by points. If you have reached the point limit, you must unequip a Tactic before activating another one.
@{6}.Unequipping a Tactic will not refund the Guild Supplies spent to activate it.
@{7}.^{5}A Limited-Time Tactic's timer starts as soon as it is activated^{6}. When its remaining duration reaches @{8}, it will be removed from Current Effect.

10960000027._kDes:
@{1}.Adventurers without a guild can Create Guilds or respond to and Join any guild.
@{2}.After initiating guild creation, 2 other players must respond before the guild can be created. If there are not enough Responses within ^{1}@{3} hours^{2}, guild creation will fail.
@{4}.Once the required number of Responses is reached, Guild Creation Successful. After the guild is created, ^{3}the creator automatically becomes the Guild Master.^{4}
@{5}.If guild creation fails, the items consumed to Create Guild will be Returned by mail.
@{6}.You must Join a guild to participate in Guild Activities and earn generous rewards and Event Auction Dividends.
@{7}.Each Adventurer may have membership Requests pending with up to ^{5}@{8} guilds at once^{6} and may withdraw them at any time.

10960000028._kDes:
@{1}.The first time any Adventurer Leaves Guild, there is no penalty period, and they may Join another guild immediately.
@{2}.If an Adventurer is below Lv. @{3}, the penalty period for subsequently Leaving Guild is @{4} minutes. If an Adventurer is above Lv. @{5}, the penalty period is @{6} hours.
@{7}.Adventurers who are Banished from Guild have no penalty period and may Join another guild immediately.
@{8}.If you Return to your former guild within @{9} weeks of leaving, your Guild Funds Donation amount and Total Contribution will be Kept.

10960000029._kDes:
@{1}.All adventurers who Join a guild are initially Temporary Members and will automatically become Members ^{1}after @{2} hours^{2}. This change cannot be made manually.
@{3}.Temporary Members cannot be assigned positions or participate in the Guild League.
@{4}.A management Member with appointment permission can appoint or dismiss any Member in a lower position.
@{5}.A Member with a management position cannot be directly Banished from Guild. The Member must first be removed from the position.
@{6}.A Member with elite management permission can adjust elite Member assignments for the Guild League. A Member with equipment management permission can adjust Member assignments for equipment and vehicles in Territory War.

10960000030._kDes:
@{1}.A Member with rally permissions can send a Guild Rally pop-up to every Guild Member.
@{2}.After accepting the rally, Guild Members will immediately be teleported to the initiating Member's location.
@{3}.The ^{1}Guild Rally Cooldown is @{4} minutes^{2} and is shared by the entire guild.

10960000031._kDes:
@{1}.Once the Guild Auction begins, all Guild Members are eligible to participate.
@{2}.After the auction ends, Members eligible for a dividend from the event will receive an Auction Dividend.
@{3}.The Auction Dividend from each auction will be sent by mail, so be sure to check your inbox.
@{4}.If you leave the guild before the Guild Auction ends, you will not receive an Auction Dividend from that auction.

10960000032._kDes:
Activity Dividend:
@{1}.^{1}The weekly Guild Activity Dividend Settlement takes place every Monday at 5 AM^{2}. After Settlement, you can manually claim your dividend from the interface.
@{2}.If you select Leave Guild without claiming last week's dividend, it will be sent to you by mail. Please check your inbox.

Auction Dividend:
@{3}.Every Monday at 5 AM, the Auction Dividend Settlement for the previous week will be displayed.

10960000033._kDes:
Receive an invite Rules:
@{1}.Receiving a merge invite means ^{1}the other guild is inviting your guild to Merge into theirs^{2}.
@{2}.After accepting the merge invite, you must adjust the number of guild members who can Merge into the other guild so that it does not exceed the number of members they can accept.
@{3}.Once you have accepted the merge invite and adjusted the number of members who can merge, ^{3}the Merge Guild process will be completed at 5:00 a.m. the next day^{4}.
@{4}.Before the merge takes place, you can select [Cancel Merge] on the screen. The Merge Guild process will end immediately after it is canceled.
@{5}.If your guild's member count exceeds the number of members the other guild can accept when the merge takes place, the Merge Guild process will end immediately and the merge will fail.
@{6}.If the merge fails, neither guild will be changed or otherwise affected.

10960000034._kDes:
Send an Invite: Rules
@{1}.Sending a merge invite means ^{1}your guild is inviting the other guild to Merge into your guild^{2}.
@{2}.After you send a merge invite, the merge process will begin once the other guild agrees and adjusts the number of members who will Merge into your guild so that it does not exceed your guild's available capacity.
@{3}.The merge will be officially completed ^{3}at 5:00 AM the following day^{4}. If the other guild has more members to merge than your guild can accept when the merge occurs, the merge will fail.
@{4}.If the merge fails, neither guild will undergo any changes or be affected in any way.

10960000035._kDes:
Guild Activity Rules:
@{1}.Any Guild Member who participates in a Guild Event Quest can earn^{1} Guild Activity, Guild Contribution, and Personal Contribution rewards^{2}.
@{2}.Guild Activity progress is shared by^{3} all Guild Members and resets every Monday at 5:00 AM^{4}. Any unclaimed Activity Chests will expire.
@{3}.Guild Contribution is the Guild's Currency and can be used for building Level-ups. Personal Contribution is personal Currency that can be exchanged for items in the Guild Shop.

10960000036._kDes:
Guild League Elite Rules:
@{1}.On this screen, you can designate elite players who may participate in Guild League arena modes.
@{2}.Quick Team Formation sends a team invitation to each Member. Members will not be added to the team in the order shown on the elite settings screen, so the team leader must adjust the lineup manually.

10960000037._kDes:
Siege War Cannon Permission Rules:
@{1}. This screen allows you to configure cannon permissions for Siege War.
@{2}. These settings also affect player permissions during Siege War.

10960000038._kDes:
Siege War Vehicle Permission Rules:
@{1}.You can set vehicle permissions for Siege War on this screen.
@{2}.These settings also apply to player permissions during Siege War.

10960000039._kDes:
Guild Funds Rankings Rules:
@{1}.Each Guild Member can earn Guild Funds by completing Royal Caravan activities.
@{2}.In Territory War, Guild Funds are a vital Currency used to purchase cannons, vehicles, and other important battlefield equipment.
@{3}.The Guild Master and Vice Guild Master can also spend Guild Funds to purchase Benefits Packs for the entire guild.
@{4}.Other players can view the guild's Guild Funds rankings on the 【Join a guild】 screen. Don't forget to complete your daily Guild Caravan turn-in quest and make a Donation to your guild!

10960000040._kDes:
Bidding Fund Rules:
@{1}.Escort missions convert Guild Supplies into Bidding Funds.
@{2}.Eligibility for Stronghold War and Siege War can only be obtained by bidding with Bidding Funds.
@{3}.Bidding Funds can be accumulated without limit during the Season.
@{4}.Bidding Funds will be reset when the Season ends, so be sure to use them in time.

10960000041._kDes:
@{1}.Refining applies to equipment slots only. Changing Equipment does not affect Refine bonuses.
@{2}.Slots can still be Refined without Equipment equipped, but Refine bonuses are only Active while Equipment is equipped.
@{3}.Refining every equipment slot to the specified Refine Level will Activate Resonance stats. Equipment must still be equipped to receive the corresponding bonuses.

10960000042._kDes:
@{1}.Each Equipment Refine Level has a fixed Success Rate.
@{2}.Refining has a Chance to fail, and Refinement Failed may reduce the Refine Level by @{3}.
@{4}.Refinement Failed or a Refine Level reduction grants a certain amount of LUK. The more consecutive level reductions, the more Extra LUK is granted.
@{5}.At safe Refine Levels, Refinement Failed will not reduce the Refine Level. Safe Refine Levels: @{6}/@{7}/@{8}/@{9}/@{10}. There are @{11} Refine Levels in total.
@{12}.When using Blessed Ore, Refinement Failed will not reduce the Refine Level. Legend Ore increases the Refinement Success Rate and also prevents Refine Level reduction upon failure.

10960000043._kDes:
@{1}.Enhance applies only to equipment slots. Changing equipment does not affect Enhance bonuses.
@{2}.You can Enhance an equipment slot even when no equipment is equipped, but the bonuses only take effect once equipment is equipped.
@{3}.The maximum Reinforcement level is equal to the character's Current Level.
@{4}.Enhancing all equipment slots to the specified level activates Resonance attributes. Equipment must be equipped to receive the corresponding bonuses.

10960000044._kDes:
@{1}.Mail is divided into System Mail and Guild Mail, which unlock at different levels.
@{2}.System Mail and Guild Mail each have a storage limit. New mail cannot be received once the limit is reached, so please clear out your mail regularly, Adventurer.
@{3}.Mail with attachments cannot be deleted until the attachments have been claimed.
@{4}.Each mail has an expiration date. Expired mail will be deleted automatically, so be sure to read it and claim any attachments in time.

10960000045._kDes:
@{1}.Trade is the official marketplace for buying and selling items.
@{2}.Some rare items can be priced freely, with no price restrictions.
@{3}.Rare items have a display period after being listed and cannot be traded normally until that period ends.
@{4}.When an item's status changes to Purchase Successful or Sale Successful, the purchased item or sale proceeds will be sent by mail. Please claim them promptly.
@{5}.You can follow items to easily check their availability in real time.
@{6}.Listed items remain available for a limited time. Any item that does not sell before its listing expires will automatically be returned to the player by mail.
@{7}.After an item is sold, a transaction tax is deducted from the Currency the seller receives. Different tax rates apply based on the player's Trade volume for This Week.

10960000046._kDes:
@{1}.Today's tax rate is updated daily at @{2}:@{3} and will remain unchanged for the rest of the day.
@{4}.Trade tax is deducted at the rate in effect when the Trade is completed.
@{5}.The tax rate increases in tiers based on Trade volume. Tax rate tiers reset every Monday.

10960000047._kDes:
@{1}.The search Function supports both fuzzy and exact searches.
@{2}.Items listed for sale and items in the publication period are kept in separate search pools.
@{3}.For each search type, Keep up to @{4} search records.

10960000048._kDes: Due to multiple violations, your suspension periods have been combined. Please refer to the latest end time.

10960000049._kDes:
@{1}.Trade records are stored for up to @{2} days or @{3} entries;
@{4}.Trade records are cleared when a new Season begins

10960000051._kDes:
@{1}.Certain classes have unique class items.
@{2}.After meeting the specified requirements, Merchants can use carts, Knight classes can ride Peco Pecos, and Archer classes can bring Falcons.
@{3}.Each class item serves a different purpose. Adventurers, go explore and Discover them all!

10960000052._kDes:
@{1}.Adventurers can purchase the items they need here.
@{2}.Some items may have purchase quantity or frequency limits. Check the Refresh Time and purchase them before they refresh.

10960000053._kDes:
@{1}.Adventurers can repurchase the items they need.
@{2}.Some items may have purchase quantity or frequency limits. Check the Refresh Time and purchase them before they refresh.

10960000054._kDes:
@{1}.The continent of Prontera is never short on Adventurers, and helping one another is its noblest virtue.
@{2}.You can add other Adventurers as friends through the game world, chat channels, rankings, and more.
@{3}.After sending a friend request, you must wait for the other player to accept before you become friends.
@{4}.Team up with friends to participate in activities, complete quests, and more to earn Intimacy Points and raise your Intimacy Level.
@{5}.Once you reach the required Intimacy Level, you will receive bonus effects when teaming up together.
@{6}.Friends can also exchange gifts to increase their Intimacy Points.

10960000055._kDes:
@{1}.After a gift is sent, both friends receive the corresponding stat increases.
@{2}.Popularity: The stat gained by the recipient after receiving a gift.
@{3}.Heart Points: The stat gained by the sender after sending a gift.
@{4}.Intimacy: The stat gained by both the sender and recipient after a gift is sent.

10960000056._kDes:
@{1}.Only players who are mutual friends can send each other gifts.
@{2}.The recipient must be Online to receive a gift.
@{3}.You can switch recipients on the Gift page.
@{4}.Different gifts grant different amounts of Intimacy and Love. Once a gift is successfully sent, both friends will receive the corresponding bonuses.
@{5}.Only premium gift items allow you to add a custom message and trigger a flashy Entire Server Notification.

10960000057._kDes:
@{1}.Each player can have up to @{2} Cross-server Friends.
@{3}.After a server merge, Cross-server Friends will automatically be added to the My Friends list.
@{4}.Cross-server Friends can form parties for some content, but cannot send gifts.

10960000058._kDes:
@{1}.Mounts are divided into two categories: Battle Mounts and Universal Mounts. The Peco Peco is an exclusive Battle Mount for Knight classes. Once the requirements are met, it can be claimed and used immediately. Other classes cannot obtain this mount.
@{2}.Mounts come in different quality tiers. Each tier has different ranges for mount speed, attributes, and Trait Points. The higher the quality, the higher these values.
@{3}.Each mount has a different number of Trait Points, with the value range determined by the mount's quality.
@{4}.For Universal Mounts, setting a mount as the default grants its attributes. 【Battle Mount】 and 【Universal Mount】 attributes are separate, and a mount's appearance and attributes cannot be used independently.

10960000059._kDes:
@{1}.Rankings are updated in real time.
@{2}.Each leaderboard is ranked according to criteria specific to that game mode. Some leaderboards allow you to click a column header to sort in ascending or descending order.
@{3}.Click a character on the leaderboard to view their profile.

10960000060._kDes: Rankings close every Monday at @{1}:@{2} AM, and leaderboard rewards are distributed based on each Adventurer's Hero tier.

10960000061._kDes: Rankings are finalized at the end of the Season, and Leaderboard Rewards are issued based on each Adventurer's Valor Tier.

10960000062._kDes:
@{1}.The Pinnacle Top Ten rankings update in real time, displaying the ten strongest adventurers on the current server.
@{2}.Settlement takes place every Monday at @{3}:@{4}, and Pinnacle Top Ten rewards are distributed.

10960000063._kDes:
@{1}. Evenly Matched rankings are updated in real time and show the ten players on the current server whose overall power is closest to mine.
@{2}. Increasing overall power will improve your title.

10960000064._kDes:
@{1}.When using 【Right Mouse Button (+Shift)】 to Adjust Camera, use Ctrl + Right Mouse Button to adjust the camera Distance.
@{2}.When using 【Mouse Left Tap (+Shift)】 to Adjust Camera, use Ctrl + Mouse Left Tap to adjust the camera Distance.

10960000065._kDes:
@{1}. When speaking freely in a Tavern room, please remember to ^{1}follow the Compliance Guidelines^{2}.
@{2}. Tavern chat will Keep its relatively strict moderation and reporting systems. Adventurers, please do not post any content that violates the rules. 
@{3}. When you ^{3}send Tavern Gifts^{4} to other Adventurers in the room, you can ^{5}increase the room's popularity^{6}, while the Adventurers who receive them can ^{7}gain Star Points^{8}.
@{4}. Star Points have a weekly ranking, and the top ten players each week can earn a limited-time title.
@{5}. Don't hold back on sending Tavern Gifts! Complete daily quests to receive free gift items, and boldly show others your appreciation!
@{6}. Both ^{9}popularity and the number of players in the room^{10} affect the room's position in the Tavern list.

10960000066._kDes:
@{1}. The host can set how Members turn on their mics and who has permission to speak. The host can also mute a Member or add them to the room's Blocks.
@{2}. Please ^{1}use these permissions responsibly^{2} and make your Tavern room a fun place for everyone!

10960000068._kDes:
@{1}.After befriending other adventurers, Intimacy bonuses between friends can be unlocked.
@{2}.Actions such as ^{1}Unfriend or adding a friend to Blocks^{2} will immediately ^{3}reset Intimacy^{4}. Proceed with caution.
@{3}.The maximum Intimacy level between friends is ^{5}Lv. @{4}^{6}.
@{5}.After unlocking other Connect relationships, higher Intimacy levels can be unlocked.

10960000069._kDes:
@{1}.Gifts to Friends: Different gifts grant different amounts of Affinity.
@{2}.Participate in activities with friends to gain Affinity. The amount of Affinity you can gain from activities each day is limited.

10960000071._kDes: @{1}.MVP monsters share HP across all channels. When an MVP appears, it can be found and fought on any channel, and all battle contributions count toward the rankings.

10960000072._kDes:
@{1}.There are 4 types of MVP rewards: Ranking Rewards, Participation Rewards, First Strike Rewards, and Final Blow Rewards. Each has an independent Reward Count and does not affect the others. Tap Reward Count for details.
@{2}.Participation Rewards and Ranking Rewards have a Chance to include Rare rewards such as Cards. The higher the team's rank, the greater the Chance.
@{3}.Ranking Rewards are distributed by party. After Killing the MVP, members of the top @{4} parties with Remaining Reward Counts can obtain Ranking Rewards.
@{5}.The first Character to attack the MVP receives the First Strike mark. Going Offline or changing maps, except when switching channels, Clears the First Strike mark. The first Character to attack the MVP afterward receives the First Strike mark.

10960000073._kDes:
@{1}.After the MVP is Defeated, Points are calculated for all participating parties based on Damage dealt, Damage taken, Healing Volume, and death count Data. Deaths deduct a small number of Points. All participating parties are then ranked by Points.
@{2}.If a party includes Members with no Remaining Ranking Reward or Participation Reward Counts, the total score is Decayed by a certain percentage. The more such Members there are, the greater the Decay.

10960000074._kDes: If a team has a Member with no Reward Count remaining, its score will be reduced by a certain percentage

10960000075._kDes:
@{1}.You receive @{2} Bonus Points each day. While Bonus Points are active, Kill field monsters to obtain large amounts of EXP, equipment, and cards
@{3}Each field monster you Kill consumes @{4} Bonus Points. Once all Bonus Points are used, the drop rate from field monsters decreases, and only basic drops such as headgear materials can be obtained
@{5}.Players can manually Pause Bonus Points. While paused, Killing field monsters does not consume Bonus Points, but only basic drops such as headgear materials can be obtained
@{6}.While Bonus Points are active, EXP and equipment rewards from Killing field monsters are affected only by World Level, while card drops vary by monster. Adventurer, plan carefully to obtain the cards you want!

10960000076._kDes:
@{1}.On the Recommended Monster screen, click the favorite button in the upper-left corner of a monster's info to add it to your favorites. You can favorite up to @{2} monsters
@{3}.In your monster favorites, click a monster's Portrait to open the Recommended Monster screen and quickly Locate its info

10960000077._kDes:
@{1}.After Enable Bonus Time, Killing Monsters in the Field grants large amounts of EXP, Equipment, Cards, and other Drops.
@{2}.Outside Bonus Time, Drops are divided into reduced Drops and Fatigue Drops.
@{3}.With reduced Drops Active, Killing Monsters in the Field grants only small amounts of EXP, Materials, and other Basic Drops.
@{4}.With Fatigue Drops Active, Killing Monsters in the Field grants only small amounts of Minted Coins and Materials.
@{5}.EXP and Equipment Drops from Killing Field Monsters are affected only by World Lv. Card Drops vary by Monster, so plan carefully to obtain the Cards you want!
@{6}.After enabling Bonus Auto Mode, if you do not Kill a Monster and obtain Drops within 10 seconds, Auto Mode is automatically suspended. Bonus Time is not deducted while suspended. Bonus Auto Mode automatically resumes when you Kill another Monster and obtain Drops.
@{7}.Bonus Auto Mode is automatically disabled in Dungeons and similar Locations and cannot be enabled there.
@{8}.If you are challenging a Field MVP, enabling Bonus Auto Mode will also suspend it. It will resume after you escape the MVP's aggro, Kill a Monster, and obtain Drops.

10960000078._kDes:
@{1}.Adventurers can use the mysterious power bestowed by the Goddess to train without actively participating in combat, earning Rare battle rewards such as cards and equipment
@{2}.After beginning an expedition, exploration time will continue to accumulate even while Adventurers are offline.
@{3}.Expedition rewards must be claimed manually. Rewards are based on the accumulated exploration time when claimed. Accumulated time has a limit, so remember to claim your rewards promptly~

10960000079._kDes:
@{1}.If the Adventurer's Base Level differs too greatly from the monster's level, the reward drop Chance and variety of rewards dropped from the Kill will be reduced (headgear drops are unaffected)
@{2}.The greater the level difference, the greater the reduction

10960000080._kDes:
@{1}.This screen shows today's field auto-battle earnings from @{2}:00 to @{3}:00 the next day
@{4}.Keep up to @{5} days of earnings records

10960000081._kDes:
@{1}.Drops are independent for each player and their teammates.
@{2}.When a teammate uses Auto Mode on the same map, there is a Chance that the Monster's Drops will also be shared with the player.
@{3}.Drops shared by teammates are shown Below each item on this screen with “Teammate:” followed by the quantity shared.

10960000082._kDes:
@{1}.Every @{2} levels, a Soul Echo unlocks an element and gains a random attribute
@{3}.You can equip up to @{4} Soul Echoes
@{5}.The elements of equipped Soul Echoes can activate Elemental Resonance. Each Elemental Resonance can reach up to Lv. @{6}, requiring @{7}, @{8}, and @{9} elements, respectively.

10960000083._kDes:
@{1}.The elements of equipped Soul Echoes can activate Elemental Resonance. Each Elemental Resonance can reach up to Lv. @{2} and requires @{3}, @{4}, and @{5} elements, respectively.
@{6}.Each level activated grants the corresponding resonance effect.

10960000084._kDes: @{1}.Only players with Reward Count remaining for the current dungeon can participate in the auction and receive an Auction Dividend. ^{1}The Auction Dividend rate is @{2}^{2}. Enjoy the thrill of bidding! @{3}.If everyone declines to bid, the item will go unsold. After the auction ends, it will be awarded at random to an eligible Member of the party with Reward Count remaining. @{4}.Declining during an auction is final. Once you decline, you cannot bid on that item again during the current auction.

10960000085._kDes:
@{1}.When you obtain a Divine Art Totem, its stats and skills are randomized.
@{2}.Use Skill Books for Learning Skills to add or replace Divine Art Totem skills.
@{3}.Use designated items to reroll its stats.
@{4}.Divine Art Totems of the same quality can be combined. The resulting totem's stats and skills are randomized.

10960000086._kDes:
@{1}.Spend Divine Totem Currency to Level-up Divine Totems, enhancing the effects of deployed Divine Totems.
 Divine Totem levels reset each Season

10960000087._kDes:
@{1}.Use Skill Books in Learning Skills to add or replace Divine Arts Totem skills.
@{2}.Learning Skills cannot exceed the Initial skill limit for the Totem's quality. Purple Totems can have up to @{3} skills, while Orange Totems can have up to @{4}. Once a Totem has reached its Initial skill limit, Skill Books can only replace skills.
@{5}.Blue Totems cannot use Learning Skills.

10960000088._kDes:
@{1}.Consume the required items to reroll a selected stat.
@{2}.Each Divine Art Totem can only be rerolled a limited number of times per Season.

10960000089._kDes:
@{1}.Divine Art Totems of the same quality can be combined, randomizing their attributes and skills
@{2}.Combining Divine Art Totems allows their number of skills to exceed the Initial limit

10960000090._kDes: Skill guaranteed when this Divine Art Totem is obtained or synthesized

10960000091._kDes: Only one effect applies to skills with the same name.

10960000092._kDes: Cards can be obtained by defeating monsters, completing quests, and through Trade. MVPs drop ultra-Rare MVP Cards.

10960000093._kDes:
@{1}.Each card has unique stats or skill effects.
@{2}.Insert a card into its designated equipment slot while that slot has equipment equipped to gain the card's effects.
@{3}.Combine cards strategically to maximize your character's power.
@{4}.Cards can be advanced to enhance their effects.
@{5}.Cards of Purple Quality or higher can be added to the Collection. Collected cards feature stunning artwork and significantly enhanced effects.

10960000094._kDes:
When you have a card, you can insert it in any of the following ways:
@{1}. Select the card in your ^{1}Backpack^{2}.
@{2}. Select the equipment in the ^{3}Equipment tab^{4}.
@{3}. Use the ^{5}Card Insertion screen^{6}.

10960000095._kDes:
@{1}.Consume cards of the same name to advance a card.
@{2}.Tap the ^{1}Preview^{2} button to see how the card's effects change after advancement.
@{3}.Collection Cards can also be advanced.

10960000096._kDes: Unused cards that are not Tier @{1} can use the ^{1}Return^{2} button to return their advancement materials.

10960000097._kDes:
@{1}.Each equipment slot has fixed card slots. Base Level Increased automatically triggers their ^{1}Unseal^{2}.
@{2}.Unsealed card slots can hold compatible cards.
@{3}.When a card is inserted into an equipment slot's card slot and equipment is worn in that slot, the character gains the card's effects.
@{4}.Select or drag cards to insert or replace them.

10960000098._kDes: The card in this slot only takes effect when ^{1}equipping a two-handed weapon^{2}. It has no effect when equipping a one-handed weapon.

10960000099._kDes:
@{1}.Cards of Purple Quality or higher can be added to the Collection.
@{2}.Use @{3} cards of the same quality to obtain one random Collection Card of that quality.
@{4}.Collection Cards feature ornate card art and slightly enhanced effects.

10960000100._kDes:
@{1}.The Codex System includes multiple collections, such as the Monster Codex and Card Codex.
@{2}.Defeating a Monster for the first time or Obtaining a Card for the first time grants Collection Points.
@{3}.After accumulating enough Collection Points, you can increase your Collection Lv. and earn rewards.

10960000105._kDes: Your Profile is a space where you can express yourself. Decorate it freely and customize Connect elements such as titles, ranks, and Portraits.

10960000106._kDes: Customize your Character, Background, Stickers, and more through Profile editing.

10960000107._kDes: Filter Star Cores in your Backpack by slot type

10960000108._kDes:
@{1}.In this Kafra Corporation reality show, contestants must make smart use of prearranged resources to stand out from the competition. The final winner will receive the show's Grand Prize.
@{2}.Each contestant can choose a Job Build before the match. Each Build comes with @{3} skills, while all other skills, Equipment, Medicine, and other items must be found and Picked up.
@{4}.Kafra Corporation has created a special Currency to reward Beginners who participate in the show. Earn Currency by competing and completing Quests, then exchange it for supplies at the Kafra Shop!
@{5}.During this test, the reality show and Battle of Dragon Coffin Island open on alternating days. Check the Calendar.
@{6}.To keep the reality show fair, all contestants must participate actively!

10960000109._kDes:
@{1}.Each class has multiple builds, and each build comes with @{2} skills.
@{3}.All builds can use universal skills.
@{4}.The Unlock Requirement for each skill is to use or pick it up during Kafra: Battle of the Survivors!
@{5}.These skills can only be used in Kafra: Battle of the Survivors.

10960000110._kDes:
@{1}.Includes multiple competitive modes. Check their schedules to see when they open and participate.
@{2}.Some modes support parties. Joining with a party is recommended for the best experience.

10960000111._kDes:
@{1}.Battle records are divided into Match Data and Season Data, both of which track contestants' performance in the reality show during the current Season.
@{2}.Season Data provides an overview by tracking only cumulative and best results.
@{3}.Match Data tracks detailed results for each match, separated into Team and Solo modes.
@{4}.All data is cleared at the end of the Season.

10960000112._kDes:
@{1}.If a player is defeated for the first time within @{2} seconds after the battlefield officially opens, they receive @{3} Extra opportunities to rejoin the battle.
@{4}.After being defeated for the first time, you do not need to wait for a teammate's aid and may choose a new drop point to rejoin the battle.
@{5}.You have a limited time to choose a drop point. If time expires before you make a selection, one will be assigned at random. Keep an eye on the timer.

10960000113._kDes:
@{1}.Spend Kaka Victory Coins at the Kafra Shop to exchange for rewards.
@{2}.Some items require you to reach a specific rank.

10960000114._kDes:
@{1}.Select filters to bulk-discard equipment and skills that match them. 
@{2}.Click a selected filter again or clear its checkbox to deselect it. 
@{3}.Items in the Item category, equipped gear, and equipped skills cannot be bulk-discarded. 
@{4}.Tap Confirm Discard to discard every item in your Backpack that matches the selected filters.

10960000115._kDes:
@{1}.View all Adventure Card Sets obtained during this match here.
@{2}.Adventure Card Sets are only active during the current match. They have no effect after leaving this mode or while playing other modes.

10960000116._kDes:
@{1}. Choose your preferred style before entering battle. The styles available in Survivor Battle differ from traditional styles.
@{2}. Each style is bound to two skills. These two skills can only be changed by switching styles during the mode.
@{3}. In addition to style skills, you can find more skills during the mode and carry up to @{4} Extra custom skills.

10960000117._kDes:
@{1}.After choosing a style, you may select any location on the mode map as your Spawn.
@{2}.You can see your teammates' and enemies' Spawn locations, allowing you to adjust your Spawn strategy as the situation changes.
@{3}.In Team Mode, you may invite teammates to follow you or follow a teammate.

10960000118._kDes:
@{1}.Treasure Chests appear randomly throughout the battlefield and may contain exclusive equipment, skills, Medicine, and other items.
@{2}.Mix and match skills freely during the match to create countless builds. Choose your favorites and jump into battle!

10960000119._kDes: @{1}.Random events may occur during the match. Seize these opportunities to become stronger.

10960000120._kDes:
@{1}.If you are defeated within @{2} minutes, you may choose a new Spawn and Revive once for free.
@{3}.If you are defeated after @{4} minutes, you will drop an ID Tag. A teammate must retrieve it before you can Revive.

10960000121._kDes:
@{1}.Participate in the mode to earn Currency, which can be used to purchase items from the shop.
@{2}.You can also earn rewards by reaching a higher rank.

10960000122._kDes:
@{1}.Participating in Survivor Battle grants Rank Points. Your rank automatically receives a Level-up when your points reach the limit.
@{2}.There are @{3} ranks in total: Trainee, Rookie, Warrior, Elite, Moonlit Challenger, Dominator, and Legendary Survivor. To become a Legendary Survivor, you must rank among the top @{4} players on the Entire Server and have at least @{5} points in Dominator.
@{6}.Trainees cannot be demoted. Rookies and above can lose minor ranks, while Dominators and above can lose major ranks.
@{7}.Idling and similar behavior during a match will be penalized. Penalties are applied directly to your Rank Points, so please participate actively.

10960000123._kDes:
@{1}.In this mode, Guild Members must work together to Defeat Bosses. It has @{2} Difficulty levels: Easy, Hard, and Nightmare. Easy includes only Temple of Cadence; Hard includes Temple of Cadence and Above the Sea of Clouds; Nightmare includes Temple of Cadence, Above the Sea of Clouds, and Chaos Court.
@{3}.Each week, the Guild Master selects the Difficulty and Initiates the Challenge. During the event, Members may Enter Dungeon at any time to Follow the guild's current progress and participate in the Challenge.
@{4}.Reward Counts are shared between stages with the same name across different Difficulty levels. After Claiming a stage reward, you cannot Claim another reward from a stage with the same name that week. Stages with no Remaining Reward Counts may be skipped.
@{5}.Clear rewards are issued immediately after each stage's Settlement. Auction Rewards continue to accumulate, and the auction begins after the Event Over.
@{6}.While the event is Active, the Guild Master may adjust the Challenge Difficulty at any time.

10960000124._kDes:
@{1}.Unlocks after clearing every stage on the previous difficulty.
@{2}.The Reward Count resets and the next difficulty unlocks every Monday at @{3}:@{4}.
@{5}.Only one difficulty can be unlocked each week.

10960000125._kDes:
@{1}.After mounting the Turret, you can immediately use it to attack.
@{2}.Adjust the camera to fire the Turret in different directions.
@{3}.You will automatically dismount the Turret if you die or go offline.

10960000126._kDes:
@{1}.Auction Rewards earned by clearing stages in the Guild Challenge can be previewed here.
@{2}.After the event ends, all items will be available for bidding in the Guild Auction.

10960000127._kDes:
@{1}.If you are defeated for the first time within @{2} seconds after the battlefield officially opens, you receive one Extra opportunity to rejoin the battle.
@{3}.After being defeated for the first time, you do not need another teammate's aid and may choose a new drop point.
@{4}.There is a time limit for choosing a drop point with this Extra opportunity. If time expires, you will automatically Revive where you were defeated. Keep an eye on the timer.

10960000128._kDes: A teammate's ID Tag. Use it or take it to an ambulance to Revive that teammate.

10960000129._kDes:
@{1}.Once the Festival Invitation begins, you may choose one Lucky Star to bet on. You may only bet on one Lucky Star, and your choice cannot be changed afterward.
@{2}.You must place your bet before the Festival Invitation quiz begins. Betting is unavailable once the quiz has started.
@{3}.If your chosen Lucky Star finishes in first place, every player who bet on that Lucky Star receives a reward.
@{4}.The reward is determined by the number of players who correctly chose the winning Lucky Star and will be sent by mail.

10960000130._kDes:
@{1}.The preparation phase lasts @{2} minutes. Once it ends, you can no longer enter this area, so avoid leaving during the preparation phase.
@{3}.The quiz begins immediately after the preparation phase. Watch for the question details.

10960000131._kDes:
@{1}.The first time you use a new Skill Build, you must reallocate skill points and equip skills again. 
@{2}.Each Skill Build is independent. Switching Skill Builds also switches your skill point allocation and equipped skills. 
@{3}.Skill Builds cannot be switched during combat.

10960000132._kDes: Stat Builds cannot be switched during combat.

10960000133._kDes: Equipment Builds cannot be switched during combat.

10960000134._kDes: Card Presets cannot be switched during combat.

10960000135._kDes: Divine Totem Builds cannot be switched during combat.

10960000136._kDes: Soul Echo Builds cannot be switched during combat.

10960000137._kDes: Pet Presets cannot be switched during combat.

10960000138._kDes:
Base Combat Power is permanent.
Equipment, refinement, cards, pets, and Divine Totems can increase Base Combat Power.

10960000139._kDes:
Season Combat Power resets with each Season.
Season Breakthrough, Season Refinement, pet Level-up, and Soul Echoes can increase Season Combat Power.

10960000141._kDes: The Spirit Tower has no Attempt Restriction, so you can challenge it as many times as you want—as long as you can handle it! If you cannot clear it, try again tomorrow!

10960000142._kDes: The Spirit Tower's pet lineup is separate from the pet deployment lineup used in the open world, so keep that in mind!

10960000143._kDes:
@{1}. Break through the castle gate and enter the Inner Area.
@{2}. Defeat the Gatekeeper to gain additional attack time and open the path.
@{3}.Capture the control point to secure the frontline Revive point.
@{4}.Destroy the Crystal to claim victory!

10960000144._kDes:
● The battering ram deals massive damage to the castle gate, so protect it.
● When your side has more players inside the circle than the enemy, the battering ram moves forward.
● Once the battering ram reaches the castle gate, it attacks automatically.

10960000145._kDes:
● Once a siege ladder is deployed, it can be used to scale the wall.
● Siege ladders move automatically, but they still need protection.
● After reaching the wall, prioritize killing the cannons and guards!

10960000146._kDes:
● Players with firearm permission can deploy cannons to attack.
● Hold the Fire button to shrink the shell's impact area, except when using the Flying Crow.
● Ammunition is limited, so use it wisely.

10960000147._kDes:
● Players with vehicle permission can operate a Madogear Pilot at the workshop.
● The Madogear Pilot has a recovery Orbit that restores Life to nearby allies.
● The Madogear Pilot is extremely powerful and can help your side push the battlefront.

10960000148._kDes:
Survive until the countdown ends to win.
@{1}. Prevent the castle gate from being destroyed.
@{2}. Protect the Warden and Gatekeeper.
@{3}. Hold the control point to keep the Crystal Invincible.
@{4}. Prevent the Crystal from being destroyed!!!

10960000149._kDes:
● Leap from the edge of the wall to leave the castle and attack.
● Use the same method to return to the wall.
● Destroy the enemy battering ram as soon as possible to prevent the castle gate from being breached.

10960000150._kDes:
● Once the enemy deploys a siege ladder, they can scale the wall.
● Destroying a siege ladder cuts off the retreat of enemies already on the wall.
● Cannons are also effective against siege ladders.

10960000151._kDes:
A rift has appeared above the Midgard Continent, and an unknown world appears poised to descend. The Novice Instructor is recruiting Adventurers to collect Arcane Crystals and defend against the approaching world.
@{1}.During the event, obtain Arcane Crystals by opening the Tier @{2} chest in the Event Calendar, challenging MVPs, and turning in Cat Hand Caravan quests. You may challenge MVPs @{3} times per day. Cat Hand Caravan quests have no Attempt Restriction.
@{4}.The Entire Server's material donation progress unlocks milestone rewards on the event progress bar. Once the bar is full, preparations will be complete, and everyone can await the arrival of the otherworld.
@{5}.Donate Arcane Crystals to the Novice Instructor in exchange for Contributor Badges, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Contributor Shop.
@{6}.The donation event ends on Day X at Hour X. Players may continue exchanging for prizes in the shop until Day X at Hour X.

10960000152._kDes: Guild Points are the sum of the individual Contribution Points earned by all Members of the Guild. Each player's Contribution Points are proportional to the number of Crystals contributed. Open Activity Chests in the Event Calendar and participate in MVP challenges, Daily Activity, and Guild Recruitment to earn more Contribution Points!

10960000153._kDes:
Siege Points (Attackers Only): Gain @{2} points for every @{1} damage dealt to the castle gate, Castle Guards, Protectors, or Emperium.
Defense Points (Defenders Only): Gain @{4} points every @{3} seconds while stationed within a certain range of the castle gate, Castle Guards, Protectors, or Emperium.
Machines Destroyed: Number of enemy machines destroyed.
Kills: Number of times enemies were defeated.
Assists: Number of times you helped allied Members complete a Kill.
Battlefield Rating: Rating earned by meeting battlefield objectives, reflecting your overall individual contribution.
Machine Damage: Total damage dealt using machines.
Damage Dealt: Total damage dealt by the character.
Damage Taken: Total damage taken by the character.
Healing: Total Healing Volume provided by the character.

10960000164._kDes: After the Royal City auction ends, the successful Guild gains the right to attack the Royal City. If the Royal City has no owner at the start of the Season, the two Guilds that win the auction will be randomly assigned the attacker and defender roles.

10960000165._kDes:
Attackers: Destroy the defenders' Emperium to win.
Defenders: Hold out until time expires to win.

10960000166._kDes:
Up to @{1} Guild Members may enter the battlefield. The mode is divided into four phases: one preparation phase and three attack phases.
Preparation Phase: Attackers cannot leave their base, and defenders cannot leave the castle walls, but both sides may operate their respective machines and Madogear Pilots.
Battle Phase P@{2}: The battle officially begins. Attackers have @{3} minutes to breach the castle gate. If they succeed, they receive bonus time and the attack continues. If they fail to breach the gate before time expires, the defenders win.
Battle Phase P@{4}: Attackers must Kill the Protector within the time limit to open the path to the castle. Killing Castle Guards and the Protector grants the corresponding time bonuses.
Battle Phase P@{5}: There is a Revive point in front of the castle. Attackers must enter the control circle and capture it to remove the Emperium's Invincible status and secure the Revive point. The Revive point can change hands repeatedly. If the defenders recapture it, the Emperium becomes Invincible again. Under any circumstances, after the Emperium remains out of combat for @{6} seconds, it gradually recovers HP within its current phase. The Emperium has three HP phases in total.

10960000167._kDes: Both sides can use firearms and vehicles in battle. The Guild provides both types of machines, but an officer must grant Guild Members permission to use them. Be sure to coordinate machine permissions before the battle.

10960000168._kDes:
Dormant musical energy lies silently awaiting its awakening, ready to sound the prelude of creation...
Solve the note puzzles and play the melody to fill the continent with musical energy.

^{1}Note Clues^{2}
During the event, several ^{3}Note Clues^{4} are scattered throughout a certain city each day. Obtain a Clue to reveal the answer to its corresponding note puzzle. Some Clues can be obtained from a mysterious person.
The melody can only be played successfully when ^{5}all notes are selected correctly^{6}. Search for Note Clues to uncover more answers!

10960000169._kDes: Several notes are missing from the score shown by the mysterious person. The piece can only be performed successfully after every note puzzle has been solved.

10960000170._kDes: Following the mysterious figure's hints will reveal Clues to @{1} missing-note puzzles.

10960000171._kDes: Search the locations indicated by the mysterious figure to find scattered note Clues and solve the corresponding puzzles.

10960000172._kDes: For unsolved note puzzles, tap the puzzle to select a note manually.

10960000173._kDes:
After solving every puzzle, you can pluck the strings and attempt to play the piece, but the melody will only sound if every note is correct.
Each person can obtain only a limited number of Clues per day. Try asking others and sharing information—you might uncover more answers!

10960000174._kDes:
● Turn it in to the guild for guild Currency rewards.
● It cannot be taken out of the Realm Sandbox and will drop from your inventory when you leave.● Upon dying in an Orange Zone, you will drop @{1}% of the total amount you are carrying.● Upon dying in a Black Zone, you will drop @{2}% of the total amount you are carrying.

10960000175._kDes:
Safe Zone: Other players cannot attack you, but beware—monsters are still hostile.
Conflict Zone: Switch to Guild Mode/Free Mode to attack other players. Stay alert!
War Zone: You can freely attack Guild Members and may also switch to Free Mode!

10960000176._kDes:
@{1}.When listing an item at a Stall, a @{2}% Stall fee is charged if the Currency is Meowfruit, while a @{3}% fee is charged if the Currency is Zeny.
@{4}.For Meowfruit, the minimum price is @{5} Meowfruit and the maximum is @{6} Meowfruit.
@{7}.For Zeny, the minimum price is @{8} Zeny and the maximum is @{9} Zeny.

10960000177._kDes:
@{1}.You helped make the city prosper, so Prontera now offers Stall services to all Adventurers.
@{2}.Stalls are permitted in all open-world areas. Stall listings are not shared between channels.
@{3}.Please Keep a suitable Distance from other Adventurers' Stalls. You cannot set up a Stall too close to another one.

10960000187._kDes:
Active Skill: A skill the Adventurer can actively use in battle when the pet is assigned to an active slot.
Passive Skill: A skill that grants bonuses to the Adventurer when the pet is assigned to a Utility slot.
Unlocked Attribute Skill: A skill that permanently grants attribute bonuses to the Adventurer after the pet is unlocked, even when it is not deployed.
Combat Skill: A skill used actively by the pet after it enters battle in modes such as the Pet Tower.

10960000188._kDes:
A pet can gain @{2} star levels for every @{1} Pet Promotions.
Pet Promotion increases the pet's growth rate.
Increasing a pet's star level raises the star level of its active, Passive, and unlocked attribute skills. Higher-star skills provide stronger effects.

10960000189._kDes:
Adventurers can deploy @{1} pets and assign @{2} support pets at the same time, with @{3} active pet slots, @{4} Utility pet slots, and @{5} support pet slots.
Deployment slots are gradually unlocked as the Adventurer's level increases, while support slots are gradually unlocked based on the number of Floors cleared in the Spirit Tower. A deployed pet grants the Adventurer a percentage of its base attributes: @{6}% from deployment slots, while the bonus varies by support slot.
Pets in active slots grant the Adventurer active skills, while pets in Utility slots grant the Adventurer Passive Skills.
Some pets provide a more powerful Core Passive effect while assigned to a Utility slot.
If multiple pets with Core Passives are assigned to Utility slots, only the Core Passive in the lowest-numbered Utility slot takes effect.
Deploying @{7} pets of the same Faction activates a Faction effect. Each Faction has a different effect; view the Faction combination attributes below.

10960000190._kDes: After Unlocking a Collection Entry, you can activate the Pet in the Collection. Once activated, the Pet grants its unique Collection Stats without needing to Deploy it. The Pet's Collection Stats increase with its star rating.

10960000208._kDes:
@{1}.Phantom Realm can be ^{1}entered directly with a party or through matchmaking^{2}. At least @{2} Members are required to Enter Dungeon.
@{3}.During matchmaking, the system prioritizes the Dungeon's Suggested roles that ^{3}the current party is missing^{4}.

@{5}.After each Boss is unlocked, you receive ^{7}1 fixed First Clear Reward Count^{8}. First Clear Reward Counts are not reset by the weekly refresh.

10960000209._kDes:

10960000220._kDes:
Weapon—Heavy Cannon:

10960000224._kDes: After escaping, Nature God Ilmata transformed into its second divine body. It must absorb Almagia's energy to recover—destroy it before it fully recovers!!!

Players operating the Rapid-Fire Cannon can aim at the Hollow Jellyfish in the sky and Launch attacks.
Hollow Jellyfish continuously deal area damage to Almagia's back. Eliminate them quickly to protect the players fighting Ilmata.

10960000226._kDes: Almagia has recovered its energy. ^{1}Players on its back must escape by sliding down its tail^{2}, then resume the battle when it becomes Weak again.

After being dragged into Ilmata's dream, the players arrive in Almagia's midsection. ^{1}They must break through the obstacles ahead and escape the dream quickly^{2}.
When the game begins, a Vessel Protector appears behind the players and ^{3}cannot be attacked^{4}. Approaching the Vessel Protector continuously deals massive damage.

10960000231._kDes:

The guild transporting the supplies is the Escort faction, while all other guilds are Raiders.
See the following tabs for more details.

10960000232._kDes:
Go to the Quartermaster to pick up a supply cart
Escort the supply cart to the Supply Officer to earn event points for the entire party

10960000233._kDes:
Search the battlefield for supply carts

10960000234._kDes:
During the event, participate in active content (MVP, Guild Recruitment, and Daily Activity Chests) for a chance to obtain Crystals. Collect a complete set of Crystals to open a Box of Memories (the chest on the event page) and claim bountiful rewards.
A complete set of Crystals includes:
@{1}. Crystal of Pain
@{2}. Crystal of Joy
@{3}. Crystal of Doubt
@{4}. Crystal of Regret
@{5}. Crystal of Vows
Collect @{6} of each to create the chest. You can also obtain Crystals by requesting them from Alliance Members.
Open the “Box of Memories” multiple times to gradually unlock the progress reward, the ^{1}Box of the Future^{2}, which contains rare resources for the next Season.

10960000235._kDes:
When the Season's official phase ends, Season Settlement rewards will be distributed to all players. The Season Settlement System grants substantial rewards based on each player's and Guild's performance across various activities throughout the Season. The better a player performs during the Season, the greater the rewards they will receive.

^{1}Settlement Time^{2}:
Season Settlement takes place when the final @{1} phases of the current Season begin. All Season Settlement rewards will be distributed after this point.

^{3}Settlement Categories^{4}:
Season Settlement is divided into two main categories: Territory War Settlement and Spacetime Epic Settlement. Each category covers different content and offers different types of rewards.

^{5}Territory War Settlement^{6}:
Territory War Settlement rewards are based on each Guild's and player's performance in Territory War. Players who achieve outstanding results in Territory War will not only receive substantial rewards, but also become eligible to purchase limited-time items for the new Season from the Season Shop.

^{7}Spacetime Epic Settlement^{8}:
Spacetime Epic features multiple Epic Quests spanning various types of Season content. Completing Spacetime Epic grants generous rewards as well as the highly collectible Spacetime Emblem.

10960000236._kDes:
At Season Settlement, rewards will be determined based on each guild's and player's performance in the Territory War.
Territory War Settlement consists of @{1} parts: Territory Points Leaderboard Settlement, Royal City Settlement, and Realm Merit Settlement.

^{1}Territory Points Leaderboard Settlement^{2}:
At Season Settlement, a guild's ranking on the Territory Points Leaderboard determines whether its Guild Members are eligible for Throne Rewards.
Throne Rewards are the most prestigious rewards of the entire Season. They are distributed through a quota system according to the following rules:
@{2}. The top @{3} guilds on the Points Leaderboard receive @{4}, @{5}, and @{6} Throne slots, respectively.
@{7}. A guild occupying the Royal City at Settlement receives @{8} Throne slots; a guild occupying County Cities receives @{9}*the number of County Cities occupied Throne slots.
@{10}. A guild's Throne slots are automatically awarded to Guild Members in descending order of their Royal War Prestige ranking within the guild.
@{11}. All officers of the top @{12} guilds on the Points Leaderboard automatically receive Throne Rewards without using their guild's Throne slots;
Players who do not receive Throne Rewards will receive Laurel Rewards instead. The higher their guild ranks, the greater their Laurel Rewards will be.

^{3}Royal City Settlement^{4}:
The guild occupying the Royal City at Settlement will receive an Extra honor: Realm Starlight.

^{5}Realm Merit Settlement^{6}:
At Season Settlement, Realm Merit Leaderboard rewards will be calculated. All eligible ranked players will receive rewards based on their placement.

10960000237._kDes:
Each Season includes a series of “Chronicle of Time and Space” quests. Players' completion status will be checked at the time of Season Settlement.
You will receive the corresponding reward for every @{1} Chronicle of Time and Space quest completed. Some quests reward the Season-exclusive collectible “Space-Time Emblem,” which can be viewed under “Personal Space - Emblem Wall.”
Any Chronicle of Time and Space quests left incomplete after the Settlement deadline can no longer be completed.
When the Season ends, the System will automatically send any unclaimed Chronicle of Time and Space rewards by mail.

10960000238._kDes:
This event centers on Territory War and consists of two main parts:
@{1}. Guild Quests: Rewards
During the event, guilds can participate in Territory War and complete point-based quests, allowing each Guild Member to earn the corresponding rewards.
@{2}. Guild Total Points Ranking Rewards
During the event, the System will rank guilds across the Entire Server based on the Total Points accumulated by their members in Territory War. After the event ends, the highest-ranking guilds will receive tier-based rewards that all alliance members can claim. These rewards will provide vital resources and strategic advantages in future Territory Wars.

10960000239._kDes:
Participate in the Spirit Tower during the event to earn ranking rewards at Settlement. The higher your rank, the better the rewards!
@{1}. Players who reach higher Floors will rank higher.
@{2}. Players who complete the same number of Floors will be ranked by completion time, with faster players ranking higher.

10960000240._kDes:
During the event, challenge Ilmatar, God of Nature on Desperate difficulty. Rankings are based on the shortest clear time for each stage.
@{1}. You may participate multiple times during the event. The rankings will update based on your best result.
@{2}. Each stage can be challenged repeatedly. Your total clear time will be updated based on your best time for each stage.
@{3}. At event Settlement, each guild Member will receive event rewards.
@{4}. Rewards will be distributed according to the final rankings when the event ends. The higher your rank, the better the rewards!

10960000241._kDes:
During the event, clear the Realm of Gods on Normal difficulty without using the Praiser Priest's Revive skill to complete the challenge successfully.
@{1}. Rankings will be based on your actual clear time.
 @{2}. Using the Praiser Priest's Revive skill will result in challenge failure, and the result will not count toward the event.
 @{3}. You may Repeat the challenge after clearing it. Only your best result will appear on the leaderboard.
 @{4}. Rewards will be distributed after the event ends. The higher your ranking, the better the rewards!

10960000242._kDes: Log in for a total of @{1} days during the event to unlock all check-in rewards! Remember to claim them manually each day. The grand prize awaits you on the final day!

10960000243._kDes: Develop Echoes during the event and complete Event Quests to earn rewards!

10960000244._kDes: During the event, guilds compete based on their total accumulated Contribution. Spending Contribution will not reduce this total. Each Member must reach the base Contribution requirement to claim rewards. If you switch guilds during the event, your base Contribution will be recalculated from zero.

10960000245._kDes: Take part in all kinds of exciting events and Claim fantastic Grand Prizes!

10960000246._kDes: Can be obtained from Daily Activity Chests.

10960000247._kDes: City Defense decreases every minute based on the intensity of the monster invasion. Defeat monsters to restore City Defense. If City Defense falls to @{1}, the city will be overrun.

10960000248._kDes: Complete missions during the event to earn even more rewards!

10960000249._kDes:
Conqueror slots within the guild will be automatically assigned based on the Guild Merit Rankings;
Officers of the top three guilds in the Territory War Points Rankings will automatically receive Conqueror rewards without using a Conqueror slot.

10960000251._kDes:
@{1}. Season Rank activities include Dungeons, Guilds, Territory War, Battle Royale, Treasure Hunting, and Secondary Professions.
@{2}. Each activity awards its own points, which increase the corresponding rank and earn you rewards.
@{3}. Rewards for each rank can be claimed up to @{4} times, so you can freely choose the activities you enjoy.
@{5}. Season Ranks reset when a new Season begins, and new ranked activities may be added. Stay tuned.

10960000252._kDes:
The first guild to reach @{1} Guild Points wins. If both guilds have @{2} points, or if the scores are tied when the match ends, the guild with more total player defeats on the Main Battlefield wins. The following actions on the Main Battlefield grant Guild Points:
Defeat a player: @{3} points/player
Capture a point: @{4} points/capture
Hold a capture point: @{5} points/@{6} sec.
Successfully deliver a flag: @{7} points/delivery

10960000253._kDes:
Personal Points are used for rankings during Report Settlement. The following actions grant Personal Points on the battlefield:
Defeat a player: @{1} Points/player
Assist an ally: @{2} Points/time
Revive an ally: @{3} Points/player
Flag Captured (Main Battlefield): @{4} Points/time
Flag Delivered Successfully (Main Battlefield): @{5} Points/time
Capture a Stronghold (Main Battlefield): @{6} Points/time
Maintain control (Main Battlefield): @{7} Points/@{8} seconds
Defeat a Guard (Sub-Battlefield): @{9} Points each (Final Blow), @{10} Points each (Participation)
Defeat a Commander (Sub-Battlefield): @{11} Points each (Final Blow), @{12} Points each (Participation)
Defeat a Boss (Sub-Battlefield): @{13} Points each (Final Blow), @{14} Points each (Participation)

10960000254._kDes: Battlefield Rating reflects individual performance during a match and is divided into seven tiers: D, C, B, A, S, SS, and SSS. Actions that benefit your guild and teammates increase your Rating and tier.

10960000255._kDes: The League has eight tiers: Ragnarok, Diamond, Jade, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Black Iron. At the start of each tournament, the System assigns tiers based on each guild's group ranking from the previous tournament. Higher-ranked guilds are promoted, while lower-ranked guilds are demoted. Guilds in the same tier are then divided into groups and randomly matched within their group for the preliminary round.

10960000256._kDes: At the start of each tournament, all guilds will be automatically registered at @{1}:@{2} on Monday. The System will then assign each guild to a division and match based on its group ranking from the previous tournament. (For the first tournament of each Season, divisions will be determined by the Combat Power of each guild's Members.) Each guild will compete in three matches: the preliminaries, semifinals, and finals. After the finals, the System will determine the group rankings based on the results of all three matches.

10960000257._kDes: Each guild may send up to @{1} Members into the Main Battlefield, and only Elite Members may Enter. The Main Battlefield has 3 capture points: Fire, Mountain, and Water. Capturing and maintaining control of these points grants Guild Points. Control is determined by which guild has more Members at the point. After a point is captured, it is Fortified for @{2} seconds and cannot change hands. Once the Battle begins, a Boss appears in the courtyard every @{3} minutes. The player who lands the Final Blow on the Boss receives a flag. Delivering the flag to a point controlled by your guild grants Guild Points.

10960000258._kDes: There is no limit to the number of players who may Enter the Sub-Battlefield. All Members except Temporary Members may participate. Once the Battle begins, large numbers of Guards appear immediately. After @{1} minutes, more Guards and @{2} Commanders appear. After @{3} minutes, a Boss appears. Defeating Guards, Commanders, and the Boss grants Morale. Defeating Commanders and the Boss increases the Uses of Commander skills in the Main Battlefield.

10960000259._kDes:
The first guild to reach @{1} Guild Points on the Main Battlefield wins. If both guilds have @{2} Points, or if their Points are tied when the match ends, the guild with more total player Defeats on the Main Battlefield wins. The following actions grant Guild Points on the Main Battlefield:
Defeat a player: @{3} Points/player
Capture a Stronghold: @{4} Points/time
Maintain control: @{5} Points/@{6} seconds
Flag Delivered Successfully: @{7} Points/time

10960000260._kDes:
When Morale reaches @{1}/@{2}/@{3}, all Members on the Main Battlefield and Sub-Battlefield gain @{4}%/@{5}%/@{6}% DMG Reduction. The following actions grant Morale on the Sub-Battlefield:
Defeat a player: @{7} Morale/player
Defeat a Guard: @{8} Morale each
Defeat a Commander: @{9} Morale each
Defeat a Boss: @{10} Morale each

10960000261._kDes: Defeating Commanders and Bosses on the Sub-Battlefield grants powerful Commander skills with shared limited Uses to the Guild Master and Commanders on the Main Battlefield.

10960000262._kDes: After the match, a guild with at least @{1} Guild Points and @{2} participants will receive Auction Rewards and Auction Dividends. Players with at least @{3} Personal Points will receive individual Participation Rewards.

10960000263._kDes:
@{1}.Each day after @{2}:00, the Guild Caravan will place orders with Adventurers for the day's required goods. Adventurers can craft them or purchase them through Trade or from a Stall.
@{3}.After loading their goods, Adventurers will receive personal rewards based on the value of the goods.
@{4}.After loading all @{5} goods for the day, Adventurers can dispatch the caravan and receive generous rewards.
@{6}.Dispatching the caravan after loading @{7}/@{8}/@{9} goods will grant even more Additional rewards.

10960000264._kDes:
@{1}.Players can use Get Help to request cargo assistance from fellow guild members.
@{2}.Guild members who help load cargo can earn rewards, so lend your friends a hand!
@{3}.The number of times you can use Get Help or help others each day is limited, so plan wisely.

10960000265._kDes: @{1}.During the first round each day, we'll supply the Royal Caravan. It only comes once, but loading its cargo grants the greatest rewards, so be sure to load as much as you can!

10960000266._kDes: @{1}.Starting with the second round each day, we'll supply the Traveling Caravan. It will return several times and offers generous rewards for loading goods, so load as much as you can.

10960000270._kDes:
The Guild Black Market is a resource Trade platform between guilds. Guild Management can use Guild Funds to purchase war supplies listed by other guilds.
@{1}.Guild Management can list guild war supplies for sale at a stall by setting the unit price and quantity.
@{2}.The unit price can only be adjusted within a certain range based on the recent average Trade price and cannot be entered freely.
@{3}.The Black Market displays all resources listed for sale by every guild. Resources with the same unit price are grouped together.
@{4}.When a purchase is made, the System automatically matches sellers based on listing time. When an item is sold, a percentage of the total price is charged as a transaction fee.
@{5}.Only a Member with Guild Management permissions can use the Black Market.

10960000271._kDes: The Trade fee is charged by the Black Market as a percentage of the sale proceeds. You can view your actual earnings in the sales history.

10960000272._kDes:
@{1}. Auto Bid can be configured during the preparation phase and will automatically place bids once the auction begins.
@{2}. After each failed qualification attempt, the bid will automatically Increase Bid based on the fixed tier multiplier until it exceeds the threshold price.
@{3}. If none of the tiers exceed the threshold price, Auto Bid will stop and send a Notification to the Guild.
@{4}. Bid Style determines the delay before each automatic bid.

10960000273._kDes: The System will automatically use Increase Bid in fixed increments (@{1}%, @{2}%, @{3}%, @{4}%, @{5}%, and @{6}%). Once all bids are used, it will stop bidding.

10960000274._kDes:

@{1}. Daily MVP participation rewards
@{2}. Rewards for making a total of @{3}, @{4}, @{5}, or @{6} Guild Supply submissions
@{7}. Final Daily Activity Chest reward
Collect a complete set of Crystals to open the Memory Coffer—the chest on the event page—and claim generous rewards. You can also request Crystals from Guild Members. 10960000275._kDes:
During the event, complete Activity Missions to obtain Treasure Maps, then use them to hunt for treasure. There are two types of Treasure Maps: Normal Treasure Maps and Rare Treasure Maps.
@{1}. Using a Normal Treasure Map may grant rewards (including Treasure Map Fragments), trigger an Elite Monster encounter, summon a powerful Boss, or result in a failed treasure hunt.
@{2}. Successfully hunting for treasure with a Rare Treasure Map will grant valuable rewards with consistently high prize values.
Rare Treasure Maps can be crafted from Treasure Map Fragments. Treasure Map Fragments can be obtained while hunting for treasure with Normal Treasure Maps or purchased through Trade.
During the event, we recommend prioritizing Activity Missions on the Event Gameplay screen. Completing these missions grants a certain number of Normal Treasure Maps and is one of the main ways to obtain Treasure Map Fragments.
Additionally, hunting for treasure with Normal or Rare Treasure Maps has a Chance to grant a Lost Traveler's Journal. Follow the Clues in the journal to search the map for the destination, where you may find an Extra surprise reward.

10960000277._kDes:
The full Territory War cycle lasts one Season and includes the War Map, Stronghold Battles, Supply Transport, and Siege Battles.
The War Map is a standard open-world mode that can be entered at any time, while the other modes have specific unlock requirements and follow a set sequence.
Each Season consists of multiple rounds, with modes opening in the following order during each round: Stronghold Battle → Supply Transport → Regional Capital Siege → Royal Capital Siege

10960000279._kDes:
Auction Eligibility:
Guilds with ≥ n members may participate in the Stronghold War qualification auction. Guilds that do not meet this requirement may not participate.

Auction Cost:
Guild Supplies are consumed to bid for the right to participate in Stronghold War.

Auction Permissions:
Only certain guild ranks have permission to perform auction-related actions.

Auction Rules:
The corresponding amount of Guild Supplies will be deducted when a bid is successfully placed.
Once a guild places a bid, it cannot withdraw or lower the bid. Bids may only be raised manually.

10960000288._kDes:
Participation Reward Distribution Rules:
Individual Rewards: Players who earn n points in the Stronghold Battle become eligible to claim rewards.
Auction Rewards: If a guild is eligible to participate in the Stronghold Battle and at least @{2} of its players earn @{1} points, the guild becomes eligible for Guild Auction rewards. The rewards will be listed in the Guild Auction after the event ends.

Stronghold Occupation Reward Distribution Rules:
Individual Rewards: Players who earn @{3} points in the Stronghold Battle become eligible to claim rewards if their guild occupies a stronghold on the battlefield when the event ends.
Auction Rewards: If a guild is eligible to participate in the Stronghold Battle and occupies a stronghold on the battlefield when the event ends, the guild becomes eligible for Guild Auction rewards. The rewards will be listed in the Guild Auction after the event ends.

10960000290._kDes:
Stronghold Contest Phases:
The Stronghold Contest cycles through the following phases: Bidding → Preparation → In Progress → Ended.
At the end of the Season, the off-season begins. The contest will resume when the next Season starts.

Bidding:
During this phase, Guild Leaders must spend Guild Supplies to place bids and qualify for the Stronghold Contest.
For each prefecture within the same realm, only the top @{1} bidding guilds can participate in the Stronghold Contest.

Preparation:
During this phase, the bidding results and attack information are displayed so qualifying guilds can discuss their strategies.

In Progress:
The Stronghold Contest officially begins. Keep the information displayed during the Preparation phase and provide qualifying guilds with an entrance to the event.

Ended:
The results of the current Stronghold Contest are displayed. Tap Battle Record in the lower-right corner for more details on the battle's offense and defense.
When this phase ends, a new Stronghold Contest cycle begins with the Bidding phase.

10960000291._kDes:
Stronghold Contest Phases:

Battle Prep Phase: During this phase, attacks are prohibited. Players may move within the permitted area to gather information, discuss tactics, and coordinate battle plans.

Battle Phase: During this phase, players may attack members of an opposing Faction. Capture the stronghold's banner and successfully defend it to occupy the stronghold.

10960000292._kDes:
Victory in the Stronghold Assault!
Stronghold Phase
@{1}.Assault Preparation Phase:
During this phase, players from opposing Factions cannot attack each other. Attackers may move outside the stronghold area, while defenders may move freely throughout the entire area. Use this time to gather intelligence, coordinate tactics, and prepare for battle.
@{2}.Stronghold Assault Phase:
Each stronghold has a banner that attackers can damage. The Guild of the player who deals the final blow temporarily takes control of the stronghold. If the stronghold is not captured again within a certain period, it will be locked, and that Guild will retain control of it for the rest of the battle.
