11210100000._kDes: A Hat made from half of a sturdy fruit. It provides solid defense, but a hammer would still break it, so it cannot be refined.

11210100001._kDes: A Hat made by wearing a bread bag backward.

11210100002._kDes: A decorative eggshell worn on the head. It's surprisingly sturdy.

11210100003._kDes: A military Hat worn exclusively by Prontera Soldiers.

11210100004._kDes: A Hat coveted by every talented mage. It looks a little odd, but it's comfortable to wear and gives off a lively air.

11210100005._kDes: A black Hat worn by students.

11210100007._kDes:
A stone statue of an ancient sage. Some people wear it on their heads, hoping to gain the sage's wisdom.
But it's incredibly heavy.

11210100008._kDes: Shuka Bain's Black Cat Ears. Exquisitely crafted and adorable.

11210100009._kDes: A bandage Hat that wraps around the head. It makes your injuries look serious enough to earn a healer's sympathy.

11210100010._kDes: A magnificent headpiece made from the wing feathers of a Grand Peco.

11210100012._kDes: A rather fashionable Hat adorned above with a valuable feather.

11210100014._kDes: A headband adorned with a beautiful kitten doll. The lace trim makes it even cuter.

11210100015._kDes: A doll made to be carried on your head. If you hear a cat meowing from somewhere or feel something moving on your head, it's just your imagination.

11210100016._kDes: A Nurse Cap worn by nurses who care for patients in place of doctors.

11210100017._kDes: A Hat modeled after a Deviruchi. Its fresh, adorable look brings joy to both the wearer and everyone who sees it.

11210100018._kDes: Legend has it that this apple was struck by an ancient Sniper from an incredible Distance.

11210100019._kDes: A theatrical prop Helmet that frightens others when worn normally.

11210100020._kDes: Everyone knows that stepping on a banana peel will make you slip. If someone wears one into battle, it means their opponent is already Angry.

11210100021._kDes: Sweetheart Tea Party · Matching Theme Headwear

11210100023._kDes: A headband made from gathered Angel feathers.

11210100024._kDes: Protective headgear made of gold. Since gold is its primary material, it is remarkably sturdy and provides excellent defense.

11210100025._kDes: A headband modeled after a demon's wings.

11210100026._kDes: A Helmet for true Orc heroes, proving that its wearer is the bravest and greatest among all Orcs.

11210100027._kDes: A jeweled accessory for women. Legend says it was once worn at the wedding of a queen from a certain kingdom. It sharpens the mind while casting magic.

11210100028._kDes: A headband worn by the supreme leader of a clan.

11210100029._kDes: A large Hat worn by pirate captains. Since it is reserved for captains, it projects an imposing air of absolute authority.

11210100030._kDes: A beautiful Hat with unusual patterns. Wearing it somehow makes you feel smarter.

11210100031._kDes: This Crown sharpens the wearer's mind and contains magic that bolsters mental strength.

11210100032._kDes: A Hat found in a distant land, symbolizing the sun's supreme power. It is sturdier than it looks.

11210100034._kDes: Folded from cloth into a circular shape and set with a gemstone, this headpiece looks truly majestic.

11210100035._kDes: A Helmet topped with goat horns and steeped in religious significance.

11210100036._kDes: A Hat modeled after Moonlight Flower.

11210100038._kDes: Starfish-shaped headwear that brings you closer to nature!

11210100039._kDes: A Crown shaped like Thorn branches, adorned with gemstones, tiny osmanthus-like flowers, and dark butterflies. A bow at the back trails long tassels.

11210100040._kDes: A Golden Coronet engraved with mysterious runes. Legend says it was blessed during the coronation of a former pope.

11210100041._kDes: A unique Hat with enormous wings symbolizing the sun. Please don't ask how you're supposed to walk while wearing it.

11210100042._kDes: Calling it animal poop or excrement sounds rather crude, so it is collectively referred to as dung.

11210100043._kDes: A mask modeled after those worn by an assassination squad to conceal their identities. Wearing it somehow makes you feel more agile.

11210100044._kDes:
He is the sun; He has no need to look up.
Worldscorch Feather · Theme Headwear

11210100046._kDes: Black glasses that can shield your eyes from the sun or serve as a fashionable accessory.

11210100047._kDes: A strip of cloth worn over the eyes, though it is sometimes used for other purposes.

11210100050._kDes: A Blinker worn over an injured eye to protect it.

11210100051._kDes:
Magical glasses that make constantly spinning patterns appear before your eyes.
Wearing them causes Stun, though to everyone else they look like ordinary glasses.

11210100052._kDes: A mask with a hearty laugh. Wearing it prevents others from reading your Emotes or emotions beneath the mask.

11210100053._kDes: Small and delicate, this is perfect for looking cute in front of your sweetheart. A must-have for any handsome young man or beautiful young woman...

11210100054._kDes: A pair of small red-accented hair ribbons that make girls look even cuter.

11210100055._kDes: Pairing it with a Nurse Cap may produce an unexpected effect. A cute Blinker designed for anyone seeking a distinctive look.

11210100056._kDes: A bizarre-looking mask. Its frightening appearance makes it perfect for playing pranks.

11210100057._kDes: A mask imbued with the strong will of a Goblin Leader. But no matter how you dress it up, a Goblin is still a Goblin.

11210100058._kDes: Earrings made from black wings, exuding the noble aura of a demon. Wearing them seems to grant mysterious power from the wings.

11210100059._kDes: Dazzling earrings modeled after beautiful Angel wings. Wearing them seems to grant mysterious power from the wings.

11210100060._kDes:
He comes from the slowly rising light.
Worldscorch Feather · Theme Facewear

11210100062._kDes: A mustache that gives you a sincere and dependable look when worn.

11210100063._kDes: The long, pointed beak of a bird or other animal, ideal for catching insects or pecking at feed.

11210100065._kDes: An ornament worn on a Clown's nose.

11210100066._kDes: Sweet, delicious candy prepared for good children.

11210100067._kDes: A Romantic Leaf that flutters in the wind when held in your mouth, evoking the feeling of a wandering traveler.

11210100068._kDes: A fragrant Lucky Clover that brings good luck!

11210100069._kDes: Our best friend on a hectic morning. It brings to mind someone rushing out the door with it held in their mouth.

11210100070._kDes: A pacifier placed in a Child's mouth to soothe them. It should look adorable when equipped by a Child character!

11210100071._kDes: A neckerchief that may once have been worn by rogues.

11210100072._kDes:
An item modeled after an Angry Snarl. Use it to become an angry cat, angry rabbit, or create other looks!
(Secondary drop from Goblin Leader)

11210100073._kDes: A Pipe that holds a cigarette. Its built-in filter helps reduce the harm caused by smoking.

11210100074._kDes:
A specially treated fish that can be held in your mouth. It smells slightly fishy, but never spoils.
Defeated monsters have a low chance to drop a "Tasty Fish."

11210100075._kDes: Once a keeper of Order across this continent, now all that's left to do is enjoy the game.

11210100076._kDes: When you become a little kitty, you'll discover Happiness in its purest, most Easy form.

11210100077._kDes: Dark roses bloom across jet-black satin, pale lace coiling around the neck like a spiderweb. A metal cross sways from its chain, and the hoop skirt traces a sharp arc of shadow. Every step echoes the low hum of a medieval pipe organ.

11210100078._kDes: A moonlight-silver satin gown cascades downward, with crystal bead strands flowing across the waist like a river of stars. The mermaid hem blooms into delicate pleats, glowing icy blue with every movement, as though the night sky became a dress.

11210100079._kDes: An oversized linen-cotton shirt drapes over distressed denim and cream knitwear, creating relaxed layers. Rolled-up sleeves reveal a braided bracelet, while canvas shoes add a touch of sunlit warmth.

11210100080._kDes:
A navy plaid suit creates a crisp silhouette, with a Gold academy crest on the lapel.
The pleated skirt swings perfectly with every step, paired with knee-high socks and Oxford shoes for a youthful look.

11210100081._kDes: Sweet pink meets refreshing Blue, while fondant-like pleats build a creamy texture. Chocolate-colored ribbons sparkle with frosting-like sequins, and the skirt spins like a tiered cake, beginning a dreamy parade of sweetness.

11210100082._kDes: A sweet pink, Blue, and yellow puff dress features layers of fondant-like pleats with a creamy texture. Chocolate-colored ribbons sparkle with frosting-like sequins, and as the skirt spins open like a tiered cake, a dreamy parade of sweetness begins.

11210100083._kDes: Golden threads shimmer through nine-hued robes, inspired by Dunhuang's flying apsaras. Its sleeves dance like swirling ribbons, blending the spirit of the Silk Road with Eastern grace. Every detail radiates classical elegance and ethereal beauty.

11210100084._kDes: Feathers cascade over satin like golden-red flames, while brilliant gold thread traces the radiance of rebirth. With every step comes the low call of a divine bird—regal, magnificent, and blazing with presence.

11210100085._kDes: A fluffy Fox tail. Will wearing it turn you into a real Fox?

11210100086._kDes: A very old-fashioned television set that can surprisingly still play programs.

11210100087._kDes: A mechanical ship's wheel with gears at its center. Powered by the central furnace core, it spins continuously.

11210100088._kDes: A backpack specially made for Adventurers who dare to challenge themselves and never give up. Its vivid red matches the fiery spirit burning within them.

11210100089._kDes: The rabbit family of Fairy-Tale Town loves curling up inside teacups for afternoon naps whenever the sun is shining.

11210100091._kDes: Wings that look like a cross between a butterfly's and a dragonfly's. Pair them with a dress to look like a tiny flower fairy.

11210100092._kDes: A clock-shaped halo with Roman numerals. Its hour and minute hands rotate counterclockwise, as though they could control time itself.

11210100093._kDes: A Costume modeled after the Grim Reaper's scythe.

11210100094._kDes:
A doll Piamette uses to make attacking and defending easier?
I could have sworn I saw it move...

11210100095._kDes: A Costume balloon featuring Lunatic, Eclipse, and Leaf Lunatic together. It's so huge, it feels like it could carry someone away.

11210100097._kDes: It looks like a kitten's tail. Will wearing it turn you into a real kitten?

11210100098._kDes:
Each spread of its wings brings fire, and every feather burns eternally.
Worldscorch Feather · Theme Backwear

11210100099._kDes: It's a Poring! A giant Poring carrying a huge backpack!

11210100106._kDes: A fluffy, long-haired rabbit wearing a purple bow. It's incredibly cute when it runs.

11210100107._kDes: This little airplane looks a bit old-fashioned.

11210100108._kDes: A hot-air balloon brimming with Goblin spirit! Unfortunately, flaws in its construction keep it from taking off.

11210100109._kDes: It once cleaved through raging waves with its massive claws. Now it has laid the storm to rest and become the steadiest of mounts, carrying you sideways across the seas of the world.

11210100110._kDes: A hardworking little kitty pushes its cart... You are the most valuable treasure aboard, yet you'll never be sold.

11210100111._kDes: The latest Goblin masterpiece! After fixing the flaw that kept the previous hot-air balloon grounded, this one can soar through the sky!

11210100112._kDes: A tiny kun hidden in the deep sea. Someday, it will slowly grow and soar into the heavens...

11210100113._kDes: The Toy Factory's latest rocking horse, complete with a mysterious and slightly unsettling smile.

11210100114._kDes: The once-frail Super Picky has become incredibly brave, carrying an Adventurer onward.

11210100115._kDes: A radiant, sacred unicorn that looks enchanting from every angle.

11210100116._kDes: This magic carpet once carried tales from the Arabian Nights beneath the desert moon and stars. The moment you step aboard, it unfurls a miracle that lets you ride the wind.

11210100117._kDes: Forged from an ancient, tamed sun, this chariot trails the golden light of dawn and the dying embers of dusk with every charge.

11210100118._kDes: The song of a deep-sea whale bears an orchid from a secluded valley. Wherever it carries you, flowers seem to bloom in the sky and stars rise from the water.

11210100119._kDes: In the Northern Deep dwells a fish named Kun. Kun is so enormous that no one knows how many thousands of miles it spans... How many grills would that take?

11210100120._kDes: This ancient dragon once governed the paths of the stars. Now it restrains its divine might and carries you across the heavens.

11210100122._kDes: Pink hair as sweet as a Strawberry macaron.

11210100123._kDes:
The flames have burned out, but this color will never fade.
Worldscorch Feather · Theme Hairstyle

11210100125._kDes: All that sweetness is swirling around you.

11520200011._kDes: As a Madogear Pilot wielding a kinetic battle axe, seize the initiative with devastating Burst, fierce crowd control, and crushing blows that defeat foes before they can react.

11520200025._kDes: Strike opponents with consecutive Sand Puffs.

11520200026._kDes: High Crit, dealing Physical damage with Normal Attacks.

11520200027._kDes: Perform rapid combos with poison skills, with some AoE options.

11520200028._kDes: Flexible offense and defense with ST damage.

11520200029._kDes: Use High Burst to strike the backline, with two Stealth abilities ensuring the first move.

11520300000._kDes: A novice practitioner and new Member of the Church, the Praiser Priest Acolyte can use Divine Light on themselves and allies while providing numerous buffs and removing debuffs. They are also highly effective against Undead and Demon monsters.

11520300001._kDes: A novice practitioner and new Member of the Church, the Exorciser Acolyte can use Divine Light on themselves and allies while providing numerous buffs and removing debuffs. They are also highly effective against Undead and Demon monsters, making them well suited for auto-battle leveling in the field.

11520300002._kDes: A core Member of the Church who has begun taking on more practical duties. After mastering basic Divine Light magic, the Praiser Priest gains the ability to Revive allies, use AoE Divine Light, and provide shields. Their AoE buffs are also comprehensively Enhanced, making them a capable healer.

11520300003._kDes: A core Member of the Church who has begun taking on more practical duties. The Exorciser Priest excels at Holy magic, dealing heavy damage to Undead monsters and making this build a strong choice for Priest auto-battle leveling.

11520300004._kDes: An advanced cleric of the Church with considerable theological knowledge and administrative experience. The Praiser Priest High Priest further improves their Divine Light and party buffs.

11520300005._kDes: An advanced cleric of the Church with considerable theological knowledge and administrative experience. The Exorciser High Priest further improves their damage and Holy-element buffs.

11520300006._kDes: A highest-ranking cleric who has mastered extremely advanced divine arts for wide-area recovery and AoE buffs. The Praiser Priest Archbishop gains greatly improved survivability and AoE recovery, as well as the ability to grant allies Respawn.

11520300007._kDes: A highest-ranking cleric who has mastered extremely advanced Holy magic. The Exorciser Priest gains stronger Holy magic with greater Burst damage, along with AoE crowd control on the battlefield.

11520300008._kDes: Deals steady Physical damage with cart attacks.

11520300009._kDes: Deals steady Physical damage with cart attacks and provides Buffs that improve the Battle capabilities of both the user and the party.

11520300012._kDes: As a Madogear Pilot equipped with a battle axe, gain exceptional mobility, control, and survivability, allowing you to charge deep into enemy lines and deal explosive Burst damage.

11520300013._kDes: Sustained high-speed damage and AoE suppression

11520300030._kDes: Use even more powerful Magic. Master Earth and Fire to cast massive AoE spells that greatly aid the party.

11520300031._kDes: Use even more powerful Magic. Master Wind and Water to cast massive AoE spells that greatly aid the party.

11520300032._kDes: These magic experts own overwhelming magic potential already, but now their magics are at a complete different level: they are capable of wielding the power of Neutral magics, or even utilizing their Psychokinesis power to control gravity.

11520300033._kDes: Harness the power of all four elements to counter large groups of enemies.

11520300034._kDes: Use powerful soul energy to control and damage enemies in a small area.

11520500000._kDes: Excels at healing allies and specializes in defensive and buff magic.

11520500001._kDes: High Priests are blessed by the gods. They repeatedly work miracles through sacred power and excel at purifying Undead Monsters. With a wide variety of Support and Healing Magic, they are among the most reliable members of any party.

11520500002._kDes: A powerful presence that saves allies from danger. Reduces the damage allies take while providing powerful Healing.

11520500003._kDes: As the Archbishop closest to the angels, a potent embodiment of sanctity, he offers the finest aid to his allies. At the same time, he wields holy magic to deliver devastating blows to his enemies.

11520500004._kDes: Abacus in hand, cart at the ready. A natural gift for business never stops this merchant from turning a pushcart into the perfect battlefield weapon.

11520500005._kDes: Flame and hammer define a Blacksmith's life—the power of tempering not only forges keen blades, but also empowers the party to Sweep Attack through enemy lines.

11520500006._kDes: Skill elevated to an art, craftsmanship without limit. A Blacksmith at the pinnacle of the craft wields peerless hands to push forging power to its utmost.

11520500007._kDes: Piloting the Madogear Pilot, they Launch long-range cannon fire to demolish enemy lines, or charge in with a kinetic battle axe to control the field and unleash explosive strikes, leaving opponents no time to breathe.

11520500008._kDes: Warriors who walk the path of holy war, wielding faith and Spear as their sharpest weapons. After Job Advance from Swordsman, Crusaders Keep their formidable melee capabilities while further specializing in Spear weapons. They develop two distinct combat styles: an Attack-type Spear build that trades blood for damage, and a defensive shield build that protects allies in peril.

11520500009._kDes: Tempered by even greater holy trials, Paladins Enhance the core mechanics of each Crusader path, further defining the class traits of the "Attacker" and "Protector."

11520500010._kDes: The ultimate evolution of the Crusader path. Royal Guards are not only the kingdom's mightiest warriors, but also engines of destruction that shatter enemy lines. They can withstand and deal heavy damage, crash repeatedly through enemy formations, or serve as the core of their own party.

11520500011._kDes: Uses a bow to excel at ranged attacks and can knock enemies back at critical moments.

11520500012._kDes: Long-range combat specialist, master of archery, and a mastermind who utilizes traps to lure the enemy into the palm of their hand. They can train a Falcon to support them, and the upper limit to their attack damage is very high.

11520500013._kDes: They are shooters with perfect aim. Under the attack of arrows and their falcons, no enemy can withstand long, not to mention to fight back.

11520500014._kDes: A solitary Ranger who keeps only a Demonic Wolf for company and has mastered the art of marksmanship. The Ranger can unleash rapid shots at distant targets with the speed of a gale or ride a Demonic Wolf for highly mobile hunts.

11520500015._kDes: Excels at close-range combat, wielding a sword with a balance of offense and defense.

11520500016._kDes: A loyal knight of the kingdom. Skilled with swords and spears, knights can ride Peco Pecos into battle, wield formidable offensive power, and rapidly charge toward enemies.

11520500017._kDes: Their stopping power is enough to crush frontline enemies in the blink of an eye, and they are the most powerful force of The Knights. Not only do they excel in both offensive and defensive positions, once they are in rampage, they're able to massively increase their physique within a short amount of time.

11520500018._kDes: The kingdom's mightiest knight, having mastered the power of runes and tamed a demonic dragon. With complete mastery of swords and spears, Rune Knights ride demonic dragons into the fray, unleash elemental breath attacks, and Sweep Attack entire armies.

11520500019._kDes: Thief is the most agile of all Adventurer classes. Rather than relying on heavy armor to survive, Thieves use their extraordinary reflexes to evade attacks.

11520500020._kDes: Agile, swift, and deadly, Assassins learn the ways of the Dual Blade Technique. Their unrivaled burst damage makes them rulers of one-on-one combat. They can equip the Katar, a weapon with a high critical rate.

11520500021._kDes: An assassin who always has another trick under their sleeve, and none of their targets ever live to see another day. They're good at using poison and assassin techniques to sabotage the enemy's formation and achieve effective results.

11520500022._kDes: When an Assassin Cross achieves a Breakthrough beyond their limits, they become the dreaded Guillotine Cross. Each ring of violet-black afterimages is a waltz that reaps Life—a devastating display of Ultra speed.

11520500023._kDes: Excels at long-range magical combat and can command the five elements of Water, Fire, Wind, Earth, and Ghost.

11520500024._kDes: Capable of using more powerful magics. Although their poor close-quarter combat ability being their weakness as past, by mastering the four elemental stats of Water, Earth, Fire, and Air, they can still be a powerful addition to the team with their incredibly wide-range AOE magics.

11520500025._kDes: These magic experts own overwhelming magic potential already, but now their magics are at a complete different level: they are capable of wielding the power of Neutral magics, or even utilizing their Psychokinesis power to control gravity.

11520500026._kDes: Warlocks are the ultimate form of the Mage path and the most complex class in the entire Magic system. They combine absolute mastery of the four Elements with the secrets of Soul Buster. A Warlock can weave the four Elements into an Entrapping Net or crush a single target through sheer force of will with Soul Buster.

12390100330._kDes: On the ^{3}oldest stone bridge^{4} in ^{1}Geffen^{2}, examine the joint in the central support beam. A gift lies within a carefully crafted hidden recess.

12390100331._kDes: Beside the bench near the ^{1}Izlude shop^{2}, watch the ^{3}butterflies^{4} that refuse to leave. They seem drawn to an old man's unfinished gift and still flutter there, showing the way.

12390100332._kDes: In ^{1}Izlude^{2}, the ^{5}small tree^{6} ^{3}outside the Blacksmith shop^{4} has listened to the ringing of hammers for years. They say a master craftsman buried one of his precious "failures" beneath the root closest to the shop.

12390100333._kDes: In ^{1}Izlude's^{2} bustling ^{3}market^{4}, search the most inconspicuous corner of a fruit stall. The shrewd merchant likes to hide his most valuable earnings in the gaps between a pile of Lemons and potatoes.

12390100334._kDes: Beside the ^{3}wooden table^{4} in the southeastern tea pavilion of ^{1}Payon^{2} lies a gift from an elderly tea lover. He left a memento wrapped tightly in oilcloth behind the table leg for a friend who missed their meeting.

12390100335._kDes: In ^{1}Payon^{2}, head to the ^{3}left side of the open area just inside the courtyard gate^{4}, behind Scholar Biko. A crack in the left boot heel of the ^{5}stone statue^{6} is large enough to conceal a small object. The secret waits there.

12390100336._kDes: The ^{1}wooden bridge in Goblin Forest^{2} was once the site of a caravan raid. Amid the chaos, a small pouch of gems rolled away and became lodged in a crack between the planks at the center of the bridge.

12390100337._kDes: ^{1}Outside Prontera North Gate^{2}, beside the path leading from the North Gate to Labyrinth Forest, the ^{3}dead-tree Dummy directly in front of the dilapidated cabin^{4} stands out. A traveler in a hurry once hid a bag of coins beneath it, but never returned.

12390100338._kDes: Behind the ^{3}bakery visible on your left^{4} ^{1}outside Prontera South Gate^{2}, some stones at the ^{5}base of the city wall^{6} are loose. They say an indebted sailor hid his last bag of silver coins here.

12500000006._kDes:
The late Emperor had yet to complete half of his great undertaking when he passed away. Now the realm is divided into three, and Yizhou is exhausted and weakened. This is truly a critical moment upon which our survival depends. Yet the officials of the imperial guard remain diligent at court, while loyal and devoted officers abroad risk their lives, all because they remember the late Emperor's exceptional kindness and wish to repay it to Your Majesty. You should open your ears to wise counsel, thereby honoring the late Emperor's legacy and inspiring those of lofty ideals. You should not belittle yourself or make improper comparisons that would block the path of loyal remonstrance.

　　The imperial palace and the government offices are one body; rewards and punishments, praise and censure, should be administered by the same standards. If anyone commits treachery or violates the law, or performs loyal and virtuous deeds, the proper authorities should determine their punishment or reward, thereby demonstrating Your Majesty's just and impartial rule. You should show no favoritism or allow different laws to apply within and outside the palace.

　　Palace Attendants and Vice Directors Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi, Dong Yun, and the others are all honest and capable men, loyal and pure in purpose and judgment. For this reason, the late Emperor selected and promoted them to serve Your Majesty. In my humble opinion, all palace affairs, great or small, should be discussed with them before being carried out. They will surely remedy omissions and shortcomings and bring broad benefit.

　　General Xiang Chong is virtuous and fair in character and conduct, and thoroughly versed in military affairs. When his abilities were tested in the past, the late Emperor praised him as capable. The officers therefore unanimously recommended Chong as commander. In my humble opinion, all military affairs should be discussed with him. He will surely bring harmony to the ranks and assign every soldier according to his ability.

　　Drawing close to worthy ministers and keeping petty men Away was how the Former Han flourished; drawing close to petty men and keeping worthy ministers Away was how the Later Han declined. Whenever the late Emperor discussed this matter with me, he never failed to lament the reigns of Emperors Huan and Ling with bitter regret. The Palace Attendants, Directors of the Secretariat, Chief Clerks, and Army Advisers are all faithful and upright ministers willing to die for their principles. I pray that Your Majesty will remain close to them and place your trust in them. Then the restoration of the House of Han may soon be expected.

　　I was once a commoner, personally tilling the fields in Nanyang. I sought only to preserve my life in troubled times and had no desire for fame or distinction among the feudal lords. The late Emperor did not disdain me for my humble station or lowly origins, but graciously humbled himself to visit me three times at my thatched cottage and consult me about the affairs of the age. Moved by his kindness, I pledged myself to his service. Later, when disaster struck, I accepted responsibility amid defeat and received my orders in a time of peril. Twenty-one years have passed since then.

　　The late Emperor knew that I was cautious, and so, as death approached, he entrusted me with this great responsibility. Since receiving his command, I have worried and sighed day and night, fearing that I might fail in my charge and thereby tarnish the late Emperor's wisdom. Thus, in the fifth month, I crossed the Lu River and ventured deep into barren lands. Now the south has been pacified and our arms and provisions are sufficient. We should rally the three armies, march north to secure the Central Plains, and devote what little ability I possess to eliminating the traitors and villains, restoring the House of Han, and returning to the old capital. This is my duty in repaying the late Emperor and serving Your Majesty with loyalty. As for weighing advantages and disadvantages and offering faithful counsel, that is the responsibility of Youzhi, Yi, and Yun.

　　I pray that Your Majesty will charge me with defeating the rebels and restoring the dynasty. If I fail, punish me for my crimes and inform the spirit of the late Emperor. If no counsel is offered to promote virtue, then rebuke Youzhi, Yi, Yun, and the others for their negligence and make their faults known. Your Majesty should also deliberate for yourself, seek advice on the right course, examine and accept sound counsel, and faithfully uphold the late Emperor's final edict. I am overwhelmed with gratitude for the favor I have received. Now that I must go Away, tears fall as I submit this memorial, and I scarcely know what I have written.

12500000007._kDes:
In the spring of the fourth year of the Qingli era@{1}, Teng Zijing was demoted and appointed governor of Baling Prefecture@{2}. By the following year@{3}, the government was efficient, the people were united@{4}, and all neglected endeavors had been revived@{5}. The Yueyang Tower was then renovated@{6} and expanded beyond its former dimensions@{7}, while poems and rhapsodies by eminent Tang poets and contemporary writers were inscribed upon it@{8}. I was asked to write this account in commemoration@{9}.
In my view, the magnificent scenery of Baling@{10} is embodied by Lake Dongting alone. It embraces the distant mountains@{11} and swallows the mighty Yangtze River@{12}, its vast waters surging endlessly@{13} and stretching beyond the horizon@{14}. From morning sunlight to evening shadow, its appearance changes in countless ways@{15}. Such is the grand vista from Yueyang Tower@{16}, which earlier writers have described in full@{17}. Yet with Wu Gorge accessible to the north@{18} and the Xiao and Xiang Rivers extending far to the south@{19}, banished officials and wandering poets@{20} often gather here@{21}. Could their feelings upon viewing this scenery possibly be the same@{22}?
When ceaseless rain falls in dreary sheets@{23} and the sky remains overcast for months on end@{24}, bitter winds howl furiously@{25} and turbid waves surge toward the heavens@{26}. The sun and stars conceal their light@{27}, and the mountains vanish from sight@{28}. Merchants and travelers can go no farther@{29}, while masts topple and oars splinter@{30}. As twilight falls, all is engulfed in darkness@{31}, amid the roars of tigers and cries of apes. Those who ascend the tower then may lament their exile and yearn for home@{32}, fear slander and dread reproach@{33}, and find only desolation wherever they look@{34}, until sorrow overwhelms them@{35}.
But when the spring breeze is gentle and the sunlight bright@{36}, the water lies calm and untroubled@{37}. The radiance of sky and lake meets as one@{38} across a boundless expanse of blue-green. Gulls wheel above the sandbars and come to rest, while shimmering fish swim below@{39}. Angelica grows along the banks and orchids upon the islets@{40}, lush and verdant@{41}. At times, the lingering mist clears completely@{42}, revealing the brilliant moon over a thousand miles@{43}. Its glimmer dances like gold upon the rippling water@{44}, while its still reflection sinks like a jade disc into the depths@{45}. Fishermen's songs echo back and forth@{46}—how could such joy ever end@{47}? Those who ascend the tower then may feel their hearts open and their spirits soar@{48}, forgetting both favor and disgrace@{49}, and raise a cup of wine to the breeze@{50}, filled with boundless delight@{51}.
Alas@{52}! I have often sought to understand the hearts of the benevolent sages of antiquity@{53}, whose sentiments perhaps differed from both of these@{54}. Why was that? They rejoiced not in material things, nor grieved over their own misfortunes@{55}. When serving in the imperial court, they worried for the people@{56}; when living in distant seclusion, they worried for their sovereign@{57}. Thus, whether advancing in office or withdrawing from it, they always had cause for concern. When, then, could they find joy? Surely they would say, "Be the first to worry about the world's troubles and the last to enjoy its pleasures"@{58}. Ah! Without such people, whom could I follow@{59}?
Written on the fifteenth day of the ninth month in the sixth year of the era. [@{60}]

A cloaked woman plays her instrument, then smiles at you and says:
“Adventurer, there's something special about you... May I take a look?”

12500000009._kDes: The Chrono Compass emits a dazzling light, then projects a strange vision: you see yourself entering a mysterious abyss, where a massive structure stands, seemingly a door.

12500000010._kDes: The airship takes off. As you look outside, the people of Izlude wave goodbye.

12500000011._kDes:
The naked young woman suddenly transforms into a giant ant—she was the Ant Queen all along!
She unleashes an attack skill and summons several Pieres to surround the Professor.
A cocoon gradually envelops the Professor, and the ants drag them toward a mysterious opening. The Ant Queen follows them inside and disappears.

12500000012._kDes: Pushed from the Garden of Time by Ji, you fall into the abyss.

12500000013._kDes: After using Interaction on the Chrono Compass, you see a brief vision of all the Nails of World Order lighting up.

12500000014._kDes: The stone pillars drain your power, leaving you floating helplessly in midair. The pillars in Prontera and other cities shatter, revealing enormous nail-shaped sculptures within. The nails then plunge a short Distance into the ground, causing the entire continent to quake. The shock wave sends you flying, but Ji suddenly appears and catches you.

12500000015._kDes: The professor comes over to greet you. Moments later, a Soldier reports that a glowing "Relic" appeared near Goblin Forest after the tremor, and someone needs to investigate.

12500000016._kDes: The Relic begins to glow, and Pharaoh leaps out, catching everyone off guard. The knights are too busy to help, so they ask you to fight the monster.

12500000017._kDes: Ki shows you an animation of the massive gate to the Garden of Time coming together piece by piece.

12500000018._kDes: After being released, the Pathfinder Ant crawled off in one direction, leaving a trail of Footprints.

12500000019._kDes: The Chrono Compass absorbs the Thoughtform, space trembles, time is set to Pause, and the player enters the Abyss.

12500000020._kDes: Without looking back, Jack ran into the woods. In the distance, a scream rang out as a branch tore his clothes...

12500000021._kDes: Under the Guild Members' conflicted gazes, you turned and left the suffocating place behind. Even the sunlight seemed unusually bright.

12500000022._kDes: You arrive at your destination, but no one is there. There's only an adorable little kitten meowing.

12500000023._kDes: Pet the adorable kitten, and it affectionately nuzzles your hand... Suddenly, the ground gives way beneath your feet. It seems a Trap Hunter was set here. Helpless, you fall in and slam hard into the ground...

12500000024._kDes: The vision in your dream was a beacon from the future.

12500000025._kDes: It revealed no illusion, but the calamity that the continent of Midgard will one day face—

12500000026._kDes: A storm powerful enough to consume heaven and earth is gathering beyond the horizon.

12500000027._kDes: And you are the one chosen by the light.

12500000028._kDes: The savior foretold in prophecy, the morning star that still shines amid despair.

12500000029._kDes: Until fate reveals itself once more, you must never stop moving Forward.

12500000030._kDes: Go forth and train, sharpening your edge with every Battle;

12500000031._kDes: Go forth and explore, seeking every source of power across these ancient lands.

12500000032._kDes: When darkness truly descends, only the best-prepared hero

12500000033._kDes: can become the light that pierces the endless night.

13230100000._kDes: "The faithful of Eden cheered for the dawn, their songs becoming strings and their faith the harp's pillar. When God played the harp, even He nearly believed—that hope truly existed."

13230100001._kDes: "When the Klein Cube was swallowed by the Eternal Land, the first gears engaged—the void split into golden patterns, only to collapse into darkness in an instant. Yet the music played on, performing the eternal struggle between order and chaos."

13230100002._kDes: "When the Fishmen chanted, every storm fell silent. God forged that silence into a blade and carved through the will of seven thousand worlds to resist."

13250100000._kDes: Based on an analysis of the strange fluctuations in the Ant Hell

13260100000._kDes: ...The Nail of Order is by no means a natural creation. Ancient records from Juno state that the ancient civilization of Juperos possessed technology capable of converting Life Emotions (thought forms) into physical energy. I theorize that activating the Nail requires some Ultra form of "conviction" as the key.

13260100001._kDes: The Legend of the Ant Hell... "The Mimic Girl's Obsession." If the Legend is true, high-purity thought particles born from an intense "unwillingness to give up" should remain here. This is the perfect sample for testing my theory.

13260100002._kDes: Objective: Use the improved "Particle Resonator" to capture and analyze the free-floating thought particles here. If their energy spectrum resonates with the Nail of Order, it will prove that... human conviction and powerful Emotions can drive the Nail of Order.

13260100003._kDes: The resonator is reacting violently. The rumors were true... The sample's purity is beyond anything I imagined! I must... I must go deeper... to the source of the energy...
